examples.en: The aforesaid conditions must be satisfied before the council can approve any construction within the protected area.
examples.zh: 必須滿足上述條件，地方議會才能批准保護區內的任何建設專案。

words.tip: 法律或正式書面語，通常置於名詞前。

senses.en: Money paid beyond the amount owed, or paying too much

examples.en: The cashier returned my overpayment before I left.
examples.zh: 我離開前，收銀員退還了我多付的錢。

examples.en: Clear payroll procedures can prevent accidental overpayment and reduce disputes between employers and their staff.
examples.zh: 清晰的工資發放流程可以防止意外多付款，並減少僱主與員工之間的糾紛。

words.tip: 款項用of引出：an overpayment of wages。

senses.en: The study of whole economies, including growth, inflation, and unemployment.

examples.en: My sister studies macroeconomics at college every Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我姐姐每週二都在大學裡學習宏觀經濟學。

examples.en: An understanding of macroeconomics helps policymakers assess how interest rate changes might affect national employment.
examples.zh: 瞭解宏觀經濟學有助於政策制定者評估利率變化可能如何影響全國就業。

words.tip: 雖以s結尾，指學科時接單數謂語；區別於微觀經濟學。

senses.en: with that thing or together with it
immediately after that

examples.en: She handed him the parcel and a ribbon therewith.
examples.zh: 她把包裹連同一條絲帶遞給了他。

examples.en: Applicants must submit the completed form and all supporting documents therewith before the committee considers their request.
examples.zh: 申請人必須提交填好的表格及隨附的全部證明檔案，委員會才會審議其申請。

words.tip: 古舊或法律用語；日常用with it或along with it。

senses.en: To oversee and take responsibility for work or an activity.

examples.en: An experienced gardener superintended the planting of our trees.
examples.zh: 一位經驗豐富的園丁監督了我們種樹的過程。

examples.en: Qualified engineers should superintend major construction projects to ensure that safety standards are consistently maintained.
examples.zh: 大型建設專案應由合格工程師監督，以確保始終遵守安全標準。

words.tip: 正式及物動詞，直接接工作或活動；日常多用supervise。

senses.en: Of this document, statement, or matter.

examples.en: Our lease says, “Keep a copy hereof for your records.”
examples.zh: 我們的租約上寫著：“請保留本檔案副本備查。”

examples.en: The housing agreement states that the provisions hereof apply equally to all tenants in the building.
examples.zh: 住房協議規定，本協議的條款平等適用於樓內所有租戶。

words.tip: 法律文體用詞，相當於of this，不等於here。

senses.en: A tax, especially one charged on imported goods.
A projecting support from which an arch rises.

examples.en: The guide explained the old impost on imported tea.
examples.zh: 導遊講解了過去對進口茶葉徵收的稅。

examples.en: An impost on imported grain could protect domestic farmers while increasing food costs for urban consumers.
examples.zh: 對進口穀物徵稅可以保護本國農民，卻也可能增加城市消費者的食品開支。

words.tip: 稅義較古舊或專業；現代通常用tax或duty。

senses.en: Relating to the final profit or financial outcome.

examples.en: The owner discussed bottom-line results with her accountant.
examples.zh: 店主和她的會計討論了最終盈利情況。

examples.en: An excessive focus on bottom-line performance may discourage companies from investing in employee development.
examples.zh: 過分關注最終盈利表現可能使企業不願投資於員工發展。

words.tip: 連字元形式常作定語；名詞寫bottom line。

senses.en: Someone who earns money to support a family.

examples.en: My mother was the main bread-earner in our family.
examples.zh: 我母親曾是家裡主要掙錢養家的人。

examples.en: Affordable childcare can help a family's sole bread-earner remain employed while ensuring that children receive appropriate care.
examples.zh: 負擔得起的托育服務能幫助家中唯一掙錢養家的人繼續工作，同時確保孩子得到妥善照顧。

words.tip: 較少見；日常及考試寫作通常用breadwinner。

senses.en: A written instruction asking a bank to pay a specified amount.

examples.en: My grandmother sent me a cheque for my birthday.
examples.zh: 奶奶寄給我一張支票作為生日禮物。

examples.en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, some businesses still accept a cheque from customers.
examples.zh: 儘管數字支付日益普及，一些企業仍接受顧客用支票付款。

words.tip: 支票英式拼寫為cheque，美式為check，讀音相同。

senses.en: A different offer made in response to an earlier offer.

examples.en: The seller rejected our price and made a counter-offer.
examples.zh: 賣家拒絕了我們出的價格，並提出了還價。

examples.en: Employers may make a counter-offer when skilled employees announce plans to accept a position elsewhere.
examples.zh: 當技術熟練的員工宣佈打算另謀職位時，僱主可能提出新的待遇條件以挽留他們。

words.tip: 可寫作counteroffer；不僅指還價，也指修改條件。

senses.en: A day when you do not have to work.

examples.en: On my day off, I cycled to the lake.
examples.zh: 休息那天，我騎車去了湖邊。

examples.en: Taking a regular day off allows employees to recover and may improve their performance at work.
examples.zh: 定期休息一天能讓員工恢復精力，也可能提高工作表現。

words.tip: 複數是days off；請一天假可說take a day off。

senses.en: A decrease in an amount, level, or activity.
The act of leaving someone or something at a place.
A place where the ground suddenly becomes much lower.

examples.en: The café noticed a drop-off in customers after summer.
examples.zh: 夏天過後，這家咖啡館發現顧客減少了。

examples.en: A sharp drop-off in bus use may indicate that services no longer meet residents' needs.
examples.zh: 公交使用量大幅下降可能表明，公交服務已無法滿足居民需求。

words.tip: 名詞帶連字元；動詞短語寫作drop off。

senses.en: Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.

examples.en: The small restaurant serves first-rate food at reasonable prices.
examples.zh: 這家小餐館的菜品一流，價格也合理。

examples.en: Access to first-rate training enables young workers to develop skills that employers increasingly value.
examples.zh: 獲得一流培訓的機會能讓年輕勞動者培養僱主日益看重的技能。

words.tip: first-rate表示質量一流，不是“第一次評價”。

senses.en: involving all the usual working or studying hours
for all the usual working or studying hours

examples.en: My sister starts her first full-time job next week.
examples.zh: 我姐姐下週開始做她的第一份全職工作。

examples.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to return to full-time employment without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
examples.zh: 負擔得起的托育服務使更多家長能夠重返全職工作，同時不會給家庭經濟帶來過大壓力。

words.tip: 修飾名詞時保留連字元，如a full-time job。

senses.en: Contracts to trade assets later at prices agreed now.

examples.en: My cousin trades wheat futures from her home office.
examples.zh: 我表姐在家中的辦公室交易小麥期貨。

examples.en: Farmers can use futures to protect themselves against falling crop prices, although these contracts also involve financial risks.
examples.zh: 農民可以利用期貨防範農作物價格下跌，但這些合約也涉及金融風險。

words.tip: 金融義用複數形式；futures contract指期貨合約。

senses.en: Arrange or style hair.

examples.en: She learned to hairdress by practising on a mannequin.
examples.zh: 她透過在人頭模型上練習學會了做髮型。

examples.en: People who learn to hairdress professionally may develop practical skills that support employment in local service industries.
examples.zh: 學習專業美髮的人可以培養實用技能，從而在當地服務行業就業。

words.tip: 日常說做髮型用 style hair；美髮行業用 hairdressing。

senses.en: costing half the usual price
at half the usual price

examples.en: We bought half-price tickets for the afternoon boat trip.
examples.zh: 我們買了下午遊船的半價票。

examples.en: Offering half-price public transport to students could improve access to education and reduce car use.
examples.zh: 向學生提供半價公共交通服務可以改善受教育機會，並減少汽車使用。

words.tip: 名詞前常寫half-price；at half price不加連字元。

senses.en: a system where employees reserve shared workspaces instead of permanent desks

examples.en: With hotelling, I book a desk before coming in.
examples.zh: 採用工位預約共享制後，我來上班前會先預訂工位。

examples.en: Hotelling can reduce office costs, although employees may miss having a permanent space for their belongings.
examples.zh: 工位預約共享制可以降低辦公成本，不過員工可能會懷念擁有固定空間存放個人物品的日子。

words.tip: 通常指預約共享工位；旅館業用hotel industry。

senses.en: happening or available inside a physical shop
inside a physical shop rather than online

examples.en: The shop is offering free in-store cooking demonstrations today.
examples.zh: 這家店今天提供免費的店內烹飪演示。

examples.en: Despite the growth of online shopping, in-store services remain important for customers who need personalised advice.
examples.zh: 儘管網購不斷發展，店內服務對於需要個性化建議的顧客仍然重要。

words.tip: in-store指店內的；“有庫存”通常說in stock。

senses.en: Requiring no interest payments on borrowed money.

examples.en: We bought our sofa with an interest-free loan.
examples.zh: 我們用一筆免息貸款買了沙發。

examples.en: Interest-free loans can help students cover living expenses without increasing their financial burden through interest charges.
examples.zh: 免息貸款可以幫助學生支付生活開支，而不會因利息費用增加他們的經濟負擔。

words.tip: 免息不等於免費：本金仍須償還。

senses.en: Practical knowledge and skills needed to do something successfully

examples.en: My uncle has the know-how to repair old bicycles.
examples.zh: 我叔叔掌握修理舊腳踏車的技術。

examples.en: Sharing technical know-how can help small businesses adopt cleaner production methods without relying entirely on outside consultants.
examples.zh: 分享技術知識可以幫助小企業採用更清潔的生產方式，而不必完全依賴外部顧問。

words.tip: 不可數名詞，強調實際操作能力，拼寫保留連字元。

senses.en: having little chance of harm, loss, or failure

examples.en: We chose a low-risk investment for our savings.
examples.zh: 我們為儲蓄選擇了一項低風險投資。

examples.en: Low-risk financial products may appeal to households that prioritise stability over potentially higher returns.
examples.zh: 低風險金融產品可能吸引那些更重視穩定而非潛在高回報的家庭。

words.tip: low-risk表示風險較低，不等於完全無風險。

senses.en: not working during a particular period

examples.en: An off-duty nurse helped when my grandfather fell.
examples.zh: 我爺爺摔倒時，一位不當班的護士幫了忙。

examples.en: Providing comfortable accommodation allows off-duty staff to rest properly, improving their performance during subsequent shifts.
examples.zh: 提供舒適的住宿能讓下班的員工充分休息，從而改善他們下一班的工作表現。

words.tip: 名詞前用off-duty；作表語通常寫off duty。

senses.en: Involving fewer hours than a full working or studying week.
For fewer hours than a full working or studying week.

examples.en: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
examples.zh: 我姐姐在一家麵包店做兼職。

examples.en: Part-time employment allows university students to gain practical experience while continuing to focus on their studies.
examples.zh: 兼職工作讓大學生能夠在繼續專注學業的同時積累實踐經驗。

words.tip: 可作形容詞或副詞：a part-time job；work part-time。

senses.en: not paid by the date when payment was required

examples.en: I finally paid the past-due bill this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我終於付清了那筆逾期賬單。

examples.en: Financial counselling can help households manage past-due payments and avoid falling further into debt.
examples.zh: 財務諮詢可以幫助家庭處理逾期款項，避免債務進一步加重。

words.tip: 名詞前可加連字元；表語通常寫作 past due。

senses.en: The theft of small amounts or items, especially from workplaces.

examples.en: The shop now locks its stockroom to prevent pilferage.
examples.zh: 這家商店現在把庫房鎖起來，以防東西被順手偷走。

examples.en: Retailers can reduce losses from pilferage by improving stock monitoring and providing secure storage for valuable goods.
examples.zh: 零售商可以透過加強庫存監控併為貴重商品提供安全儲存空間，減少小額失竊造成的損失。

words.tip: pilferage是不可數名詞，不是動詞；動詞為pilfer。

senses.en: to export goods that were previously imported

examples.en: They import tea, package it locally, and reexport it.
examples.zh: 他們進口茶葉，在本地包裝後再出口。

examples.en: Some ports reexport imported goods to neighbouring countries, creating jobs in storage, transport, and related services.
examples.zh: 一些港口將進口商品再出口到鄰國，為倉儲、運輸及相關服務創造就業機會。

words.tip: 也寫作re-export，指進口後再出口。

senses.en: The degree to which something can be sold easily.

examples.en: Fresh paint improved the salability of our old house.
examples.zh: 重新刷漆讓我們的舊房子更容易賣出。

examples.en: Manufacturers often adjust packaging to improve the salability of products in highly competitive markets.
examples.zh: 製造商經常調整包裝，以提高產品在競爭激烈市場中的適銷性。

words.tip: 美式拼寫；英式通常寫作saleability。

senses.en: Working for yourself rather than being employed by an organisation.

examples.en: My aunt is a self-employed electrician with her own van.
examples.zh: 我姑姑是個體電工，有自己的貨車。

examples.en: Self-employed workers often enjoy flexible schedules but may lack paid holidays and a stable monthly income.
examples.zh: 自僱者通常享有靈活的工作時間，但可能沒有帶薪假期和穩定的月收入。

words.tip: 指為自己工作，不等於失業；注意保留連字元。

senses.en: working for yourself rather than for an employer

examples.en: Self-employment lets me choose when I take holidays.
examples.zh: 自僱讓我可以自己決定什麼時候休假。

examples.en: Although self-employment offers greater flexibility, it can also involve irregular income and limited access to employment benefits.
examples.zh: 雖然自僱更靈活，但也可能意味著收入不穩定，且難以享有僱員福利。

words.tip: 不可數；指為自己工作，不一定是創辦公司。

senses.en: lasting or having effects for only a limited time

examples.en: This short-term job will cover my summer expenses.
examples.zh: 這份短期工作能支付我暑假期間的開銷。

examples.en: Short-term solutions may reduce immediate pressure but fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
examples.zh: 短期措施或許能緩解眼前的壓力，卻無法解決失業的根本原因。

words.tip: 作定語常用連字元；in the short term不加。

senses.en: Give a customer less weight of goods than paid for

examples.en: The shopkeeper short-weighted my rice by using faulty scales.
examples.zh: 店主使用有問題的秤，賣給我的米缺斤少兩。

examples.en: Regular inspections of market scales can prevent traders from short-weighting customers and help maintain confidence in local commerce.
examples.zh: 定期檢查市場用秤可以防止商販缺斤少兩，並幫助維持消費者對當地商業的信任。

collocations.zh: 向顧客售貨時缺斤少兩

words.tip: 動詞指缺斤少兩；名詞通常分寫為 short weight。

senses.en: Able to be ended, especially under agreed conditions

examples.en: My rental agreement is terminable with one month's notice.
examples.zh: 我的租約可以提前一個月通知後終止。

examples.en: Employment contracts should be terminable by either party, provided that reasonable notice is given.
examples.zh: 只要給予合理的提前通知，僱傭合同應允許任何一方終止。

words.tip: 正式法律用語，常形容合同；不等於terminal。

senses.en: Time when you are not working or attending school.

examples.en: I need some time off to visit my grandparents.
examples.zh: 我需要請幾天假去看望祖父母。

examples.en: Providing paid time off can improve employee wellbeing and reduce stress in the workplace.
examples.zh: 提供帶薪休假可以改善員工身心健康，減輕工作壓力。

words.tip: 通常不可數；請一天假可說 take a day off。

senses.en: taking a lot of time to do or complete

examples.en: Sorting all these old photos is surprisingly time-consuming.
examples.zh: 整理這些舊照片竟然這麼費時間。

examples.en: Applying for multiple permits can be time-consuming, discouraging small businesses from expanding their operations.
examples.zh: 申請多項許可可能很耗時，使小企業不願擴大經營規模。

words.tip: 強調花費大量時間，不一定表示浪費時間。

senses.en: Transfer goods from one ship or vehicle to another.

examples.en: Workers transshipped the crates onto a smaller boat.
examples.zh: 工人們把這些板條箱轉運到一艘較小的船上。

examples.en: Shipping companies often transship cargo at major ports to reduce costs and reach smaller markets.
examples.zh: 航運公司常在主要港口轉運貨物，以降低成本並進入較小的市場。

words.tip: 過去式為transshipped，現在分詞雙寫p。

senses.en: Experience an emotion, physical sensation, or personal belief.
Touch something to discover its texture, shape, or position.
The quality something has when touched or experienced.

examples.en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
examples.zh: 蓋著這條柔軟的毯子，我覺得暖和多了。

examples.en: Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.
examples.zh: 當公共空間照明充足且由地方政府定期維護時，居民往往更有安全感。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為felt；feel後可直接接形容詞。

senses.en: one of the two body parts used for seeing
an ability to notice or judge particular qualities
to look at someone or something with particular interest

examples.en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
examples.zh: 她閉上眼睛，聽著雨聲。

examples.en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
examples.zh: 設計師需要善於觀察細節，才能打造既美觀又便於所有人使用的公共空間。

words.tip: an eye for表示鑑賞力；keep an eye on表示照看。

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

examples.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
examples.zh: 昨天走了很長一段路，現在我全身痠痛。

examples.en: An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.
examples.zh: 應由一個獨立機構監測水質，並向公眾公佈調查結果。

words.tip: body可指機構；文章的body指正文部分。

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.
How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

examples.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
examples.zh: 步行上班確實改善了我的健康狀況。

examples.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
examples.zh: 政府可以透過提供安全飲用水和可負擔的醫療服務來改善公眾健康。

words.tip: 通常不可數；表示身體健康用in good health。

senses.en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.

examples.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
examples.zh: 我們帶了足夠的食物，準備在湖邊野餐。

examples.en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
examples.zh: 減少家庭食物浪費既能省錢，也能降低家庭消費對環境的影響。

words.tip: 泛指食物時不可數；foods表示不同種類的食物。

senses.en: Someone receiving medical care.
Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming annoyed.

examples.en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
examples.zh: 護士給病人端來了一杯水。

examples.en: Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.
examples.zh: 讓患者討論治療方案可以增進信任，並改善健康結果。

words.tip: 作名詞是“患者”；作形容詞常接with。

senses.en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much
a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment

examples.en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡晚飯後沿著河邊散步。

examples.en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
examples.zh: 學校可以透過提供多樣化的圖書和安排定期參觀圖書館，培養孩子對閱讀的熱愛。

words.tip: love doing和love to do均可表示喜歡做某事。

senses.en: the end of a person's or animal's life

examples.en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
examples.zh: 老狗的離世讓全家人深感悲傷。

examples.en: Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.
examples.zh: 更便利地獲得清潔飲用水，已減少了許多社群中可預防疾病導致的死亡。

words.tip: die是動詞，dead是形容詞，death是名詞。

senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important
Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

examples.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在當地診所得到很好的照料。

examples.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
examples.zh: 價格可負擔的托育服務讓更多家長能夠繼續工作，同時確保幼兒得到妥善照料。

words.tip: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜歡。

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

examples.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
examples.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

examples.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
examples.zh: 許多畢業生希望找到有意義的工作，使自己能夠為社會作出積極貢獻。

words.tip: 可說hope to do，不說hope sb to do。

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

examples.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
examples.zh: 我跑上坡時，心跳會加快。

examples.en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
examples.zh: 經常運動能增強心臟功能，並降低患嚴重疾病的風險。

words.tip: by heart表示熟記；lose heart表示灰心。

senses.en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness.
A substance taken for its effects on mind or body.
To give someone a substance that makes them unconscious or weak.

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a drug to ease her pain.
examples.zh: 醫生開了一種藥來緩解她的疼痛。

examples.en: New drug development requires extensive testing to ensure that treatments are both safe and effective.
examples.zh: 新藥研發需要進行大量測試，以確保治療既安全又有效。

words.tip: 可指治病的藥，也可指毒品，須看語境。

senses.en: A place where ill or injured people receive medical treatment.

examples.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
examples.zh: 她在當地醫院當護士。

examples.en: Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.
examples.zh: 在該地區新建一家醫院將有助於農村居民獲得專科醫療服務。

words.tip: 住院：英式in hospital，美式in the hospital。

senses.en: a trained professional who diagnoses and treats illnesses
a person who has earned the highest university degree
to change something dishonestly to deceive people

examples.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
examples.zh: 我描述症狀時，醫生認真地聽著。

examples.en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
examples.zh: 政府應培養更多醫生，確保農村社群能夠穩定獲得醫療服務。

words.tip: 看醫生常說see a doctor；動詞doctor可指篡改。

senses.en: To want something, especially something unlikely or not currently true.
A strong desire for something to happen or be true.
To express hope for someone's happiness or success.

examples.en: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
examples.zh: 要是我們的公寓有個更大的廚房就好了。

examples.en: Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
examples.zh: 許多居民希望社群有更多綠地，讓孩子能夠安全玩耍，讓家人能夠放鬆休息。

words.tip: wish後用過去式表現在的遺憾；過去完成式表過去的遺憾。

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.
The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business.
A planned activity involving several people working together.

examples.en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
examples.zh: 我姑姑膝蓋手術後恢復得很好。

examples.en: The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.
examples.zh: 公共交通系統的成功運作有賴於可靠的資金支援和周密的長期規劃。

words.tip: 手術部位用on連線：an operation on the knee。

senses.en: Worried about someone or something.
Involved in or affected by a particular matter.
Interested in or dealing with a particular subject.

examples.en: I was concerned when you missed the last bus.
examples.zh: 你沒趕上末班公交車時，我很擔心。

examples.en: Residents are increasingly concerned about air pollution and want local authorities to improve public transport.
examples.zh: 居民越來越擔心空氣汙染，希望地方政府改善公共交通。

collocations.en: as far as I am concerned

words.tip: about常接擔憂物件；with常接涉及的主題。

senses.en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness.
An examination to check a person's health.

examples.en: The hotel called for medical help when a guest fainted.
examples.zh: 一位客人暈倒後，酒店呼叫了醫療救助。

examples.en: Governments should improve access to medical services in rural areas where hospitals are often far away.
examples.zh: 政府應改善農村地區的醫療服務可及性，因為那裡的醫院往往距離很遠。

words.tip: medical作名詞多用於英式英語，指體檢，不指醫生。

senses.en: the possibility that something harmful or unpleasant will happen
do something despite the possibility of harm or loss

examples.en: Wear sturdy shoes to reduce the risk of slipping.
examples.zh: 穿結實的鞋子可以降低滑倒的風險。

examples.en: Governments should assess the risk of flooding before approving new housing developments near rivers.
examples.zh: 政府在批准河流附近的新住宅開發專案之前，應評估洪水風險。

words.tip: risk後接名詞或動名詞，不接to do。

senses.en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body
family relationships or origins

examples.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
examples.zh: 護士從我的手臂抽了一些血。

examples.en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 經常進行體育活動可以降低血壓，並減少患心臟病的風險。

words.tip: blood通常不可數；一次驗血用a blood test。

senses.en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury
the way someone behaves towards a person or group
a process that cleans, protects, or changes a substance

examples.en: After treatment, her injured ankle felt much better.
examples.zh: 經過治療，她受傷的腳踝感覺好多了。

examples.en: Access to affordable medical treatment is essential for reducing health inequalities between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
examples.zh: 獲得負擔得起的醫療服務，對於縮小富裕社群與弱勢社群之間的健康差距至關重要。

words.tip: 泛指治療通常不可數；指具體療法時可用a treatment。

senses.en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants

examples.en: The vet checked our rabbit for signs of disease.
examples.zh: 獸醫檢查了我們的兔子，看是否有患病跡象。

examples.en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
examples.zh: 獲得清潔飲用水可以顯著減少傳染病在脆弱社群中的傳播。

words.tip: 重音在第二音節；泛指疾病可不加冠詞。

senses.en: An emotional state or response to something
A physical sensation or the ability to sense touch
An impression or belief not necessarily supported by evidence

examples.en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
examples.zh: 考試結束後，我頓時感到如釋重負。

examples.en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
examples.zh: 強烈的歸屬感可以增強學生的自信，並鼓勵他們參與學校活動。

words.tip: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直覺。

senses.en: Relating to the body rather than the mind.
Existing as something real that can be touched or measured.
Relating to natural forces, matter, and energy.

examples.en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
examples.zh: 每個週末做園藝活都讓我得到充分的身體鍛鍊。

examples.en: Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.
examples.zh: 規律的體育活動能夠改善公眾健康，並減輕國家醫療體系的財政壓力。

words.tip: physical偏身體或物質；physiological指生理的。

senses.en: Biological classification based on reproductive and other physical characteristics.
Physical activity involving sexual intimacy.
To identify the biological sex of an animal.

examples.en: The vet checked the sex of our new kitten.
examples.zh: 獸醫檢查了我們新養的小貓的性別。

examples.en: Researchers examined whether biological sex influenced participants' responses to the treatment in the clinical study.
examples.zh: 研究人員在臨床研究中考察了生理性別是否影響參與者對治療的反應。

words.tip: sex偏重生理性別；gender常側重社會性別。

senses.en: To experience physical pain or mental distress.
To experience something harmful or become worse.

examples.en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
examples.zh: 我不吃午飯時就會頭痛。

examples.en: Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
examples.zh: 大型道路施工導致顧客無法到店時，小企業往往會遭受經濟損失。

words.tip: 疾病常用suffer from；損失、損壞常直接接在suffer後。

senses.en: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness.
The sound or act of expressing amusement.

examples.en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
examples.zh: 寶寶滑稽的舞蹈讓吃晚飯的每個人都笑了。

examples.en: People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
examples.zh: 經常一起歡笑的人可能建立更牢固的社會聯絡，並更好地應對日常壓力。

words.tip: laugh at人常指嘲笑；laugh with人指一起笑。

senses.en: feeling regret about something you did or something that happened
feeling sadness or sympathy because of someone's difficulties

examples.en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁灑在了你的乾淨襯衫上。

examples.en: Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
examples.zh: 儘管企業可能對環境破壞表示歉意，但恢復公眾信任需要切實行動。

words.tip: sorry for doing表示為所做之事道歉。

senses.en: To raise the corners of your mouth, showing happiness or friendliness.
A facial expression with raised mouth corners, often showing happiness.

examples.en: The baby smiled when I waved across the room.
examples.zh: 我在房間另一頭揮手時，寶寶笑了。

examples.en: A friendly smile can help patients feel more comfortable when discussing their concerns with healthcare professionals.
examples.zh: 友善的微笑能讓患者在與醫護人員討論自己的顧慮時感到更自在。

words.tip: 對某人微笑用smile at，不用smile to。

senses.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress
to cause someone emotional suffering

examples.en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
examples.zh: 我的左腳踝感到一陣劇痛。

examples.en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
examples.zh: 經常鍛鍊可能減輕長時間久坐的辦公室職員的背痛。

words.tip: 泛指疼痛常不可數；具體一陣疼痛可用a pain。

senses.en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.

examples.en: This tight lid will prevent the soup from spilling.
examples.zh: 這個嚴實的蓋子能防止湯灑出來。

examples.en: Investing in early health education can help prevent chronic diseases and reduce future pressure on public healthcare services.
examples.zh: 投資早期健康教育有助於預防慢性病，並減輕公共醫療服務未來的壓力。

words.tip: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。

senses.en: How heavy someone or something is.
A heavy object used for exercise or measuring weight.
The importance or influence given to something.

examples.en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
examples.zh: 這個行李箱太重，很難提起來。

examples.en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
examples.zh: 政策制定者在設計改善公共健康的策略時，應更加重視科學證據。

words.tip: weight是名詞；weigh是動詞：How much does it weigh?

senses.en: To feel anxious, or make someone feel anxious.
An anxious feeling or something that causes it.

examples.en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
examples.zh: 貓待在外面時，我會擔心她。

examples.en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
examples.zh: 許多家長擔心，過長的螢幕使用時間可能影響孩子的睡眠和注意力。

words.tip: worry about表示擔心某事；worried描述人的狀態。

senses.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.
To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.

examples.en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
examples.zh: 她因為恐高而握住了我的手。

examples.en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
examples.zh: 對失敗的恐懼可能使學生不敢提問，在競爭激烈的學習環境中尤其如此。

words.tip: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是為某人擔憂。

senses.en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body
to accept responsibility for something difficult

examples.en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
examples.zh: 她把頭靠在父親的肩膀上。

examples.en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
examples.zh: 政府和企業必須承擔更大的責任，減少工業生產對環境的影響。

words.tip: 作動詞常接responsibility或burden，表示承擔。

senses.en: Relating to sex or physical attraction between people.
Involving reproduction through the joining of male and female cells.

examples.en: The clinic offers confidential advice about sexual health.
examples.zh: 這家診所提供保密的性健康諮詢。

examples.en: Schools can provide age-appropriate sexual health education to help young people make informed decisions.
examples.zh: 學校可以提供適齡的性健康教育，幫助年輕人作出明智決定。

words.tip: sexual指與性有關；sexy才常表示性感的。

senses.en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking
the opening of a cave or where a river meets the sea
to form words with your lips without making a sound

examples.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
examples.zh: 牙醫讓我把嘴張大一點。

examples.en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
examples.zh: 河口附近的溼地提供了寶貴的棲息地，也有助於保護沿海社群免遭洪災。

words.tip: 名詞末音為/θ/；動詞末音為/ð/。

senses.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.
The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables.
Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.

examples.en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
examples.zh: 在泳池游泳後，我覺得皮膚很乾。

examples.en: Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
examples.zh: 保護皮膚免受過度日曬，可以降低日後出現嚴重健康問題的風險。

words.tip: 指人體皮膚通常不可數；一張獸皮可數。

senses.en: Wanting to learn about or take part in something.
Likely to be affected by a situation or decision.

examples.en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
examples.zh: 我姐姐對學習種菜很感興趣。

examples.en: Students who are interested in science should have regular opportunities to conduct practical experiments.
examples.zh: 對科學感興趣的學生應該經常有機會開展實際實驗。

words.tip: 人感到有興趣用interested；後接in加名詞或動名詞。

senses.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

examples.en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
examples.zh: 為了你自身的安全，請戴上頭盔。

examples.en: Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.
examples.zh: 改善道路安全既需要更好的街道設計，也需要更嚴格地執行交通法規。

words.tip: 通常不可數；safe是形容詞，safety是名詞。

senses.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.
To cause emotional pain or damage something.
Physically injured or emotionally upset.

examples.en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
examples.zh: 我上樓梯時，腳踝還是疼。

examples.en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
examples.zh: 削減公共交通經費可能損害依賴公交出行辦理必要事務的農村社群的利益。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為 hurt；疼痛部位可作主語。

senses.en: to rest with eyes closed and awareness reduced
the natural resting state in which awareness is reduced

examples.en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
examples.zh: 我們的貓喜歡睡在溫暖的暖氣片旁邊。

examples.en: Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.
examples.zh: 規律的睡眠有助於記憶和注意力，因此對備考學生尤其重要。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為slept；入睡用fall asleep。

senses.en: Inner strength, courage, or enthusiasm
A person's soul or a being without a physical body
A strong alcoholic drink made by distillation

examples.en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
examples.zh: 即使輸了比賽，我們隊仍展現出昂揚的鬥志。

examples.en: Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
examples.zh: 社群專案能夠增強合作精神，並鼓勵居民為自己的社群感到自豪。

words.tip: 表示“情緒”或泛指“烈酒”時，常用複數spirits。

senses.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.
The ability to think clearly and understand things.

examples.en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
examples.zh: 跌倒時，頭盔有助於保護你的大腦。

examples.en: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠有助於大腦正常運作，並幫助學習者更有效地記憶資訊。

words.tip: 表示智力時常用複數brains；器官用brain。

senses.en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something.
A quality or skill that makes someone or something effective.
How strong, powerful, or resistant to damage something is.

examples.en: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
examples.zh: 我使出全身力氣才提起那個手提箱。

examples.en: Schools should help students identify their strengths rather than judge everyone solely through written examinations.
examples.zh: 學校應幫助學生髮現自己的長處，而不是僅憑筆試評判所有人。

words.tip: 表示力氣通常不可數；表示長處可數。

senses.en: the ability to see
an imagined future or the ability to plan for it
an image experienced as real but not physically present

examples.en: My new glasses have made my vision much clearer.
examples.zh: 我的新眼鏡讓我看東西清楚多了。

examples.en: Urban planners need a clear vision of how expanding cities can remain both liveable and environmentally sustainable.
examples.zh: 城市規劃者需要明確的願景，使不斷擴張的城市既宜居又能保持環境可持續性。

words.tip: 表示視力通常不可數；具體願景可用a vision。

senses.en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
a liquid for swallowing or a serving of it
to consume alcoholic beverages

examples.en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
examples.zh: 我遛完狗總會喝些水。

examples.en: Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.
examples.zh: 鼓勵兒童喝水而非含糖飲料，長遠來看可能改善他們的牙齒健康。

words.tip: 不規則變化：drink—drank—drunk。

senses.en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.
To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger.
To use a right, power, ability, or quality.

examples.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
examples.zh: 我步行去商店，順便鍛鍊一下。

examples.en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
examples.zh: 經常運動能夠改善心理健康，並降低幾種常見慢性病的患病風險。

words.tip: 泛指運動時不可數；一項練習或一套動作中的動作可數。

senses.en: ready and happy to do something
eager to help or work without needing persuasion

examples.en: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
examples.zh: 我願意這週末幫你搬家。

examples.en: Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
examples.zh: 如果價格仍可負擔且資訊清晰，消費者可能更願意購買可持續產品。

words.tip: 常用be willing to do，表示願意，不等於將要。

senses.en: The ability to see.
The act of seeing or the area that can be seen.
Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.

examples.en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
examples.zh: 她配了新眼鏡後看得更清楚了。

examples.en: Regular eye examinations can help preserve sight by detecting problems before they cause permanent damage.
examples.zh: 定期眼部檢查能在問題造成永久損傷前將其發現，從而幫助保護視力。

words.tip: 視力通常不可數；表示名勝常用複數sights。

senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

examples.en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
examples.zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。

examples.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
examples.zh: 學校應鼓勵積極運動的生活方式，以改善學生的身體健康和整體身心狀態。

words.tip: active指積極活動或參與；不等於表示樂觀的positive。

senses.en: Physical harm to someone's body, often caused by an accident

examples.en: His knee injury kept him away from football practice.
examples.zh: 他的膝傷使他無法參加足球訓練。

examples.en: Employers should provide regular safety training to reduce the risk of injury among workers operating heavy machinery.
examples.zh: 僱主應定期提供安全培訓，以降低操作重型機械的工人受傷的風險。

words.tip: 具體傷處可數；泛指身體傷害時常不可數。

senses.en: One of the organs on your head used for hearing.
The ability to recognise and distinguish sounds.
The grain-bearing part of a cereal plant, such as wheat.

examples.en: My ears felt cold, so I pulled on a hat.
examples.zh: 我的耳朵覺得冷，於是我戴上了帽子。

examples.en: Regular exposure to loud music can damage the ears and lead to permanent hearing loss.
examples.zh: 經常接觸高音量音樂可能損傷耳朵，並導致永久性聽力損失。

words.tip: have an ear for表示善於辨聽音樂、語言等。

senses.en: Belief in your abilities or in a successful outcome.
Trust that someone or something is reliable.

examples.en: Practising with friends gave me confidence before the interview.
examples.zh: 和朋友一起練習讓我在面試前有了信心。

examples.en: Supportive feedback can build students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively in classroom discussions.
examples.zh: 鼓勵性的反饋可以增強學生的自信，促使他們更積極地參與課堂討論。

words.tip: 對某人或某事有信心用confidence in。

senses.en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need.
A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.

examples.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
examples.zh: 玩具掉了，寶寶就哭了起來。

examples.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
examples.zh: 幼兒與父母分開時可能會哭，因此學校應營造親切友好的環境。

words.tip: 過去式cried；現在分詞crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

senses.en: Comfort felt when worry or fear ends
A reduction in pain or discomfort
Help given to people suffering from disaster or poverty

examples.en: I sighed with relief when my missing cat returned.
examples.zh: 走失的貓回來時，我鬆了一口氣。

examples.en: Rapid delivery of emergency relief can prevent further suffering in communities affected by severe flooding.
examples.zh: 迅速運送緊急救援物資可以避免遭受嚴重洪災的社群承受更多苦難。

words.tip: relief是名詞，relieve是動詞；疼痛緩解用pain relief。

senses.en: feeling fear or worry about something
used to introduce unwelcome information politely

examples.en: The puppy was afraid of the noisy vacuum cleaner.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗害怕吵鬧的吸塵器。

examples.en: Some employees are afraid to report workplace problems because they worry about losing their jobs.
examples.zh: 有些員工不敢反映職場問題，因為他們擔心失去工作。

words.tip: 通常作表語，不放名詞前；用afraid of或afraid to do。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

examples.en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊度過了一段美好的野餐時光。

examples.en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
examples.zh: 公共圖書館為兒童發現新興趣提供了極好的機會，又不會給家庭帶來經濟壓力。

words.tip: 表示極好或令人愉快，不等於奇怪的。

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

examples.en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
examples.zh: 他滑冰時摔斷了手腕的一塊骨頭。

examples.en: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
examples.zh: 規律的負重運動有助於保持骨骼強度，並能降低老年人骨折的風險。

words.tip: bone作動詞指去骨；boneless表示無骨的。

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

examples.en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
examples.zh: 在風中走了一陣後，我覺得嘴唇很乾。

examples.en: Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
examples.zh: 透明面罩可以幫助那些依靠觀察嘴唇來理解話語的人更順暢地交流。

words.tip: 上下嘴唇合稱lips；lip也可指容器等的邊沿。

senses.en: Likely to cause harm, injury, or serious problems.

examples.en: That broken step is dangerous, so please avoid it.
examples.zh: 那級破損的臺階很危險，請避開它。

examples.en: Poorly maintained roads can create dangerous conditions for cyclists, especially during heavy rain or after dark.
examples.zh: 維護不善的道路會給騎行者帶來危險，尤其是在大雨中或天黑後。

words.tip: dangerous是形容詞；修飾動作要用dangerously。

senses.en: physically well and not suffering from illness
helping to maintain or improve health
successful, strong, or developing in a positive way

examples.en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
examples.zh: 我們家的貓透過經常運動和定期檢查保持健康。

examples.en: Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.
examples.zh: 學校應提供健康膳食，以促進兒童身體發育，並鼓勵他們從小養成更好的飲食習慣。

words.tip: 既可形容身體健康，也可形容飲食等有益健康。

senses.en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.

examples.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
examples.zh: 藥劑師解釋了這種藥應該多久服用一次。

examples.en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
examples.zh: 醫學進步延長了預期壽命，但各地區獲得有效治療的機會仍不平等。

words.tip: 服藥用take medicine；表示醫學時不可數。

senses.en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.

examples.en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
examples.zh: 開始鍛鍊前，她輕輕彎了彎膝蓋。

examples.en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
examples.zh: 經常進行低衝擊運動可以增強膝關節周圍的肌肉，幫助老年人保持行動能力。

words.tip: 詞首k不發音；複數knees讀作/niːz/。

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
The beginning of something new.

examples.en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
examples.zh: 全家人都慶祝了我們女兒的出生。

examples.en: Access to skilled medical care during birth significantly improves health outcomes for both mothers and newborn babies.
examples.zh: 分娩時獲得專業醫療護理能顯著改善母親和新生兒的健康狀況。

words.tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

senses.en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders
a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle

examples.en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
examples.zh: 他在脖子上圍了一條暖和的圍巾。

examples.en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
examples.zh: 如果電腦螢幕的高度不合適，辦公室職員可能會感到頸部疼痛。

words.tip: neck指脖子；throat指喉嚨，勿混用。

senses.en: To dislike someone or something very strongly.
A very strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.

examples.en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
examples.zh: 我特別討厭在浴室地板上發現溼襪子。

examples.en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
examples.zh: 雖然許多通勤者討厭擁擠的列車，但價格實惠的公共交通對於緩解城市交通擁堵仍然至關重要。

words.tip: hate後可接動名詞或不定式，語氣比dislike強。

senses.en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time.
The act of choosing someone for a job or position.

examples.en: I have a dental appointment early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我預約了明天一早看牙醫。

examples.en: Flexible working hours allow employees to attend medical appointments without taking an entire day off.
examples.zh: 彈性工作時間讓員工無需請一整天假就能按預約就醫。

words.tip: 與某人預約用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food
to add salt to food or preserve it with salt

examples.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
examples.zh: 趁湯還沒涼，請把鹽遞過來。

examples.en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
examples.zh: 減少鹽的攝入量是降低高血壓風險的有效方法。

words.tip: 食鹽通常不可數；“一小撮鹽”用a pinch of salt。

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

examples.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
examples.zh: 讓湯涼下來，再撇去油脂。

examples.en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
examples.zh: 雖然人體需要一定的脂肪，但攝入過多會增加某些健康問題的風險。

words.tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；談健康宜用overweight。

senses.en: Relating to the mind and emotional wellbeing.

senses.zh: 腦力的；在頭腦中進行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

examples.en: A quiet walk helps me protect my mental health.
examples.zh: 安靜地散步有助於我保持心理健康。

examples.en: Employers should give mental wellbeing the same priority as physical safety when designing workplace policies.
examples.zh: 僱主制定職場政策時，應將心理健康與人身安全放在同等重要的位置。

words.tip: mental側重心理或腦力；口語中形容人瘋狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: A sweet substance used to make food and drinks sweeter

examples.en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
examples.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，攪拌均勻。

examples.en: Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
examples.zh: 減少糖的攝入有助於預防與不健康飲食有關的健康問題。

words.tip: 泛指食糖時通常不可數；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

senses.en: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment
An activity or experience that brings enjoyment

examples.en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
examples.zh: 她在陽臺上種香草，從中獲得很大的樂趣。

examples.en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
examples.zh: 公共圖書館鼓勵以閱讀為樂，同時讓各年齡段的人都能以低廉的成本獲取知識。

words.tip: 快樂通常不可數；一件樂事可說a pleasure。

senses.en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs.
Showing or experiencing strong feelings.

examples.en: Her friends gave her emotional support during the move.
examples.zh: 搬家期間，她的朋友們在情感上給予了她支援。

examples.en: Schools should support children's emotional development alongside academic progress to promote their long-term well-being.
examples.zh: 學校應在促進學業進步的同時支援兒童的情感發展，以增進他們的長期福祉。

words.tip: emotional不一定指悲傷，也可指喜悅等強烈情緒。

senses.en: An unexpected event, or the feeling it causes.
To make someone feel amazed by something unexpected.

examples.en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
examples.zh: 在廚房裡發現一個生日蛋糕，真是個美好的驚喜。

examples.en: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
examples.zh: 調查結果可能讓那些認為年輕人偏愛線上學習的政策制定者感到意外。

words.tip: 人感到驚訝用surprised；事物令人驚訝用surprising。

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

examples.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
examples.zh: 她撥出的氣在冷空氣中形成了一團白霧。

examples.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
examples.zh: 緩慢地深呼吸一次，有助於學生緩解重要考試前的焦慮。

words.tip: breath是名詞；breathe是動詞，末尾讀/ð/。

senses.en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people.
To care for someone who is ill or injured.

examples.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
examples.zh: 護士輕輕地用繃帶包住我的手腕。

examples.en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
examples.zh: 增聘社群護士可以改善農村老年人獲得醫療服務的機會。

words.tip: 作動詞可直接接人：nurse a patient。

senses.en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food.
The useful results of work or effort.
To produce fruit.

examples.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
examples.zh: 她在我的午餐盒裡放了新鮮水果。

examples.en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
examples.zh: 讓新鮮水果價格更親民，可以鼓勵低收入家庭養成更健康的飲食習慣。

words.tip: 泛指水果通常不可數；fruits可指種類或成果。

senses.en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant

examples.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
examples.zh: 有人弄壞了他的腳踏車，他感到很生氣。

examples.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 市政委員會決定關閉社群唯一的圖書館，居民們對此感到憤怒。

words.tip: 生某人的氣用angry with；因某事生氣用about。

senses.en: The ability to notice sounds through your ears.
An official meeting to consider evidence or arguments.

examples.en: My grandfather's hearing improved after he received a hearing aid.
examples.zh: 祖父配了助聽器後，聽得更清楚了。

examples.en: A public hearing allows residents to express concerns before major construction projects receive official approval.
examples.zh: 公開聽證會讓居民能在大型建設專案獲得正式批准前表達關切。

words.tip: 指聽力時不可數；指聽證會時可數。

senses.en: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement
power or influence used to achieve something

examples.en: I pulled a muscle while lifting a heavy box.
examples.zh: 我搬一個重箱子時拉傷了肌肉。

examples.en: Regular strength training builds muscle and helps older adults maintain balance and independence in daily life.
examples.zh: 規律的力量訓練能增強肌肉，幫助老年人在日常生活中保持平衡和獨立。

words.tip: muscle中的c不發音；pull a muscle指拉傷肌肉。

senses.en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs.
A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.

examples.en: She held the sleeping kitten gently against her chest.
examples.zh: 她把熟睡的小貓輕輕抱在胸前。

examples.en: Workers exposed to polluted air may develop chest problems, highlighting the importance of effective workplace ventilation.
examples.zh: 接觸汙染空氣的工人可能出現胸部疾病，這凸顯了工作場所有效通風的重要性。

words.tip: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屜櫃。

senses.en: Really or genuinely, rather than only apparently
With sincere feelings or intentions

examples.en: This is the first place I've felt truly comfortable.
examples.zh: 這是第一個讓我感到真正自在的地方。

examples.en: A truly inclusive education system must address the needs of students from different social backgrounds.
examples.zh: 真正包容的教育體系必須滿足不同社會背景學生的需求。

words.tip: true變truly時去掉e，不能寫成truely。

senses.en: Mental strain caused by difficult situations or too many demands
To give particular importance to something when speaking or writing
Extra force used when pronouncing a syllable or word

examples.en: A short walk helps me deal with work stress.
examples.zh: 散一小會兒步有助於我緩解工作壓力。

examples.en: Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.
examples.zh: 學校應教給學生實用的方法，幫助他們應對考試及其他緊張時期的壓力。

words.tip: 人感到壓力用stressed；事情令人緊張用stressful。

senses.en: The part of your face used for smelling and breathing.
The front part of an aircraft or similar vehicle.

examples.en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 我的鼻子在冷風中凍紅了。

examples.en: Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.
examples.zh: 戴口罩遮住口鼻可以減少吸入空氣中的灰塵。

words.tip: 擤鼻涕用blow your nose，不用clean。

senses.en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell.
Feeling that you might vomit.
Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.

examples.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上覺得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

examples.en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
examples.zh: 帶薪病假讓員工能在家康復，並減少感染在工作場所傳播。

words.tip: 英式英語中be sick常指嘔吐，feel sick常指噁心。

senses.en: a hard structure in the mouth used for biting and chewing
a pointed part of a tool, comb or wheel

examples.en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
examples.zh: 牙醫用一面小鏡子檢查了每顆牙齒。

examples.en: Regular dental checkups can help prevent tooth decay and reduce the need for expensive treatment.
examples.zh: 定期牙科檢查有助於預防蛀牙，減少接受昂貴治療的需要。

words.tip: 複數是不規則形式teeth，注意母音也變化。

senses.en: To manage a difficult situation successfully.

examples.en: I cope with busy mornings by preparing breakfast ahead.
examples.zh: 我會提前準備早餐，來應付忙碌的早晨。

examples.en: Schools should teach practical strategies that help students cope with examination stress and maintain their mental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 學校應教授實用方法，幫助學生應對考試壓力並保持心理健康。

words.tip: cope是不及物動詞，接困難或壓力時用with。

senses.en: making you laugh or smile
unusual or difficult to explain

examples.en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
examples.zh: 那個好笑的故事逗得桌邊的人都笑了。

examples.en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
examples.zh: 教師有時會用有趣的例子，讓複雜概念更容易記住，並鼓勵學生參與。

words.tip: funny側重好笑或奇怪；fun側重令人愉快、有趣。

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body to repair damage.
A place where a doctor or dentist sees patients.

examples.en: My uncle is recovering well after knee surgery.
examples.zh: 我叔叔做完膝關節手術後恢復得很好。

examples.en: Advances in medical technology have made many types of surgery safer and reduced patients' recovery times.
examples.zh: 醫療技術的進步提高了多種手術的安全性，並縮短了患者的康復時間。

words.tip: 手術義通常不可數；英式英語中診所義可數。

senses.en: very unreasonable, foolish, or strange
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something
extremely annoyed or upset

examples.en: It seems crazy to wear sandals in this snow.
examples.zh: 下著這樣的雪還穿涼鞋，實在很不明智。

examples.en: Although some people consider car-free cities a crazy idea, such policies could significantly improve urban air quality.
examples.zh: 儘管一些人認為無車城市是個荒唐的想法，這類政策卻可能顯著改善城市空氣質量。

words.tip: 偏口語；crazy about表示著迷，不宜用來稱呼精神疾病患者。

senses.zh: 至關重要的；必不可少的
senses.en: extremely important or necessary
necessary for keeping a living body alive

examples.en: A warm coat is vital on these freezing mornings.
examples.zh: 在這樣寒冷的早晨，一件暖和的外套必不可少。

examples.en: Reliable public transport plays a vital role in reducing urban congestion and improving access to employment.
examples.zh: 可靠的公共交通對緩解城市擁堵和改善就業機會的可及性起著至關重要的作用。

words.tip: 常用be vital for/to，表示對……至關重要。

senses.en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty
get back something lost, stolen, or spent

examples.en: It took several days to recover from the flu.
examples.zh: 流感過後，花了好幾天才康復。

examples.en: Local economies often recover more quickly when governments provide timely support for small businesses.
examples.zh: 政府及時為小企業提供支援時，當地經濟往往恢復得更快。

words.tip: 從疾病或挫折中恢復用recover from。

senses.en: feeling happy or satisfied about something

examples.en: I'm really pleased with how the cake turned out.
examples.zh: 我對這個蛋糕做出來的效果非常滿意。

examples.en: Residents were pleased that the council had created more green spaces for children to play safely.
examples.zh: 居民們很高興，市政部門增設了更多綠地，讓孩子們可以安全地玩耍。

words.tip: 對結果滿意用pleased with；聽到喜訊用pleased to hear。

senses.en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

examples.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
examples.zh: 發現門外放著鮮花，我很驚訝。

examples.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
examples.zh: 綠地的可及性對居民自報幸福感的影響如此之大，令研究人員感到驚訝。

words.tip: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人驚訝。

senses.en: a plant or plant part eaten as food

examples.en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
examples.zh: 我們今天早上在市場買了新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 學校可以在午餐時供應更多種類的蔬菜，鼓勵更健康的飲食。

words.tip: 通常為可數名詞；泛指多種蔬菜用vegetables。

senses.en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell.
In a bad or unkind way.

examples.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
examples.zh: 長途乘車後，我感到身體不適。

examples.en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
examples.zh: 應鼓勵生病的員工休息，而不是立即返崗。

words.tip: 表示生病時通常作表語：be ill。

senses.en: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort
annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats

examples.en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
examples.zh: 散步後我累得不想做飯。

examples.en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
examples.zh: 經常長時間工作的員工可能會疲憊不堪，無法安全地履行職責。

words.tip: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

senses.en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes.
A planned way of eating for health or weight control.
To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.

examples.en: My usual diet includes plenty of rice and vegetables.
examples.zh: 我的日常飲食中有大量米飯和蔬菜。

examples.en: A balanced diet can improve concentration and help students maintain their energy throughout the school day.
examples.zh: 均衡飲食能提高注意力，並幫助學生在整個上學期間保持精力。

words.tip: diet不一定指節食，也可指日常飲食。

senses.en: With great force, intensity, or conviction.

examples.en: I strongly recommend taking a jacket on this walk.
examples.zh: 我強烈建議這次散步帶上一件夾克。

examples.en: Many residents strongly oppose the proposed airport expansion because they fear increased noise and air pollution.
examples.zh: 許多居民強烈反對擬議中的機場擴建，因為他們擔心噪聲和空氣汙染加劇。

words.tip: 常修飾recommend、oppose、believe，強調態度。

senses.en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about.
Believing you are better or more important than others.

examples.en: He felt proud of the cake he baked himself.
examples.zh: 他為自己親手烤出的蛋糕感到自豪。

examples.en: Residents are often proud of their cultural heritage and support efforts to preserve historic buildings.
examples.zh: 居民往往為自己的文化遺產感到自豪，並支援保護歷史建築的行動。

words.tip: be proud of後接名詞或動名詞，表示為……自豪。

senses.en: lacking physical strength or energy
not effective, convincing, or well supported
having little intensity, flavour, or power

examples.en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
examples.zh: 我覺得渾身無力，沒法把買來的東西提上樓。

examples.en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
examples.zh: 依據薄弱證據制定的政策可能無法解決失業的根本原因。

words.tip: weak與week同音；weakness可指弱點，也可指虛弱。

senses.en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected
to make someone feel very surprised or upset
a dangerous medical collapse, or an electrical jolt through the body

examples.en: The sudden rise in rent came as a shock.
examples.zh: 租金突然上漲，讓人十分震驚。

examples.en: Moving abroad can cause culture shock, particularly when everyday customs differ greatly from those at home.
examples.zh: 移居國外可能帶來文化衝擊，尤其是當日常習俗與本國差異很大時。

words.tip: 人感到震驚用shocked；事物令人震驚用shocking。

senses.en: A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.

examples.en: The physician listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
examples.zh: 我描述症狀時，醫生認真地聽著。

examples.en: Access to a qualified physician remains limited in remote areas, contributing to significant inequalities in healthcare.
examples.zh: 偏遠地區獲得合格醫生診治的機會仍然有限，這加劇了醫療服務方面的顯著不平等。

words.tip: 美式常泛指醫生；英式常指內科醫生。

senses.en: a condition involving persistent sadness and loss of interest
a long period of severely reduced economic activity
an area lower than the surface around it

examples.en: Her doctor recommended regular counselling to help manage depression.
examples.zh: 她的醫生建議定期接受心理諮詢，以幫助緩解抑鬱症。

examples.en: Improving access to mental health services can help people with depression receive timely support and appropriate treatment.
examples.zh: 改善心理健康服務的可及性，可以幫助抑鬱症患者及時獲得支援和適當治療。

words.tip: 抑鬱症不等於短暫心情低落；經濟蕭條常用a depression。

senses.en: Connected with inner feelings and meaning rather than material things.
Related to religious beliefs or experiences.

examples.en: Walking quietly in the forest gives me spiritual comfort.
examples.zh: 在森林裡靜靜散步能給我心靈上的慰藉。

examples.en: Public spaces can support spiritual well-being by offering residents peaceful places for reflection and connection with nature.
examples.zh: 公共空間可以為居民提供安靜思考和親近自然的場所，從而促進精神健康。

words.tip: 可指心靈層面，不一定涉及宗教。

senses.en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.

examples.en: He refused a cigarette and went for a walk instead.
examples.zh: 他拒絕了遞來的香菸，轉而出去散步。

examples.en: Higher cigarette taxes may discourage smoking, but accessible support services are also essential for people trying to quit.
examples.zh: 提高香菸稅可能有助於減少吸菸，但對嘗試戒菸的人來說，便捷的支援服務也必不可少。

words.tip: 可數名詞；一包香菸可說a packet of cigarettes。

senses.en: a strong feeling such as joy, fear, or sadness

examples.en: Her voice shook with emotion when she saw her brother.
examples.zh: 見到哥哥時，她激動得聲音都顫抖了。

examples.en: Teaching children to recognise and manage emotion can improve their relationships and support long-term mental health.
examples.zh: 教孩子識別和管理情緒，可以改善他們的人際關係，並促進長期心理健康。

words.tip: 泛指情感時可不可數；具體的各種情緒常用emotions。

senses.en: To give a loud, high cry from strong emotion.
A loud, high cry expressing fear, pain, or excitement.

examples.en: The children screamed with excitement as the ride began.
examples.zh: 遊樂設施一啟動，孩子們就興奮地尖叫起來。

examples.en: Residents complain that visitors scream late at night, disturbing sleep and reducing the neighbourhood's quality of life.
examples.zh: 居民抱怨遊客深夜尖叫，擾人睡眠，降低了社群的生活質量。

words.tip: scream強調聲音尖厲；shout只強調喊得響。

senses.en: Very much, especially in relation to feelings or beliefs
Far into something or a long way below the surface

examples.en: I was deeply touched by your thoughtful gift.
examples.zh: 你貼心的禮物讓我深受感動。

examples.en: Many residents are deeply concerned about the effects of air pollution on their children's health.
examples.zh: 許多居民非常擔憂空氣汙染對孩子健康的影響。

words.tip: 表示程度時常修飾情感詞，如 deeply worried。

senses.en: Having good things happen by chance.
Believed to bring good fortune.

examples.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
examples.zh: 我們很幸運，趕上了回家的末班公交車。

examples.en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
examples.zh: 雖然一些創業者受益於偶然的機遇，但企業的長期成功通常需要周密規劃和持續努力。

words.tip: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。

senses.en: Treatment intended to improve physical or mental health.

examples.en: After her injury, regular therapy helped her walk comfortably again.
examples.zh: 受傷後，定期治療幫助她重新自如地行走。

examples.en: Schools that provide access to psychological therapy may better support students experiencing persistent anxiety.
examples.zh: 提供心理治療服務的學校可能更好地支援長期感到焦慮的學生。

words.tip: 泛指治療通常不可數；具體療法可用複數。

senses.en: loved or valued very much
costing a lot of money
used to express surprise, worry, or disappointment

examples.en: This little garden is very dear to my grandmother.
examples.zh: 祖母十分珍愛這座小花園。

examples.en: Places that are dear to local residents deserve consideration when urban redevelopment plans are prepared.
examples.zh: 制定城市改造計劃時，應顧及當地居民珍愛的場所。

words.tip: dear表“貴”主要用於英式口語；稱呼常用Dear。

senses.en: Feeling happy or pleased about something.
Willing and pleased to do something.

examples.en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
examples.zh: 我很高興你今晚來和我們一起吃飯。

examples.en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
examples.zh: 許多居民都很高興，地方議會決定保留當地的公園。

words.tip: 常作表語；用be glad to do或be glad that從句。

senses.en: drinks containing a substance that can make people drunk
a colourless liquid used in drinks, cleaning products, and fuels

examples.en: This restaurant serves fresh juice but does not sell alcohol.
examples.zh: 這家餐館供應鮮榨果汁，但不賣酒。

examples.en: Public health campaigns should explain how excessive alcohol consumption can damage both physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 公共衛生宣傳應解釋過量飲酒如何損害身心健康。

words.tip: 泛指酒或酒精時通常不可數；a drink可指一杯酒。

senses.en: A nutrient needed for growth and repair of body tissues.

examples.en: These beans add protein to our vegetable soup.
examples.zh: 這些豆子為我們的蔬菜湯增添了蛋白質。

examples.en: A balanced plant-based diet can provide sufficient protein when it includes varied sources such as beans and nuts.
examples.zh: 均衡的植物性飲食如果包含豆類和堅果等多樣化來源，就能提供充足的蛋白質。

words.tip: 作營養物質通常不可數；指不同種類時可數。

senses.en: a physical or mental change that suggests an illness
a sign that an underlying problem exists

examples.en: A sore throat was her first symptom of illness.
examples.zh: 喉嚨痛是她生病後出現的第一個症狀。

examples.en: High staff turnover can be a symptom of poor management rather than a shortage of skilled workers.
examples.zh: 員工流動率高可能反映管理不善，而非技術工人短缺。

words.tip: 常用a symptom of；症狀緩解用relieve symptoms。

senses.en: A return to health or a normal condition.
The process of getting something lost or stolen back.

examples.en: Her recovery was slow, but she could walk again.
examples.zh: 她康復得很慢，但已經能重新走路了。

examples.en: Economic recovery depends partly on restoring consumer confidence and supporting small businesses through difficult periods.
examples.zh: 經濟復甦部分取決於恢復消費者信心，以及幫助小企業渡過困難時期。

words.tip: 康復常用make a recovery；recover是動詞。

senses.en: take air into your lungs and let it out

examples.en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
examples.zh: 坐在窗邊，緩緩呼吸一分鐘。

examples.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
examples.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人經常吸入受汙染的空氣，這可能增加他們患呼吸系統疾病的風險。

words.tip: breathe是動詞，末音/ð/；breath是名詞，末音/θ/。

senses.en: The act of intentionally causing one's own death.

examples.en: Our local centre offers free workshops on suicide prevention.
examples.zh: 我們當地的中心提供免費的自殺預防講習班。

examples.en: Suicide prevention requires accessible mental health services, supportive communities, and responsible reporting in the media.
examples.zh: 自殺預防需要便捷可及的心理健康服務、相互支援的社群以及負責任的媒體報道。

words.tip: 中性表達常用die by suicide，避免汙名化。

senses.en: very interested in something or eager to do it
quick to notice or understand things
very strong or intense

examples.en: Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
examples.zh: 萊拉很想加入我們的週末徒步小組。

examples.en: Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
examples.zh: 熱愛科學的學生能從將理論與日常經驗相結合的實踐實驗中受益。

words.tip: keen on後接名詞或動名詞；keen to後接動詞原形。

senses.en: a very strong enthusiasm for an activity or subject
a powerful feeling, especially love or anger

examples.en: Her passion for baking fills our kitchen with delicious smells.
examples.zh: 她對烘焙的熱愛讓我們的廚房總是香氣四溢。

examples.en: Teachers who share their passion for science can inspire students to pursue careers in research.
examples.zh: 教師分享自己對科學的熱愛，能夠激勵學生投身科研事業。

words.tip: 表達對某事的熱愛，用a passion for。

senses.en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen

examples.en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
examples.zh: 貓沒有回來時，她顯得很擔心。

examples.en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
examples.zh: 許多家長擔心過長的螢幕使用時間會影響孩子的睡眠。

words.tip: worried形容人擔憂；worrying形容事物令人擔憂。

senses.en: a disease, or the state of being unwell

examples.en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
examples.zh: 她突然生病，沒能參加我們的野餐。

examples.en: Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.
examples.zh: 及早獲得醫療服務可以防止小病發展為嚴重的健康問題。

words.tip: 泛指生病時不可數；指具體疾病時可數。

senses.en: Causing great surprise or admiration.

examples.en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
examples.zh: 從山上望去的景色真是令人驚歎。

examples.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
examples.zh: 近期醫學研究取得了驚人的成果，為患有過去無法治療的疾病的患者帶來了新希望。

words.tip: amazing形容令人驚歎的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: very strong or extreme in degree
showing very strong feelings or serious concentration

examples.en: The intense heat made us search for shade.
examples.zh: 酷熱讓我們四處尋找陰涼處。

examples.en: Intense competition for university places can place considerable psychological pressure on students during their final school year.
examples.zh: 大學入學名額的激烈競爭，可能給畢業年級學生帶來相當大的心理壓力。

words.tip: intense 強調程度強烈；intensive 強調密集投入。

senses.en: the way someone feels at a particular time
the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates

examples.en: A short walk usually puts me in a better mood.
examples.zh: 散一小會兒步通常就能讓我的心情好一些。

examples.en: Access to green spaces can improve residents' mood and encourage more positive interactions within urban communities.
examples.zh: 能夠享用綠地可以改善居民心情，促進城市社群內更積極的互動。

words.tip: in the mood for後接名詞；接動詞用to do。

senses.en: a strong feeling of displeasure about something wrong or unfair
to make someone feel angry

examples.en: He took a deep breath to control his anger.
examples.zh: 他深吸了一口氣來控制自己的怒氣。

examples.en: Public anger over rising transport costs can encourage local authorities to reconsider their pricing policies.
examples.zh: 公眾對交通費用上漲的憤怒，可能促使地方政府重新考慮定價政策。

words.tip: anger作名詞通常不可數；形容詞是angry。

senses.en: a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning
a state in which things are not properly arranged
uncontrolled public behaviour that disturbs peace or safety

examples.en: A sleep disorder kept him awake most nights.
examples.zh: 睡眠障礙讓他大多數夜晚都無法入睡。

examples.en: Early treatment of anxiety disorders can improve students' wellbeing and help them participate more fully in education.
examples.zh: 儘早治療焦慮障礙能改善學生的身心狀態，幫助他們更充分地參與學習。

words.tip: 疾病義可數；雜亂或騷亂義通常不可數。

senses.en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.

examples.en: The clinic near our house opens early on weekdays.
examples.zh: 我們家附近的診所工作日很早就開門。

examples.en: Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.
examples.zh: 當地診所可以透過治療常見病和提供預防性保健來減輕醫院的壓力。

words.tip: clinic指診所或門診部；“臨床的”用clinical。

senses.en: worried or uneasy about what might happen
relating to the nerves in the body

examples.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天第一次上游泳課前，我感到很緊張。

examples.en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
examples.zh: 對考試感到緊張的學生可以從定期練習和教師的鼓勵性反饋中獲益。

words.tip: nervous about後接名詞或動名詞，表示對某事緊張。

senses.en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns
to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco
to produce smoke

examples.en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡的吐司冒出了黑煙。

examples.en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
examples.zh: 森林火災產生的煙霧會降低數百公里外城市的空氣質量。

words.tip: smoke作“煙霧”通常不可數；smoky意為煙霧瀰漫的。

senses.zh: 令人驚訝的；出乎意料的
senses.en: unexpected and causing a feeling of surprise

examples.en: The tiny bakery offers a surprising variety of fresh bread.
examples.zh: 這家小麵包店的新鮮麵包種類多得令人驚訝。

examples.en: The survey revealed a surprising decline in car ownership among young adults living in major cities.
examples.zh: 調查顯示，大城市年輕人的汽車擁有率出現了出人意料的下降。

words.tip: surprising形容事物；surprised形容人的感受。

senses.en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass

examples.en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
examples.zh: 說了一下午話後，我覺得喉嚨很乾。

examples.en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
examples.zh: 空氣質量差會刺激咽喉並加重呼吸問題，兒童和老年人尤其容易受到影響。

words.tip: 喉嚨痛用have a sore throat，注意冠詞a。

senses.en: Worry or nervousness about something uncertain or threatening.

examples.en: Her anxiety faded when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好訊息後，她的焦慮消退了。

examples.en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
examples.zh: 經常鍛鍊可以減輕學生面對高難度考試和不確定就業前景時的焦慮。

words.tip: anxiety about後接擔憂的事情；形容詞是anxious。

senses.en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area
To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted

examples.en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 我做晚飯時，肚子開始咕咕叫。

examples.en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
examples.zh: 規律進餐可能有助於預防胃部不適，並幫助學生養成健康的飲食習慣。

words.tip: 表示“忍受”時，常用於 can't stomach 結構。

senses.en: a condition caused by harmful organisms entering the body

examples.en: The doctor checked my sore throat for signs of infection.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了我疼痛的喉嚨，看是否有感染跡象。

examples.en: Improved sanitation can reduce the risk of infection, particularly in communities with limited access to clean water.
examples.zh: 改善衛生條件可以降低感染風險，尤其是在難以獲得潔淨水的社群。

words.tip: infection既可指感染過程，也可指一次具體感染。

senses.en: To become calm and comfortable, or make someone feel this way.
To make muscles less tight, or become less tight.
To make rules or restrictions less strict.

examples.en: I like to relax with music after dinner.
examples.zh: 我喜歡晚飯後聽音樂放鬆。

examples.en: Regular access to green spaces helps urban residents relax and may improve their overall mental health.
examples.zh: 經常接觸綠地有助於城市居民放鬆，也可能改善他們的整體心理健康。

words.tip: 人感到放鬆用relaxed；事物令人放鬆用relaxing。

senses.en: Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.

examples.en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
examples.zh: 比賽最後幾分鐘精彩刺激極了。

examples.en: Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.
examples.zh: 可再生能源的進步為希望應對全球環境挑戰的年輕工程師提供了令人振奮的機會。

words.tip: exciting形容令人興奮的事物；excited形容人的感受。

senses.en: very angry
behaving or thinking in an unreasonable or foolish way
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something

examples.en: Dad was mad because I broke his favourite cup.
examples.zh: 爸爸很生氣，因為我打碎了他最喜歡的杯子。

examples.en: Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.
examples.zh: 雖然一些居民熱衷足球，但公共體育資金應支援更廣泛的活動。

words.tip: mad at表示生氣；mad about可表示痴迷。

senses.en: believing in your own ability to succeed
certain that something is true or will happen

examples.en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
examples.zh: 經過幾周練習，我站在臺上時感到很自信。

examples.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
examples.zh: 當教師提供建設性反饋和練習新技能的機會時，學生會變得更自信。

words.tip: confident是形容詞；confidence是名詞。

senses.en: having a baby developing inside the body

examples.en: My cousin is pregnant and expects her baby in June.
examples.zh: 我表姐懷孕了，預產期在六月。

examples.en: Accessible healthcare helps pregnant women receive regular check-ups and reliable advice throughout their pregnancy.
examples.zh: 便捷可及的醫療服務有助於孕婦在整個孕期獲得定期檢查和可靠的建議。

words.tip: 表示懷孕多久可說six months pregnant。

senses.en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain.
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

examples.en: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
examples.zh: 等待考試成績時，我感到很焦慮。

examples.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
examples.zh: 學校不提供職業指導時，學生可能會對未來感到焦慮。

words.tip: anxious about表擔憂；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations.
Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.

examples.en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
examples.zh: 我對這雙鞋很滿意，穿著特別合腳。

examples.en: Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.
examples.zh: 對工作條件感到滿意的員工更有可能留在同一家機構。

words.tip: 人感到滿意用satisfied；事物令人滿意用satisfying。

senses.en: Strong interest and excitement about something you enjoy or value.

examples.en: The children showed real enthusiasm for planting their own vegetables.
examples.zh: 孩子們對親手種菜表現出了真切的熱情。

examples.en: Teachers who demonstrate enthusiasm for their subjects can motivate students to explore ideas beyond the classroom.
examples.zh: 教師對所教學科展現熱情，能夠激勵學生在課堂之外探索新想法。

words.tip: 對某事的熱情用enthusiasm for，通常不可數。

senses.en: Pleasure felt when needs, wishes, or expectations are fulfilled.
The act of meeting a need, demand, or requirement.

examples.en: He smiled with satisfaction after fixing the broken chair.
examples.zh: 修好那把壞椅子後，他滿意地笑了。

examples.en: Greater job satisfaction can reduce staff turnover and encourage employees to contribute more actively to their organisations.
examples.zh: 更高的工作滿意度可以減少人員流失，並鼓勵員工更積極地為所在機構作貢獻。

words.tip: 通常不可數；滿意某事常說satisfaction with。

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

examples.en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
examples.zh: 我打噴嚏時，她遞給我一張紙巾。

examples.en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
examples.zh: 科學家正在開發新療法，幫助受損組織在受傷後更有效地修復。

words.tip: 紙巾是可數名詞；生物組織通常不可數。

senses.en: A tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells
Harmful computer code that spreads by infecting files or programs

examples.en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
examples.zh: 醫生說我的咳嗽是由病毒引起的。

examples.en: Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.
examples.zh: 公共衛生宣傳可以透過鼓勵接種疫苗和經常洗手來限制病毒傳播。

words.tip: virus是病毒，bacterium是細菌；兩者不能混用。

senses.en: Unable to see.
Unwilling or unable to recognize facts or problems.
A window covering that can be raised or adjusted.

examples.en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
examples.zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖觸讀故事。

examples.en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
examples.zh: 公共交通系統應提供清晰的語音播報，幫助失明乘客安全、獨立地出行。

words.tip: blind to表示未察覺或無視；窗簾義是可數名詞。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of fear.
Violence or threats used to frighten and control people.

examples.en: She woke in terror after dreaming about a falling lift.
examples.zh: 她夢見電梯墜落，驚恐地醒了過來。

examples.en: Responsible news reporting should inform the public about threats without spreading unnecessary terror among communities.
examples.zh: 負責任的新聞報道應向公眾說明威脅，同時避免在社群中傳播不必要的恐慌。

words.tip: 表示強烈恐懼，程度比fear深；通常不可數。

senses.en: pressure or difficulty that tests someone's strength or resources
to injure or overwork a muscle or body part
a particular type of plant, animal, or microorganism

examples.en: I strained my back while lifting that heavy box.
examples.zh: 我搬那個沉重的箱子時拉傷了背部。

examples.en: Rapid population growth puts considerable strain on public services, particularly housing and healthcare in large cities.
examples.zh: 人口快速增長給公共服務帶來巨大壓力，尤其是大城市的住房和醫療服務。

words.tip: strain可指拉傷；sprain主要指關節扭傷。

senses.en: the firm intention to continue despite difficulties
the process of establishing a fact or making an official decision

examples.en: Despite the rain, she finished the race with determination.
examples.zh: 儘管下著雨，她仍憑藉毅力跑完了比賽。

examples.en: Students who show determination are often better able to overcome academic setbacks and achieve their goals.
examples.zh: 有決心的學生往往更能克服學業挫折，實現自己的目標。

words.tip: 表決心常接to do；表確定常接of。

senses.en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value.
Respect for yourself, sometimes involving an exaggerated sense of importance.
To feel especially pleased about your own qualities or achievements.

examples.en: Her face shone with pride as she displayed her painting.
examples.zh: 她展示畫作時，臉上洋溢著自豪。

examples.en: Schools can foster community pride by encouraging students to participate in projects that improve their local environment.
examples.zh: 學校可以鼓勵學生參與改善當地環境的專案，從而培養社群自豪感。

words.tip: 動詞用pride oneself on；形容詞用proud of。

senses.en: A feeling of great happiness
A person or thing that brings great happiness

examples.en: The children jumped for joy when the snow began.
examples.zh: 開始下雪時，孩子們高興得跳了起來。

examples.en: Community gardens can bring joy to residents while strengthening social connections and encouraging healthier lifestyles.
examples.zh: 社群花園既能給居民帶來歡樂，也能加強社會聯絡並鼓勵更健康的生活方式。

words.tip: 表喜悅通常不可數；表樂事可數，如a joy。

senses.en: A pleasant state of physical ease and relaxation.
Relief from sadness or worry, or something providing it.
To help someone feel less sad, worried, or upset.

examples.en: I enjoyed the comfort of a warm bed after camping.
examples.zh: 露營後，我享受著溫暖床鋪帶來的舒適。

examples.en: Support groups can comfort patients by providing opportunities to share experiences and discuss concerns openly.
examples.zh: 互助小組讓患者有機會分享經歷、坦誠討論憂慮，從而給予他們安慰。

words.tip: 表示舒適或慰藉時通常不可數；作動詞直接接人。

senses.en: the soft organ in your mouth used for tasting and speaking
a language used by a particular community

examples.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
examples.zh: 我喝熱湯時燙到了舌頭。

examples.en: Children who receive early education in their mother tongue may develop stronger foundations for learning other languages.
examples.zh: 用母語接受早期教育的兒童，可能為學習其他語言打下更牢固的基礎。

collocations.en: on the tip of your tongue

words.tip: tongue指語言多見於mother tongue等搭配。

senses.en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.

examples.en: I am grateful for your help with the move.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我搬家。

examples.en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
examples.zh: 許多學生感謝獎學金讓他們即使經濟困難也能繼續學業。

words.tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。
