examples.en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
examples.zh: 這次冬日散步必須穿一件暖和的外套。

examples.en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
examples.zh: 獲得清潔飲用水對預防疾病和改善公共衛生至關重要。

words.tip: 名詞常用複數 essentials，表示必需品或基本要點。

senses.en: To establish that something is true or correct.
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

examples.en: Please call the hotel to confirm our booking today.
examples.zh: 請今天給酒店打電話，確認我們的預訂。

examples.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
examples.zh: 還需要進一步研究，以證實小學小班教學是否能持續改善學習效果。

words.tip: 可接名詞或that從句；不要用confirm to do。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

examples.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們通常星期六去市場買新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
examples.zh: 公共圖書館在星期六開放，讓更多上班的家長能與孩子一起參加教育活動。

words.tip: 首字母大寫；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose
to improve something until it is as good as possible
describing verb forms using have with a past participle

examples.en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
examples.zh: 這個安靜的角落特別適合午飯後看書。

examples.en: Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.
examples.zh: 儘管沒有完美的交通系統，可靠的公共交通服務仍能顯著減少城市對汽車的依賴。

words.tip: 形容詞重音在前；動詞讀/pəˈfekt/（英）。

senses.en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.

examples.en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
examples.zh: 在雨中走過之後，我的鞋全溼透了。

examples.en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
examples.zh: 雖然線上課程提供了靈活性，但它們無法完全取代課堂學習帶來的社交益處。

words.tip: 表示程度達到全部，常修飾形容詞或動詞。

senses.en: A talk in which people exchange ideas, feelings, or information.

examples.en: We had a friendly conversation while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 等公交車時，我們友好地聊了一會兒。

examples.en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
examples.zh: 經常與語言流利的人交談有助於語言學習者建立信心並提高聽力。

words.tip: 與某人談某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

examples.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
examples.zh: 請別碰鍋，它還很燙。

examples.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
examples.zh: 即使工作或學習使家人分居不同國家，數字通訊也能幫助他們保持聯絡。

words.tip: 保持聯絡用keep in touch with someone。

senses.en: The distance from one end of something to the other.
The amount of time something lasts.

examples.en: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
examples.zh: 我們買椅子之前量了桌子的長度。

examples.en: The length of the school day can affect both student concentration and family routines.
examples.zh: 每天在校時間的長短既會影響學生的注意力，也會影響家庭的日常安排。

words.tip: at length常指“詳細地”，不是“在長度上”。

senses.en: A steady position or a suitable mixture of different things
To keep something steady or give competing needs suitable attention
The money remaining in an account or still owed

examples.en: She lost her balance while stepping off the bus.
examples.zh: 她下公交車時失去了平衡。

examples.en: Governments must balance the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect green spaces.
examples.zh: 政府必須兼顧人們對可負擔住房的需求和保護綠地的需要。

words.tip: 兼顧兩者用balance A with B；均衡飲食用balanced。

senses.en: A group of sports teams that regularly compete against one another.
An association of people or groups sharing a common purpose.
A level of quality, ability, or achievement.

examples.en: Our team finished top of the league this season.
examples.zh: 我們隊本賽季在聯賽中排名第一。

examples.en: A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
examples.zh: 地方體育聯賽可以讓不同社會背景的球員聚在一起，從而加強社群聯絡。

words.tip: in a different league常指水平遠勝一籌。

senses.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

examples.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
examples.zh: 幸好，我們家外面發生的事故沒有造成人員受傷。

examples.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
examples.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜間涉及騎車人和行人的事故風險。

words.tip: by accident表示無意中，反義短語是on purpose。

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

examples.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
examples.zh: 我們在下雨前回到了營地。

examples.en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
examples.zh: 學校可以組織戶外營地活動，幫助學生培養獨立性並學習課堂之外的實用技能。

words.tip: go camping表示去露營；camp也可指觀點相同的陣營。

senses.en: The second month of the year.

examples.en: My sister starts her new job in February.
examples.zh: 我姐姐二月份開始新工作。

examples.en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
examples.zh: 社群中心將在二月份增設夜間課程，以滿足不斷增長的需求。

words.tip: 月份首字母大寫；月份前用in，具體日期前用on。

senses.en: Saturday and Sunday, often a time away from work.

examples.en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
examples.zh: 我們通常在週末逛農貿市場。

examples.en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
examples.zh: 價格親民的週末活動能鼓勵家人在當地社群共度更多時光。

words.tip: 英式常說 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

senses.en: a group of twelve
a large unspecified quantity, used in the plural

examples.en: Please buy a dozen eggs on your way home.
examples.zh: 請在回家的路上買十二個雞蛋。

examples.en: Dozens of community gardens have opened across the city, giving residents more opportunities to grow food.
examples.zh: 全市已開設數十個社群菜園，讓居民有更多機會種植食物。

words.tip: two dozen不加s；dozens of表示許多。

senses.en: usually, or in most situations
in the usual, expected, or healthy way

examples.en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
examples.zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。

examples.en: Students normally benefit from regular feedback, especially when teachers provide clear guidance on improving their work.
examples.zh: 學生通常能從定期反饋中受益，尤其是在教師明確指導他們改進作業時。

words.tip: 既可表頻率“通常”，也可表狀態“正常地”。

senses.en: The first part or starting point of something.

examples.en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天錯過了電影的開頭。

examples.en: The beginning of formal education marks an important stage in a child's social development.
examples.zh: 正規教育的開始標誌著兒童社會性發展的一個重要階段。

words.tip: at the beginning of後接名詞；in the beginning表示起初。

senses.en: the outer form of something
to influence how something develops
to give something a particular physical form

examples.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
examples.zh: 她把餅乾坯切成了星星的形狀。

examples.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
examples.zh: 幼年經歷可以塑造學習態度，並影響未來的學業成就。

words.tip: in shape可指身體狀態好，不只表示形狀。

senses.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow
to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger

examples.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
examples.zh: 作為一名足球迷，我幾乎不錯過任何一場比賽。

examples.en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
examples.zh: 體育迷可以透過支援社群球隊、參與共同活動來增強當地社群的凝聚力。

words.tip: 表示“……的愛好者”用a fan of。

senses.en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes.
To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance.
To push a pointed object into something.

examples.en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
examples.zh: 那隻狗把一根樹枝叼回給我。

examples.en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
examples.zh: 學生可以把圖片貼在共同製作的海報上，展示他們對當地野生動物的研究。

words.tip: 動詞過去式和過去分詞均為stuck；stick to表示堅持。

senses.en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground.
A weakness or missing part in a plan or argument.

examples.en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的襪子上有一個小洞。

examples.en: The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.
examples.zh: 安全圍欄上發現了一個破洞，促使居民要求緊急維修。

words.tip: hole指洞；whole指完整的，兩詞同音。

senses.en: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts.
Two people who are together or work together.
To put people or things together in groups of two.

examples.en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把最喜歡的那雙手套落在公交車上了。

examples.en: Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.
examples.zh: 教師常將各有所長的學生配成一組，以鼓勵合作並改善學習成效。

words.tip: a pair of shoes作主語時，謂語用單數。

senses.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby
To go somewhere and bring someone or something away
To receive or gather money from people

examples.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
examples.zh: 每次去海邊，我都會收集光滑的石頭。

examples.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
examples.zh: 研究人員收集當地家庭的資料，以評估交通政策如何影響日常出行習慣。

words.tip: 英式英語collect someone可指去接某人。

senses.en: At a low speed or over a long time.

examples.en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
examples.zh: 她慢慢地把熱湯倒進碗裡。

examples.en: Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.
examples.zh: 儘管公眾觀念改變得較慢，但越來越多的消費者正在選擇塑膠包裝更少的產品。

words.tip: slowly是副詞，修飾動作；slow通常作形容詞。

senses.en: A particular place or position.
A small mark differing in colour from its surroundings.
Notice or recognise someone or something.

examples.en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊找到了一處陰涼的地方。

examples.en: Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.
examples.zh: 衛星影象幫助研究人員在大面積破壞發生之前發現森林覆蓋的變化。

words.tip: on the spot可指“當場”或“在現場”，依語境判斷。

senses.en: The amount of space between two places or things
A lack of emotional closeness between people
To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views

examples.en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
examples.zh: 從我們家到學校的距離很短。

examples.en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
examples.zh: 縮短住宅區與工作地點之間的距離，可以減少交通排放並改善城市生活質量。

words.tip: in the distance指在遠處；at a distance指隔一段距離。

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

examples.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
examples.zh: 我們通常八月去看望住在海邊的祖父母。

examples.en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
examples.zh: 旅遊目的地的需求往往在八月增加，給當地交通和住宿帶來壓力。

words.tip: 月份首字母大寫；月份前用in，具體日期前用on。

senses.en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates
To move or travel very fast
To drive faster than the legal limit

examples.en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
examples.zh: 我們離開小鎮時，火車加快了速度。

examples.en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
examples.zh: 降低學校附近的車速，可以顯著提高步行或騎車上學的兒童的道路安全。

words.tip: speed up表示加快；speed也可作動詞指超速駕駛。

senses.en: a way taken to get from one place to another
to send someone or something along a particular path

examples.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
examples.zh: 我們換了一條路線回家，以避開擁堵。

examples.en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
examples.zh: 將公交線路延伸至農村社群，有助於居民獲得就業機會和基本公共服務。

words.tip: 美式也讀 /raʊt/；route 強調行進路線。

senses.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly
To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape
Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread

examples.en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
examples.zh: 橙子從桌上滾下來，滾到了我的椅子底下。

examples.en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
examples.zh: 工人把再生材料薄片捲成緊實的捆，以便儲存和運輸。

words.tip: roll強調翻轉滾動；捲起常用roll up。

senses.en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight.
To prevent others from knowing or noticing something.
The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.

examples.en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
examples.zh: 我們把生日禮物藏在了床底下。

examples.en: Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.
examples.zh: 企業不應隱瞞其產品或生產流程所涉及的環境風險資訊。

words.tip: 過去式hid，過去分詞hidden；hide from意為躲避。

senses.en: not joined, shared, or considered together
to divide things or move them apart

examples.en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
examples.zh: 我們把乾淨毛巾放在一個單獨的櫃子裡。

examples.en: Local authorities should provide separate bins for recyclable materials to make household waste sorting easier.
examples.zh: 地方政府應為可回收材料提供專用垃圾桶，讓家庭垃圾分類更方便。

words.tip: 形容詞詞尾讀/ət/，動詞詞尾讀/eɪt/。

senses.en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed.
Someone or something that may cause harm.

examples.en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
examples.zh: 離邊緣遠一點，有掉下去的危險。

examples.en: Poorly maintained roads pose a serious danger to cyclists, particularly in areas without dedicated cycling lanes.
examples.zh: 維護不善的道路對騎車人構成嚴重威脅，尤其是在沒有專用腳踏車道的地區。

words.tip: in danger指處於危險中；dangerous指會帶來危險。

senses.en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events.
Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement.
Someone who often visits the same place.

examples.en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
examples.zh: 我們的狗需要經常散步，才能保持快樂和健康。

examples.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
examples.zh: 規律運動可以降低老年人患慢性病的風險，並改善其整體身心健康。

words.tip: regular側重規律或經常，不等於持續不停的continuous。

senses.en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.
Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time.
Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.

examples.en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
examples.zh: 我們的房租本週末到期應付。

examples.en: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
examples.zh: 學費到期應繳時，一些學生難以同時承擔教育支出和基本生活費用。

words.tip: be due to do表示預計做；due to＋名詞表示由於。

senses.en: to answer someone or respond to a message
an answer given in speech or writing

examples.en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
examples.zh: 請在週五之前回復，好讓我預訂晚餐。

examples.en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
examples.zh: 地方官員應及時答覆對公共交通服務提出擔憂的居民。

words.tip: reply to後接人或訊息，不直接接賓語。

senses.en: Pay no attention to someone or something

examples.en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
examples.zh: 請別忽視發動機發出的那種怪聲。

examples.en: Governments cannot ignore the long-term effects of air pollution on children's health and development.
examples.zh: 政府不能忽視空氣汙染對兒童健康與發育的長期影響。

words.tip: 直接接賓語；不表示法律上的“駁回訴訟”。

senses.en: moving or acting fast, without much delay
taking only a short time

examples.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
examples.zh: 她反應敏捷，及時接住了差點掉落的玻璃杯。

examples.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
examples.zh: 對水汙染報告作出迅速回應，可以防止附近生態系統遭受嚴重破壞。

words.tip: 正式表達中用副詞quickly修飾動作。

senses.en: An alcoholic drink usually made from fermented grapes

examples.en: The restaurant uses a little wine in this mushroom sauce.
examples.zh: 這家餐館在這款蘑菇醬里加了少量葡萄酒。

examples.en: Climate change is affecting wine production as rising temperatures alter grape quality and harvest times.
examples.zh: 氣候變化正在影響葡萄酒生產，因為氣溫上升改變了葡萄品質和採收時間。

words.tip: 泛指葡萄酒時不可數；多種葡萄酒可用wines。

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound
to contact someone by telephone

examples.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
examples.zh: 她把那枚銀戒指戴在了手指上。

examples.en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
examples.zh: 乘客應將手機調至靜音，因為裝置反覆響鈴會打擾公共交通工具上的其他人。

words.tip: 響鈴、打電話的過去式為rang，過去分詞為rung。

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

examples.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨，明亮的陽光從廚房窗戶照了進來。

examples.en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
examples.zh: 無論家庭背景如何，獲得優質教育都能讓年輕人擁有光明的未來。

words.tip: 形容光線強用bright；形容房間暗用dim。

senses.en: Added to what already exists or is available.

examples.en: We need an additional chair for our guest tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚有客人來，我們需要再加一把椅子。

examples.en: Universities should provide additional financial support for students who cannot afford essential learning materials.
examples.zh: 大學應為無力購買必要學習資料的學生提供額外的經濟支援。

words.tip: 通常放在名詞前；additional costs指額外費用。

senses.en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event.
Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.

examples.en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
examples.zh: 每位客人都帶了一道菜，在晚餐時與大家分享。

examples.en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
examples.zh: 酒店可以僅在住客提出要求時更換毛巾，以鼓勵節水。

words.tip: guest可指受邀客人，也可指付費的酒店住客。

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

examples.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
examples.zh: 一隻小小的青蛙從花盆裡跳了出來。

examples.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
examples.zh: 即使日常習慣的微小改變，長期下來也能減少家庭能源消耗。

words.tip: 比small語氣更強，強調小得驚人。

senses.en: items worn to cover the body

examples.en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
examples.zh: 你洗乾淨的衣服正在外面曬太陽。

examples.en: Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.
examples.zh: 購買耐穿的衣服，而不是頻繁更換廉價服裝，可以減少家庭垃圾並節約資源。

words.tip: 只有複數形式；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.
Food given to farm animals.
A regularly updated stream of online content.

examples.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
examples.zh: 請在上學前喂一下貓。

examples.en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
examples.zh: 學校供餐計劃幫助那些家庭無法持續負擔營養食物的兒童吃上飯。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為fed；feed on表示以……為食。

senses.en: mostly or to a great extent

examples.en: The beach was largely empty when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我們到達時，海灘上幾乎沒什麼人。

examples.en: The success of public health campaigns depends largely on clear communication and widespread community trust.
examples.zh: 公共衛生宣傳活動的成功很大程度上取決於清晰的溝通和廣泛的社群信任。

words.tip: 表示主要或大體上，不表示物體體積很大。

senses.en: Make plans or preparations for something to happen.
Put things in a particular order or position.

examples.en: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
examples.zh: 我約好和表親在電影院外見面。

examples.en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
examples.zh: 學校可以安排學生參觀當地企業，幫助他們瞭解不同職業的實際要求。

collocations.en: arrange for someone to do something

words.tip: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

examples.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
examples.zh: 我的週末大部分時間都用來做飯和看書了。

examples.en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
examples.zh: 在許多農村地區，由於公共交通服務有限，居民主要依靠私家車出行。

words.tip: mostly指大部分情況；almost指差一點或幾乎。

senses.en: A picture made using a camera.

examples.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
examples.zh: 我們在那座老橋旁拍了張照片。

examples.en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
examples.zh: 歷史照片為研究城市景觀和日常生活方式如何隨時間變化提供了寶貴證據。

words.tip: photo是photograph的常用簡稱；複數為photos。

senses.en: Alive now, rather than dead or without life.
Money earned to pay for everyday needs.
The way people live and meet their everyday needs.

examples.en: The pond is full of tiny living creatures.
examples.zh: 池塘裡滿是微小的生物。

examples.en: Rising housing costs make it harder for young adults to earn a decent living in major cities.
examples.zh: 住房成本上漲，使年輕人在大城市更難掙到足以過上體面生活的收入。

words.tip: living可放名詞前；alive通常作表語或後置修飾。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

examples.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
examples.zh: 請在客人到來之前數一下盤子。

examples.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
examples.zh: 評估教育成效時，學生的自信和創造力應與考試成績同樣重要。

words.tip: count on意為依靠；count作“重要”時不及物。

senses.en: An object or collection of objects wrapped or boxed together.
A set of services or measures offered together.
To put something into a container for sale or transport.

examples.en: A small package arrived at our door this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨，一個小包裹送到了我們家門口。

examples.en: The government introduced a support package to help small businesses invest in cleaner production methods.
examples.zh: 政府推出了一攬子扶持措施，幫助小企業投資更清潔的生產方式。

words.tip: 指郵寄的包裹時，英式英語也常用parcel。

senses.en: To move someone or something to a higher position.
A machine carrying people or goods between floors.
A ride in someone else's vehicle.

examples.en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
examples.zh: 你能幫我把這個箱子抬到架子上嗎？

examples.en: Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.
examples.zh: 在較老的公共建築中安裝電梯，可以方便輪椅使用者和行動不便的人進出。

words.tip: 電梯英式用lift，美式用elevator。

senses.en: mostly, or more than anything else

examples.en: This little shop mainly sells fresh bread and cakes.
examples.zh: 這家小店主要賣新鮮麵包和蛋糕。

examples.en: Many rural communities depend mainly on agriculture, making them particularly vulnerable to changes in weather patterns.
examples.zh: 許多農村社群主要依賴農業，因此尤其容易受到天氣模式變化的影響。

words.tip: 表示“主要而非全部”；常放在實義動詞前。

senses.en: To push yourself off the ground into the air.
To increase suddenly by a large amount.
An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.

examples.en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
examples.zh: 狗跳過了大門旁的一攤積水。

examples.en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
examples.zh: 在住房需求持續超過可負擔住房供應的城市，住房成本已大幅上漲。

words.tip: jump at the chance意為欣然抓住機會。

senses.en: to collect things from different places or sources
to come together or bring people together
to understand something from what you hear or observe

examples.en: We gathered fallen apples in a basket before lunch.
examples.zh: 午飯前，我們把掉落的蘋果收進了籃子。

examples.en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
examples.zh: 研究人員向當地居民收集資訊，以瞭解公共交通如何影響就業機會的獲取。

words.tip: I gather that...表示“我聽說或推斷……”。

senses.en: the number equal to four times ten

examples.en: We waited forty minutes before the bus finally arrived.
examples.zh: 我們等了四十分鐘，公交車才終於到。

examples.en: The survey found that forty percent of local residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.
examples.zh: 調查發現，當地百分之四十的居民在短途出行時更願意騎車而非開車。

words.tip: 拼寫是forty，不是fourty；四十多歲用in one's forties。

senses.en: to go from one side to another, or intersect
a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol
annoyed or slightly angry

examples.en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
examples.zh: 我們等車輛停下後才過馬路。

examples.en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
examples.zh: 更安全的步行路線鼓勵居民步行穿過繁忙道路，而不是短途開車。

words.tip: cross是動詞；across是介詞或副詞。

senses.en: having a comfortable temperature that is not hot
showing kindness, friendliness, or affection
to become warmer or make something warmer

examples.en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
examples.zh: 這條厚毯子讓我在涼颼颼的夜晚保持暖和。

examples.en: A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
examples.zh: 學校的熱情歡迎能幫助新生獲得歸屬感，並建立自信。

words.tip: warm比hot溫度低；warm to某人指漸漸喜歡對方。

senses.en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.

examples.en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
examples.zh: 一位訪客把她的傘落在了我們前門旁。

examples.en: The museum attracts international visitors by offering exhibitions that explore local history and culture.
examples.zh: 這家博物館透過舉辦探究當地歷史與文化的展覽吸引國際遊客。

words.tip: visitor指人；visit可作動詞或名詞。

senses.en: With something added to an amount or group.
An advantage or positive feature.
Greater than zero, especially when describing temperatures.

examples.en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
examples.zh: 房間每晚六十英鎊，早餐另收費。

examples.en: Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
examples.zh: 經濟適用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能讓收入不高的勞動者更容易在擴張中的城市生活。

words.tip: plus作名詞表示優點時可數，如a big plus。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

examples.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
examples.zh: 我把鑰匙落在沙發附近的某個地方了。

examples.en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
examples.zh: 年輕人需要有負擔得起的住所，才能充分參與當地的經濟活動。

words.tip: 形容詞放後面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

senses.en: at the present time

examples.en: Our kitchen is currently full of boxes from the move.
examples.zh: 我們的廚房目前堆滿了搬家用的箱子。

examples.en: Many cities are currently investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
examples.zh: 許多城市目前正在投資建設腳踏車基礎設施，以緩解交通擁堵並改善城市空氣質量。

words.tip: 表示“目前”，常放在實義動詞前、be動詞後。

senses.en: Completely, with nothing left out.

examples.en: I entirely forgot about the soup on the stove.
examples.zh: 我把爐子上煮著的湯忘得一乾二淨。

examples.en: A transport system powered entirely by renewable energy could significantly reduce a city's carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 完全由可再生能源驅動的交通系統可以顯著減少城市的碳排放。

words.tip: not entirely表示不完全，並非完全不。

senses.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases
The small, hard ball used in this sport

examples.en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
examples.zh: 午飯後，我們在公園打棒球。

examples.en: Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.
examples.zh: 棒球等團隊運動能幫助年輕人培養合作能力並保持身體健康。

words.tip: 運動名稱不可數；表示一個棒球時用a baseball。

senses.en: The act of entering, or permission to enter a place.
An individual item in a list, diary, or reference work.
A work or person submitted for a competition.

examples.en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
examples.zh: 今天進入游泳池免費。

examples.en: Strict entry requirements may prevent capable students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education opportunities.
examples.zh: 嚴格的入學要求可能使來自弱勢背景的優秀學生無法獲得高等教育機會。

words.tip: 進入某處常用entry to；具體入口通常用entrance。

senses.en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape
gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh
not strict or severe enough

examples.en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
examples.zh: 這條柔軟的毯子讓我在寒冷的夜晚保持溫暖。

examples.en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
examples.zh: 柔和的燈光和舒適的傢俱可以減輕患者在醫院候診區的緊張感。

words.tip: soft是形容詞；修飾說話等動作通常用softly。

senses.en: a rounded object laid by female birds and some other animals
a female reproductive cell that can develop after fertilisation

examples.en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 她把一個雞蛋打進了熱煎鍋。

examples.en: Eggs provide an affordable source of protein and can form part of a balanced diet.
examples.zh: 雞蛋是價格實惠的蛋白質來源，可以成為均衡飲食的一部分。

words.tip: scrambled eggs指炒蛋；egg white指蛋清。

senses.en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things
the group of senior ministers who make major government decisions

examples.en: The clean cups are in the cabinet above the sink.
examples.zh: 乾淨杯子放在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: The cabinet approved a national programme to improve access to affordable housing in rapidly growing cities.
examples.zh: 內閣批准了一項全國性計劃，以增加快速發展城市中可負擔住房的供應。

words.tip: 可指傢俱或內閣；內閣由政府高階部長組成。

senses.en: At a time before now or before another event.

examples.en: I had previously met our neighbour at the library.
examples.zh: 我先前在圖書館見過我們的鄰居。

examples.en: Online courses now provide educational opportunities for people who previously had limited access to universities.
examples.zh: 線上課程如今為那些以前難以接受大學教育的人提供了學習機會。

words.tip: previously意為先前；表示提前準備通常用in advance。

senses.en: Something given freely to another person
A natural ability to do something well
To give something to someone as a present

examples.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
examples.zh: 姐姐用鮮黃色的紙把禮物包了起來。

examples.en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
examples.zh: 學校應培養每個孩子的天賦，而不是用同一套狹隘的標準評判所有人。

words.tip: 表示天賦時常用 a gift for，後接名詞或動名詞。

senses.en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.

examples.en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
examples.zh: 開啟之前，它看起來就是一個普通盒子。

examples.en: Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.
examples.zh: 城市規劃應反映普通居民的需求，而不是隻顧吸引富有的投資者。

words.tip: ordinary強調不特別；不等於表示平均水平的average。

senses.en: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.

examples.en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
examples.zh: 我上班出門前會喝一杯加奶咖啡。

examples.en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
examples.zh: 氣溫上升可能威脅咖啡生產，影響一些發展中國家農民的收入。

words.tip: 通常不可數；點單時two coffees指兩杯咖啡。

senses.en: To a very great degree.

examples.en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
examples.zh: 湯燙極了，所以我等了一會兒。

examples.en: Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.
examples.zh: 對於依賴線上學習的學生來說，能夠使用可靠的網路極其重要。

words.tip: 修飾可分程度的形容詞或副詞，語氣強於very。

senses.en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising
Not known or experienced before

examples.en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
examples.zh: 櫥櫃裡傳出一陣奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
examples.zh: 在遊客看來奇怪的習俗，可能體現了當地社群重要的社會價值觀。

words.tip: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

senses.en: people or things arranged in a straight line
to move a boat through water using oars
a noisy argument or loud disturbance

examples.en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
examples.zh: 我們在前排找到了兩個空座位。

examples.en: Planting a row of trees beside busy roads can help reduce noise and improve local air quality.
examples.zh: 在繁忙道路旁種植一排樹木，有助於降低噪聲並改善當地空氣質量。

words.tip: “排、划船”讀/rəʊ/；“爭吵”英美均讀/raʊ/。

senses.en: On two occasions.
To double the amount, degree, or size.

examples.en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
examples.zh: 我檢查了兩次包，卻沒找到鑰匙。

examples.en: Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 每週至少鍛鍊兩次的居民，身心健康可能得到改善。

words.tip: 兩倍常用twice as…as或twice the＋名詞。

senses.en: to be convenient or right for someone
to make someone look attractive
matching clothes consisting of a jacket and trousers or skirt

examples.en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
examples.zh: 明天把預約時間提前一點會更適合你嗎？

examples.en: Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
examples.zh: 彈性工作時間適合需要兼顧工作職責與家庭責任的員工。

words.tip: suit強調合適或好看；fit強調尺寸合身。

senses.en: to a moderate degree, but not very
in a way that treats people equally and reasonably

examples.en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
examples.zh: 走路回家的路程還算短，一路也很愜意。

examples.en: Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.
examples.zh: 學校應公平分配資源，讓背景不利的學生獲得所需的支援。

words.tip: 表程度時弱於very；fairly good是還不錯，並非極好。

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

examples.en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
examples.zh: 一陣冷風把樹葉吹過空蕩蕩的操場。

examples.en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
examples.zh: 當地工廠的關閉嚴重打擊了該地區的就業機會。

words.tip: 動詞變化為blow–blew–blown。

senses.en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.

examples.en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
examples.zh: 我們長途步行回來後，爸爸做了一頓熱乎乎的飯。

examples.en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
examples.zh: 提供健康的學校餐食能提高兒童的專注力，並促進他們的身體發育。

words.tip: meal指一頓飯；food泛指食物，通常不可數。

senses.en: Extremely good or of very high quality.

examples.en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
examples.zh: 這湯好喝極了，所以我又點了一碗。

examples.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
examples.zh: 優質的公共交通可以減少人們對汽車的依賴，讓所有居民出行更便利。

words.tip: 已含“極好”之意，通常不用very修飾。

senses.en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating
someone who prepares and cooks food

examples.en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
examples.zh: 天氣變冷時，我通常會煮蔬菜湯。

examples.en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
examples.zh: 教孩子做簡單飯菜，可以培養更健康的飲食習慣，讓他們日後更加獨立。

words.tip: cook可指廚師；cooker在英式英語中指爐灶。

senses.en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere.
A series of performances or matches held in different places.
To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.

examples.en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
examples.zh: 我們在導遊帶領下參觀了那座古堡。

examples.en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
examples.zh: 有組織的遊覽既能讓遊客瞭解當地傳統，也能為社群導遊提供穩定收入。

words.tip: tour強調參觀或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。

senses.en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire.
To damage skin or other material through heat.
An injury caused by heat, chemicals, or electricity.

examples.en: A small fire burned quietly in the fireplace.
examples.zh: 壁爐裡，一小團火靜靜地燃燒著。

examples.en: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases, making cleaner energy sources essential for environmental protection.
examples.zh: 燃燒化石燃料會釋放溫室氣體，因此清潔能源對環境保護至關重要。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞可用burnt或burned。

senses.en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.

examples.en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
examples.zh: 我的鞋裡有一顆小石子。

examples.en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
examples.zh: 對於工作時大部分時間都站著的員工來說，舒適的鞋子至關重要。

words.tip: 一雙鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe為可數名詞。

senses.en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals
an American game involving carrying, throwing, and kicking an oval ball

examples.en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每週六早上都在公園踢足球。

examples.en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
examples.zh: 地方足球俱樂部能夠聚集不同社會背景的人，從而增進社群聯絡。

words.tip: 英式football指足球；美式通常指美式橄欖球。

senses.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.

examples.en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
examples.zh: 喂，你把傘落在門邊了！

examples.en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
examples.zh: 學生初次透過電子郵件聯絡大學教職員工時，使用hey這類非正式問候語可能不太合適。

words.tip: 適合熟人間打招呼；正式郵件避免使用。

senses.en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed.
A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.

examples.en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
examples.zh: 我在床墊上鋪了一條幹淨的床單。

examples.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.
examples.zh: 學校可以鼓勵學生使用每張紙的正反兩面，以減少紙張浪費。

words.tip: sheet是可數名詞；一張紙說a sheet of paper。

senses.en: making little or no noise
having little activity or excitement
a state with little or no noise

examples.en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
examples.zh: 孩子們睡著後，屋子裡安靜了下來。

examples.en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
examples.zh: 公共圖書館內安靜的學習空間對無法在家集中注意力的學生至關重要。

words.tip: quiet是“安靜的”，quite是“相當”，注意拼寫。

senses.en: a one-piece garment with a top and a skirt
to put clothes on yourself or someone else
clothing of a particular type or worn for a particular occasion

examples.en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一條藍色連衣裙去參加姐姐的聚會。

examples.en: Some employers require formal dress, while others allow staff to wear casual clothing at work.
examples.zh: 有些僱主要求穿正裝，而另一些則允許員工上班時穿便裝。

words.tip: a dress指連衣裙；get dressed指穿好衣服。

senses.en: the number after eleven and before thirteen

examples.en: There are twelve fresh eggs in this carton.
examples.zh: 這個蛋盒裡有十二枚新鮮雞蛋。

examples.en: The training programme lasts twelve weeks and combines practical experience with classroom instruction for young adults.
examples.zh: 這項培訓為期十二週，為年輕成年人提供實踐經驗與課堂教學相結合的學習。

words.tip: twelve是基數詞；序數詞twelfth拼寫有變化。

senses.en: To bring things together or join to form a whole.
A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.

examples.en: Combine the flour and butter in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和黃油放在一個大碗裡混合。

examples.en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
examples.zh: 城市可以將公共交通改善與更安全的騎行路線建設相結合，減少對私家車的依賴。

words.tip: 動詞重音在後；收割機名詞讀/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

senses.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way
calm and able to think clearly under pressure
to become or make something less hot

examples.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
examples.zh: 一陣涼爽的微風從敞開的廚房窗戶吹了進來。

examples.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
examples.zh: 種植更多樹木有助於為城市地區降溫，並減少夏季的能源需求。

words.tip: cool 比 cold 溫和；口語中還可表示“很酷的”。

senses.en: Suitable or correct for a particular purpose or situation.
Real or satisfactory, rather than incomplete or inadequate.
Strictly understood, excluding surrounding or related things.

examples.en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
examples.zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合適的鞋。

examples.en: Workers should receive proper training before operating machinery that could pose a risk to their safety.
examples.zh: 工人在操作可能危及自身安全的機器前，應接受適當培訓。

words.tip: 表示“本身的”時放名詞後，如the city proper。

senses.en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know
Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience

examples.en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
examples.zh: 出門前請提醒我帶傘。

examples.en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
examples.zh: 學校應定期提醒學生，在使用線上學習平臺時保護個人資訊。

words.tip: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

senses.en: happening or done most often in a particular situation

examples.en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
examples.zh: 我們平時坐的窗邊那張桌子已經有人了。

examples.en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
examples.zh: 對科技行業的一些員工來說，居家辦公已成為常規安排。

words.tip: as usual意為“照常”；than usual意為“比平時”。

senses.en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.

examples.en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
examples.zh: 我打不開那個封得很緊的罐子。

examples.en: Without affordable internet access, many students are unable to participate fully in online learning programmes.
examples.zh: 如果沒有負擔得起的網路服務，許多學生就無法充分參與線上學習課程。

words.tip: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。

senses.en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly
to get food, drink, or something else quickly
to attract someone's attention strongly

examples.en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
examples.zh: 她抓起雨傘，朝公交車跑去。

examples.en: Public health campaigns often use striking images to grab attention and encourage people to change unhealthy habits.
examples.zh: 公共衛生宣傳常用醒目的圖片吸引注意，鼓勵人們改變不健康的習慣。

words.tip: grab較口語化；過去式grabbed，分詞grabbing。

senses.en: Small in amount or restricted in range

examples.en: We have limited space, so choose a smaller sofa.
examples.zh: 我們空間有限，所以選一張小一點的沙發吧。

examples.en: Students with limited access to reliable internet may struggle to participate fully in online learning.
examples.zh: 難以獲得穩定網路連線的學生可能無法充分參與線上學習。

words.tip: be limited to表示“僅限於”，to後接名詞或動名詞。

senses.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.
A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data.
Attach or secure something using sticky tape.

examples.en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
examples.zh: 我用一條膠帶封好了包裹。

examples.en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
examples.zh: 儲存在磁帶上的早期訪談應進行數字化處理，為未來的歷史研究儲存珍貴記錄。

words.tip: 膠帶通常不可數；一卷膠帶說a roll of tape。

senses.en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food.
A flat piece of metal or another hard material.
To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.

examples.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
examples.zh: 她在我的盤子裡放了一張熱乎乎的薄煎餅。

examples.en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
examples.zh: 餐館可以提供較小的餐盤，並允許顧客要求加量，從而減少食物浪費。

words.tip: plate通常指淺盤，bowl指較深的碗。

senses.en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way
very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind

examples.en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
examples.zh: 廚房窗邊有一些漂亮的黃色花朵。

examples.en: Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
examples.zh: 保護美麗的海岸景觀既能吸引遊客，也能為當地居民提供寶貴的戶外休閒空間。

words.tip: 雖以-ly結尾，卻是形容詞；英式口語中很常見。

senses.en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot
a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar
a connection between people, groups, or places

examples.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
examples.zh: 跑出去之前，請先繫好鞋帶。

examples.en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
examples.zh: 學校與當地僱主之間的緊密聯絡，可以幫助年輕人更順利地進入職場。

words.tip: tie的現在分詞是tying；表示關係時通常用複數ties。

senses.en: In or relating to the east of an area.

examples.en: Our hotel overlooks the island's quiet eastern coast.
examples.zh: 我們的酒店俯瞰著島上寧靜的東海岸。

examples.en: Improved railway connections could help eastern regions attract investment and reduce economic differences within the country.
examples.zh: 改善鐵路連線有助於東部地區吸引投資，縮小國內經濟差距。

words.tip: eastern通常只作形容詞，不表示“東方人”。

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

examples.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
examples.zh: 孩子們在草地上圍坐成一圈。

examples.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
examples.zh: 參加社群活動可以幫助老年人擴大社交圈，減少孤獨感。

words.tip: circle是圓或圓圈；cycle才常指迴圈或週期。

senses.en: To differ or change depending on circumstances.
To change something or introduce different kinds.

examples.en: Bus fares vary depending on how far you travel.
examples.zh: 公交車費會隨乘車距離而變化。

examples.en: Access to affordable housing can vary considerably between regions, affecting where young professionals choose to live.
examples.zh: 各地區獲得可負擔住房的機會可能差別很大，從而影響年輕職場人士的居住選擇。

words.tip: vary from A to B表示範圍；vary in表示某方面不同。

senses.en: The lowest part of something.
The part of your body that you sit on.
In the lowest position.

examples.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
examples.zh: 我的鑰匙在包的最底下。

examples.en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
examples.zh: 廢棄物經常堆積在河底，破壞棲息地並威脅水生生物。

words.tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

senses.en: The process of choosing someone or something
A range of things available to choose from
A group of things chosen from a larger collection

examples.en: This little bakery has a wonderful selection of fresh bread.
examples.zh: 這家小麵包店有各種很棒的新鮮麵包可供挑選。

examples.en: Transparent selection procedures can help universities offer places fairly to applicants from a wide range of backgrounds.
examples.zh: 透明的選拔程式有助於大學公平地錄取來自不同背景的申請者。

words.tip: 表示挑選過程時通常不可數；一組選項可數。

senses.en: tell someone about possible danger or an unpleasant consequence

examples.en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
examples.zh: 如果鍋太燙，請提醒我。

examples.en: Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.
examples.zh: 科學家警告說，棲息地持續減少可能使更多物種面臨滅絕風險。

collocations.en: warn someone not to do something

words.tip: warn後可接that從句；warn sb not to do表示告誡。

senses.en: Free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.
To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something.
Producing little or no pollution.

examples.en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
examples.zh: 你旁邊的架子上有乾淨的毛巾。

examples.en: Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.
examples.zh: 投資清潔能源可以減少空氣汙染，同時在新興產業中創造就業機會。

words.tip: clean是乾淨；clear是清澈或清楚，不能隨意互換。

senses.en: Bend or rest against something in a sloping position.
Having little body fat or containing little fat.
Using few resources while avoiding waste.

examples.en: She leaned against the wall and untied her shoes.
examples.zh: 她靠著牆，解開了鞋帶。

examples.en: Lean production methods can help manufacturers reduce waste while maintaining the quality of their products.
examples.zh: 精益生產方法能幫助製造商在保持產品質量的同時減少浪費。

words.tip: lean against指倚靠；lean towards可指傾向於。

senses.en: having greater than average height

examples.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午，一棵高大的樹為我們的花園遮陰。

examples.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
examples.zh: 高層建築可以容納更多居民，但需要精心規劃，以保留陽光和公共空間。

words.tip: 人、樹、樓通常用tall；山通常用high。

senses.en: Happening or existing at the beginning
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

examples.en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
examples.zh: 看到價格後，我最初的興奮消退了。

examples.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
examples.zh: 雖然太陽能電池板的初期費用較高，但從長遠看，家庭可能節省開支。

words.tip: 形容詞通常放在名詞前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: used to tell someone you are grateful
words or actions expressing gratitude

examples.en: Thanks for helping me carry these heavy bags upstairs.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我把這些沉重的袋子搬上樓。

examples.en: Public expressions of thanks can help volunteers feel valued and encourage continued participation in community projects.
examples.zh: 公開表達感謝能讓志願者感到受重視，並鼓勵他們持續參與社群專案。

words.tip: thanks for後接名詞或動名詞；thanks to表示多虧。

senses.en: A bird kept for its eggs or meat.
Meat from a chicken, eaten as food.

examples.en: The chickens scratched the soil beside our vegetable patch.
examples.zh: 那些雞在我們的菜地旁刨土。

examples.en: Replacing some red meat with chicken can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
examples.zh: 用雞肉替代部分紅肉，可以減少個人飲食對環境的影響。

words.tip: 指活雞時可數，指雞肉時不可數；小雞常用chick。

senses.en: to close something or stop being open for business
closed or not open for business

examples.en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
examples.zh: 請在雨飄進來之前把窗戶關上。

examples.en: When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.
examples.zh: 當本地圖書館關閉時，居民便失去了寶貴的免費學習資源和共享社群空間。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為shut；現在分詞為shutting。

senses.en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation

examples.en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
examples.zh: 這雙步行鞋適合走泥濘的林間小路。

examples.en: Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.
examples.zh: 城市應為老年居民提供合適的住房，方便他們就醫和乘坐公共交通。

words.tip: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。

senses.en: Happening or needed now, without any delay.
Closest in space, time, or relationship.
Directly connected to something, without anything coming between.

examples.en: The leaking pipe needs immediate attention before the kitchen floods.
examples.zh: 這根漏水的管子需要立即處理，免得廚房被淹。

examples.en: Governments should take immediate action to protect communities facing severe water shortages during prolonged droughts.
examples.zh: 政府應立即採取行動，保護那些在長期乾旱中面臨嚴重缺水的社群。

words.tip: immediate是形容詞；修飾動詞用immediately。

senses.en: A drawing showing where places or features are located
To draw or record the position of places or features

examples.en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
examples.zh: 出發前，我們把地圖鋪在桌上。

examples.en: Researchers use satellite images to map changes in forest cover and identify areas needing urgent protection.
examples.zh: 研究人員利用衛星影象繪製森林覆蓋變化圖，並確定急需保護的區域。

words.tip: map作動詞時，過去式mapped，分詞mapping。

senses.en: coming immediately after the third in a sequence
one of four equal parts of a whole

examples.en: Our apartment is on the fourth floor, beside the lift.
examples.zh: 我們的公寓在四樓，就在電梯旁邊。

examples.en: The fourth stage of the recycling process involves transforming cleaned plastic into material suitable for new products.
examples.zh: 回收流程的第四階段是將清洗後的塑膠轉化為適合製造新產品的材料。

words.tip: 第四是fourth；forth意為向前，注意拼寫。

senses.en: to separate something into parts or share it among people
to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another
a major difference separating people or groups

examples.en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
examples.zh: 趁大家還沒來，我們先把蛋糕切成小塊吧。

examples.en: Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.
examples.zh: 獲得可靠網際網路服務的機會不均，可能加深城鄉社群之間的數字鴻溝。

words.tip: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。

senses.en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action.
Used with to to express what is likely or expected.

examples.en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
examples.zh: 你應該帶把傘，那些雲看起來很陰沉。

examples.en: Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.
examples.zh: 政府應確保所有兒童都能接受優質教育，不受家庭收入影響。

words.tip: ought是情態動詞，後接to do；否定為ought not to。

senses.en: to move your head down and up to communicate
a downward and upward head movement expressing a message

examples.en: She nodded when I offered her another cup of tea.
examples.zh: 我問她是否再來杯茶時，她點了點頭。

examples.en: During group discussions, participants may nod to show understanding without necessarily agreeing with the speaker's views.
examples.zh: 在小組討論中，參與者可能透過點頭表示理解，但並不一定贊同發言者的觀點。

words.tip: 過去式nodded；現在分詞nodding，均雙寫d。

senses.en: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture
not interesting or entertaining

examples.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
examples.zh: 毛巾在陽光下晾過後已經幹了。

examples.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱天氣會損害農作物，並威脅農業社群的糧食安全。

words.tip: 形容詞比較級drier；名詞dryer指烘乾裝置。

senses.en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water
A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use
To combine resources so people can use them together

examples.en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在室外游泳池游泳。

examples.en: Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
examples.zh: 小企業可以集中資源，購買單獨承擔會過於昂貴的裝置。

words.tip: pool resources指集中資源；play pool則指打美式檯球。

senses.en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands
to increase in amount or level
an act of moving upwards or an increase in level

examples.en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
examples.zh: 我們爬上山坡，然後停下來野餐。

examples.en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
examples.zh: 隨著住房成本持續上漲，許多年輕人難以在大城市獨立生活。

words.tip: 詞尾b不發音；climb a mountain不加介詞。

senses.en: Having a taste like sugar or honey.
Kind, gentle, or thoughtful.
A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.

examples.en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
examples.zh: 這些草莓已經夠甜了，不加糖也好吃。

examples.en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
examples.zh: 減少兒童含糖飲料的攝入，可能降低他們蛀牙和體重過度增長的風險。

words.tip: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

senses.en: A room used mainly for sleeping.

examples.en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
examples.zh: 我的臥室早晨陽光很充足。

examples.en: Children who share a bedroom may develop cooperation skills, but they also need sufficient privacy as they grow.
examples.zh: 共用臥室的孩子可能會培養合作能力，但隨著成長，他們也需要足夠的隱私。

words.tip: 可數名詞；a two-bedroom flat指兩居室公寓。

senses.en: To become impossible to see or find.
To stop existing.

examples.en: We watched the boat disappear into the thick fog.
examples.zh: 我們看著小船消失在濃霧中。

examples.en: Many traditional crafts may disappear unless governments support skilled workers and encourage younger generations to learn them.
examples.zh: 除非政府支援技藝工人並鼓勵年輕一代學習，否則許多傳統手藝可能消失。

words.tip: 通常是不及物動詞，不說 be disappeared。

senses.en: To suggest someone or something as a good choice.
To advise someone that a particular action would be beneficial.

examples.en: Can you recommend a quiet café near the station?
examples.zh: 你能推薦一家車站附近安靜的咖啡館嗎？

examples.en: Health experts recommend regular exercise to reduce stress and improve overall physical and mental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 健康專家建議經常運動，以減輕壓力並改善整體身心健康。

words.tip: 用recommend doing或recommend that從句。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

examples.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
examples.zh: 她出門前把水瓶裝滿了。

examples.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
examples.zh: 選擇可重複使用的瓶子而非一次性塑膠容器，有助於減少城市垃圾。

words.tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

senses.en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day
to eat a meal around midday

examples.en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊的一棵樹下吃了午飯。

examples.en: Providing nutritious school lunches can improve children's concentration and support healthier eating habits over time.
examples.zh: 提供營養豐富的學校午餐可以提高兒童的專注力，並幫助他們逐漸養成更健康的飲食習慣。

words.tip: 泛指吃午餐用have lunch，通常不加冠詞。

senses.en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice.
A loud call or cry made with the voice.

examples.en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
examples.zh: 我們朝河對岸大喊，卻沒有人聽見。

examples.en: In noisy classrooms, teachers may need to shout, which can strain their voices over time.
examples.zh: 在嘈雜的教室裡，教師可能需要大聲說話，長期如此會損傷嗓音。

words.tip: shout at常含生氣意味；shout to重在讓遠處的人聽見。

senses.en: Liked or preferred more than others
A person or thing someone likes best
A competitor considered most likely to win

examples.en: This blue sweater is my favorite winter item.
examples.zh: 這件藍色毛衣是我冬天最喜歡的一件衣服。

examples.en: Surveys of children's favorite leisure activities can help local authorities design more appealing public recreation spaces.
examples.zh: 調查兒童最喜歡的休閒活動，有助於地方政府設計更有吸引力的公共休閒空間。

collocations.zh: 一直備受喜愛的人或物

words.tip: favorite是美式拼寫，英式為favourite；通常不用most修飾。

senses.en: To move someone or something from one place to another.
To change to another vehicle, school, or institution.
The act of moving something or someone to another place.

examples.en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
examples.zh: 請把相機裡的照片傳到我的膝上型電腦上。

examples.en: Governments should support the transfer of clean technology to regions that still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 政府應支援向仍高度依賴化石燃料的地區轉移清潔技術。

words.tip: 名詞重音在首音節；過去式transferred雙寫r。

senses.en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like
Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more

examples.en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
examples.zh: 我們花了一下午探訪港口附近的狹窄街巷。

examples.en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
examples.zh: 學校應鼓勵學生在選擇深造科目前探索不同的職業方向。

words.tip: 作及物動詞時直接接地點或問題，不加about。

senses.en: not curved or bent
directly, without turning or stopping
honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

examples.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
examples.zh: 用尺子畫一條直線。

examples.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
examples.zh: 在山區修建筆直的道路可能成本高昂，還可能破壞自然棲息地。

words.tip: straight本身可作副詞，不用加-ly。

senses.en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.

examples.en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
examples.zh: 那位運動員在早上的比賽前伸展了雙腿。

examples.en: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
examples.zh: 年輕運動員需要均衡的訓練計劃，在追求卓越運動表現的同時保護健康。

words.tip: athlete常泛指運動員，不只指田徑選手。

senses.en: completely; in every way or to the fullest degree

examples.en: I totally forgot to bring my swimming costume.
examples.zh: 我完全忘了帶泳衣。

examples.en: Online courses cannot totally replace classroom teaching because students also benefit from direct social interaction.
examples.zh: 線上課程無法完全取代課堂教學，因為學生也能從直接的社互動動中受益。

words.tip: 語氣較強；正式寫作中常可換用completely或entirely。

senses.en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things.
To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly.
Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.

examples.en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
examples.zh: 我在外套口袋裡找到了丟失的鑰匙。

examples.en: Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
examples.zh: 當無法上網或網路不穩定時，袖珍詞典對語言學習者仍然很有用。

words.tip: pocket money指零花錢，英式英語中常用。

senses.en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday

examples.en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
examples.zh: 我們通常星期五在家一起做晚飯。

examples.en: Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.
examples.zh: 允許員工星期五居家辦公，可能減輕通勤壓力並提高工作滿意度。

words.tip: 首字母大寫；on Friday，但 next Friday 前不加 on。

senses.en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.
To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.

examples.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
examples.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面覺得冷。

examples.en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
examples.zh: 薄層隔熱材料能提高能源效率，同時不會明顯減少建築內部的可用空間。

words.tip: 形容身材時，thin不一定褒義；slim通常含讚美。

senses.en: At the side of someone or something.

examples.en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
examples.zh: 請把你的溼靴子放在門旁邊。

examples.en: Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.
examples.zh: 在城市河流旁修建步道可以鼓勵身體活動，並讓居民更容易親近自然。

words.tip: beside表示“在旁邊”；besides表示“此外；除……之外”。

senses.en: Often or many times

examples.en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
examples.zh: 鄰居經常給我們送來她園子裡種的蔬菜。

examples.en: People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.
examples.zh: 經常使用公共交通的人，出行開支可能低於每天開車的人。

words.tip: 通常放實義動詞前、be動詞後，與often近義。

senses.en: In the correct or suitable way.
Completely or to the degree that is needed.

examples.en: The kitchen door will not close properly in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天廚房的門總是關不嚴。

examples.en: Public recycling schemes are more effective when residents understand how to sort household waste properly.
examples.zh: 當居民瞭解如何正確分類生活垃圾時，公共回收計劃會更有效。

words.tip: 修飾動作常用properly；修飾名詞用proper。

senses.en: To some extent, but not completely.

examples.en: The path was partly covered with fallen leaves.
examples.zh: 小路上有一部分被落葉覆蓋了。

examples.en: The rise in cycling is partly due to improved infrastructure and growing concern about air quality.
examples.zh: 騎腳踏車的人增多，部分原因是基礎設施改善以及人們更加關注空氣質量。

words.tip: 表示部分而非全部；常用partly because說明原因。

senses.en: in or to another place

examples.en: This café is full, so let's eat elsewhere.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館坐滿了，我們去別處吃吧。

examples.en: When local housing becomes unaffordable, young workers often move elsewhere in search of better living conditions.
examples.zh: 當本地住房變得難以負擔時，年輕勞動者往往會遷往別處，尋找更好的生活條件。

words.tip: 本身是副詞，通常不說in elsewhere或to elsewhere。

senses.en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity
become twice as much, or make something twice as much
an amount that is twice as large as another

examples.en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午飯點了雙份米飯。

examples.en: The city plans to double its investment in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 該市計劃將腳踏車基礎設施投資增加一倍，以緩解交通擁堵。

words.tip: double表示變為原來的兩倍，即增加一倍。

senses.en: Containing nothing or having no people inside.
To remove everything from a container or place.
Lacking real meaning, value, or sincere intention.

examples.en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
examples.zh: 我開啟餅乾盒時，裡面已經空了。

examples.en: Converting empty office buildings into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
examples.zh: 將空置辦公樓改造成可負擔住房，可以幫助城市緩解住房短缺，而不必向周邊鄉村擴張。

words.tip: empty強調裡面沒有東西；vacant常指房屋或職位空缺。

senses.en: all the people who live together in one home
relating to a home and its everyday needs

examples.en: Everyone in our household takes turns washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 我們家每個人都輪流洗碗。

examples.en: Rising energy prices place considerable pressure on household budgets, particularly among families with lower incomes.
examples.zh: 能源價格上漲給家庭預算帶來了很大壓力，低收入家庭尤其如此。

words.tip: household強調同住一戶，不一定有親屬關係。

senses.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit
a book or resource giving useful information or instructions
to show someone the way or help them decide

examples.en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
examples.zh: 導遊帶我們穿過市場裡狹窄的街道。

examples.en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
examples.zh: 教師應引導學生尋找可靠的資訊來源，而不是直接給出每個問題的答案。

words.tip: 指南用a guide to；指導某人完成用guide someone through。

senses.en: a lack of sound or speech
to stop someone or something making noise or expressing opinions

examples.en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
examples.zh: 外面下著雪，我們靜靜地坐著。

examples.en: Extended periods of silence in classrooms can give students valuable time to reflect on difficult questions.
examples.zh: 課堂上較長的安靜時段可以給學生寶貴的時間來思考難題。

words.tip: in silence意為默默地；silent是形容詞。

senses.en: Protected from danger, or firmly fixed in place.
To successfully obtain something important.
To fasten something firmly or protect it from harm.

examples.en: Check that the ladder is secure before climbing up.
examples.zh: 爬上去之前，檢查梯子是否穩固。

examples.en: Governments should ensure that citizens have secure access to clean water during periods of drought.
examples.zh: 政府應確保公民在乾旱期間能可靠地獲得清潔用水。

words.tip: secure可作形容詞，也可作及物動詞表示爭取到。

senses.en: the number equal to six times ten

examples.en: My grandfather turned sixty and celebrated with a picnic.
examples.zh: 我爺爺滿六十歲時，辦了一次野餐來慶祝。

examples.en: The survey found that sixty percent of respondents preferred reliable buses to additional parking spaces.
examples.zh: 調查發現，百分之六十的受訪者更希望公交服務可靠，而不是增加停車位。

words.tip: sixty重音在首音節；sixteen通常重讀末音節。

senses.en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed.
To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so.
Showing a time earlier than the correct time.

examples.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
examples.zh: 我們沿著河邊慢慢散步。

examples.en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
examples.zh: 公共交通擴建進展緩慢，可能會削弱通勤者放棄私家車的意願。

words.tip: slow多作形容詞；修飾一般動作通常用slowly。

senses.en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another
a process of personal change or development over time
to travel from one place to another

examples.en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
examples.zh: 這趟火車旅程帶我們穿過了白雪覆蓋的群山。

examples.en: Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
examples.zh: 改善鐵路服務可以縮短每日通勤時間，並鼓勵通勤者不開車出門。

words.tip: journey側重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

senses.en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
to become yellow or make something yellow

examples.en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
examples.zh: 她挑了一把黃色雨傘，準備在雨中散步。

examples.en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
examples.zh: 黃葉可能表明城市樹木正受到缺水或土壤條件不佳的影響。

words.tip: 可作動詞表示變黃；不要用它描述人的種族。

senses.en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light.
To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.

examples.en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 貓在陽光照著的廚房地板上追逐自己的影子。

examples.en: Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.
examples.zh: 讓學生跟隨經驗豐富的護士學習，有助於他們瞭解醫療職業的實際要求。

words.tip: shadow指具體影子；shade多指遮陽的陰涼處。

senses.en: To try very hard to do something difficult.
To fight or move forcefully against someone or something.
A difficult effort to achieve something or overcome opposition.

examples.en: I struggled to carry the heavy bags up the stairs.
examples.zh: 我費力地把那些沉重的袋子提上樓梯。

examples.en: Many young adults struggle to find affordable housing in cities where wages have not kept pace with rents.
examples.zh: 在工資漲幅趕不上房租的城市，許多年輕人很難找到負擔得起的住房。

words.tip: struggle to do表示做某事很吃力，不保證成功。

senses.en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday

examples.en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們通常在星期一去市場買新鮮水果。

examples.en: Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.
examples.zh: 許多員工覺得星期一早上壓力很大，因為他們必須處理週末積壓的任務。

words.tip: 星期首字母大寫；用on Monday，但next Monday前不加on。

senses.en: The leader of a team or person commanding a vessel.
To lead a team or command a ship.
An officer holding a particular rank in the armed forces.

examples.en: Our captain gathered the team before the final match.
examples.zh: 決賽前，我們的隊長把全隊召集到一起。

examples.en: A team captain can encourage cooperation by ensuring that every player feels valued and included.
examples.zh: 隊長可以透過確保每位隊員都感到受到重視和接納來促進合作。

words.tip: 軍銜含義隨軍種變化；海軍中通常指上校。

senses.en: Any longer, usually in negative statements.

examples.en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
examples.zh: 我不再坐公交車上學了。

examples.en: Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.
examples.zh: 許多員工不再每天通勤，因為僱主如今提供靈活的工作安排。

words.tip: 表示“不再”；英式常寫any more，數量“更多”須分寫。

senses.en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation
to avoid something unpleasant or harmful
the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions

examples.en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
examples.zh: 我們的兔子從圍欄的一處小縫隙逃走了。

examples.en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
examples.zh: 便利可達的公園讓城市居民得以遠離擁擠的街道，並有機會親近自然。

words.tip: 逃離某處用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名詞。

senses.en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort
feeling relaxed and confident in a situation
having enough money to live well without financial worry

examples.en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
examples.zh: 這把柔軟的椅子很舒服，足以讓人午睡一會兒。

examples.en: Comfortable classrooms with adequate lighting can help students concentrate and participate more actively in lessons.
examples.zh: 舒適且照明充足的教室有助於學生集中注意力，更積極地參與課堂活動。

words.tip: comfortable指舒服；convenient指方便。

senses.en: not one or the other of two
not either of two people or things
used to add another negative statement

examples.en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
examples.zh: 兩件夾克都不合身，所以我會繼續挑選。

examples.en: Neither approach can solve traffic congestion alone, so cities need a combination of investment and regulation.
examples.zh: 兩種方法都無法單獨解決交通擁堵，因此城市需要將投資與監管相結合。

words.tip: neither只用於兩者；接單數名詞，常與nor搭配。

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

examples.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
examples.zh: 她把一條厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

examples.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
examples.zh: 厚厚的隔熱層可以減少熱量流失，降低冬季家庭能源開支。

words.tip: 形容液體時指黏稠，不一定表示味道濃。

senses.en: having little distance from one side to the other
limited in range or achieved by only a small margin
to become or make something less wide or extensive

examples.en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
examples.zh: 這條狹窄的小路只容得下我們排成一列走。

examples.en: Governments should invest in rural schools to narrow the educational gap between urban and remote communities.
examples.zh: 政府應投資鄉村學校，縮小城市與偏遠社群之間的教育差距。

words.tip: narrow down表示縮小選擇範圍，不指道路變窄。

senses.en: Tell someone what you think they should do
Officially give someone information about something

examples.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a few days.
examples.zh: 醫生建議我休息幾天。

examples.en: Schools should advise students on career options before they choose subjects for further study.
examples.zh: 學校應在學生選擇進修科目之前，就職業選擇向他們提供建議。

words.tip: advise是動詞；advice是不可數名詞，詞尾發/s/。

senses.en: two or more things joined or used together
a sequence used to open a lock

examples.en: This soup has a delicious combination of herbs and vegetables.
examples.zh: 這道湯把香草與蔬菜搭配得十分美味。

examples.en: A combination of affordable housing and reliable public transport can improve living standards in growing cities.
examples.zh: 經濟適用的住房與可靠的公共交通相結合，可以提高發展中城市的生活水平。

words.tip: 常用a combination of A and B表示兩者結合。

senses.en: to need someone's help or depend on something
to trust someone or something to act as expected

examples.en: I rely on my bicycle to get to work.
examples.zh: 我靠腳踏車通勤。

examples.en: Communities that rely heavily on tourism may face economic difficulties when visitor numbers suddenly decline.
examples.zh: 高度依賴旅遊業的社群，在遊客數量驟降時可能面臨經濟困難。

collocations.en: rely on someone to do something

words.tip: 不直接接賓語：用rely on或rely upon。

senses.en: Feel grateful for something someone has done.
Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something.
Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.

examples.en: I really appreciate you watering my plants while I was away.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你在我不在的時候幫忙給植物澆水。

examples.en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
examples.zh: 政策制定者需要理解農村社群在獲取醫療及其他基本服務時面臨的困難。

words.tip: 可接名詞或動名詞，不接to do；感謝幫助用appreciate your help。

senses.en: The place and conditions in which something happens.
A position or option controlling how a device works.
The metal structure that holds a gemstone in jewellery.

examples.en: The lakeside garden provides a peaceful setting for lunch.
examples.zh: 湖邊的花園為午餐提供了寧靜的環境。

examples.en: Children often develop stronger communication skills in a supportive educational setting that encourages cooperation rather than competition.
examples.zh: 在鼓勵合作而非競爭的支援性教育環境中，兒童通常能培養出更強的溝通能力。

words.tip: 環境義常用in a setting；裝置設定常用複數settings。

senses.en: Located above another part or nearer the top.
Higher in rank, level, or position within a range.

examples.en: Keep the spare blankets on the upper shelf.
examples.zh: 把備用毯子放在上層架子上。

examples.en: Residents on the upper floors of apartment buildings may face difficulties when lifts stop working.
examples.zh: 公寓樓高層住戶在電梯停運時可能會遇到困難。

words.tip: 通常放在名詞前，如upper floor；反義詞是lower。

senses.en: Ready to deal with something because of previous planning.
Willing to do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant.

examples.en: With spare batteries packed, we were prepared for a blackout.
examples.zh: 備用電池已經備好，我們做好了應對停電的準備。

examples.en: Graduates who gain practical experience are often better prepared for the demands of a competitive labour market.
examples.zh: 有實踐經驗的畢業生往往更能應對競爭激烈的勞動力市場的要求。

words.tip: prepared for接名詞；prepared to do可表願意。

senses.en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied.
Full of people, traffic, or activity.
Already being used, especially a telephone line.

examples.en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
examples.zh: 我現在正忙著做晚餐要喝的湯。

examples.en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
examples.zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能讓人不願騎車，除非地方政府提供與機動車流隔離的安全路線。

words.tip: 用busy doing或busy with，不用busy to do。

senses.en: To combine different substances or things.
A combination of different substances, people, or things.
To spend time socially with other people.

examples.en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和雞蛋放進大碗裡拌勻。

examples.en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
examples.zh: 成功的社群通常包含多種住房型別，以滿足不同收入人群的需求。

words.tip: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or make someone stop sleeping
the disturbed water left behind a moving boat
a gathering to remember someone who has recently died

examples.en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
examples.zh: 請在你出門上班前叫醒我。

examples.en: People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
examples.zh: 在固定時間醒來的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠規律。

words.tip: 過去式woke，過去分詞woken；常與up連用。

senses.en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers

examples.en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
examples.zh: 太陽還沒升起，我們就到了機場。

examples.en: Expanding an airport may boost tourism, but it can also increase noise pollution for nearby residents.
examples.zh: 擴建機場可能促進旅遊業，但也可能加重附近居民受到的噪聲汙染。

words.tip: 在機場通常用at the airport；航站樓是terminal。

senses.en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action
used to emphasize that we do something, not others

examples.en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
examples.zh: 我們看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。

examples.en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
examples.zh: 透過參與社群專案，我們可以培養實用技能並增進鄰里關係。

words.tip: by ourselves可指獨自，也可指不靠別人。

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.
To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

examples.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
examples.zh: 一隻棕色的小狗正在門邊睡覺。

examples.en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
examples.zh: 在乾旱時期，植物為了儲存水分會減緩生長，草也常因此變成褐色。

words.tip: brown作動詞常用於烹飪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

senses.en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons

examples.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
examples.zh: 他在面試前熨好了自己的藍襯衫。

examples.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
examples.zh: 一些僱主要求員工穿正式襯衫，另一些則允許更休閒的著裝。

words.tip: shirt通常指襯衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

senses.en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes
giving close attention to details

examples.en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
examples.zh: 小心拿那個碗，那是奶奶以前用的。

examples.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
examples.zh: 周密的規劃可以幫助城市擴充套件公共交通，同時控制建設成本。

words.tip: be careful with後接物；be careful to後接動詞。

senses.en: Pleasant to look at
Having qualities that make people interested in choosing something

examples.en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
examples.zh: 玫瑰盛開時，這座花園顯得格外美麗。

examples.en: Flexible working hours make teaching a more attractive career option for some university graduates.
examples.zh: 靈活的工作時間讓教師職業對一些大學畢業生更具吸引力。

words.tip: 既可形容外表好看，也可形容方案、薪資誘人。

senses.en: To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position.
To move or put something somewhere quietly or quickly.
A small piece of paper, or a minor mistake.

examples.en: I slipped on the wet floor but stayed upright.
examples.zh: 我在溼地板上滑了一下，但沒有摔倒。

examples.en: Hospitals should keep floors dry to reduce the risk of patients slipping and injuring themselves.
examples.zh: 醫院應保持地面乾燥，以降低病人滑倒受傷的風險。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為slipped，雙寫p。

senses.en: The flesh of animals eaten as food.

examples.en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
examples.zh: 我們把生肉和蔬菜分開放在冰箱裡。

examples.en: Reducing meat consumption may lower the environmental impact of food production in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，減少肉類消費可能降低食品生產對環境的影響。

words.tip: 泛指食用肉時不可數；meats指不同種類的肉。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition

senses.zh: 成功的人或事物；受益者
senses.en: someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation

examples.en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
examples.zh: 獲勝者舉起獎盃，人群歡呼起來。

examples.en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
examples.zh: 當更激烈的競爭促使企業降價並改善服務時，消費者可能成為主要受益者。

words.tip: winner 指獲勝者；winning 可作形容詞修飾隊伍。

senses.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
the large round ball used in this game

examples.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
examples.zh: 放學後，我們在公園打籃球。

examples.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
examples.zh: 籃球等團隊運動有助於年輕人培養協作能力，同時增強體質。

words.tip: play basketball不加冠詞；指一個球用a basketball。

senses.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

examples.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我祖父每週日都和朋友打高爾夫球。

examples.en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
examples.zh: 高爾夫球場可以吸引遊客，但養護草坪可能需要大量用水。

collocations.zh: 高爾夫球杆；高爾夫俱樂部

words.tip: 球類運動前通常不加冠詞：play golf。

senses.en: a series of connected metal rings
connected shops, events, or other things forming a series
to fasten someone or something with a chain

examples.en: He secured his bicycle with a heavy metal chain.
examples.zh: 他用一條沉重的金屬鏈鎖好了腳踏車。

examples.en: Large supermarket chains can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten small independent shops.
examples.zh: 大型連鎖超市可以提供更低的價格，但其擴張可能威脅獨立小商店。

collocations.en: chain a bicycle to a railing
collocations.zh: 用鏈條把腳踏車鎖在欄杆上

words.tip: a chain of後接複數名詞，表示相連的一系列事物。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

examples.en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
examples.zh: 她輕輕地把球踢向弟弟。

examples.en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
examples.zh: 孩子們透過能夠改善協調能力、培養團隊精神的活動學習踢球和投球。

words.tip: kick用腳踢；hit泛指擊打，不限定用什麼。

senses.en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.
