examples.zh: 這些黃色窗簾確實讓我們的小廚房明亮了許多。

examples.en: Planting colourful flowers can brighten neglected public spaces and encourage residents to take greater pride in their neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 種植色彩鮮豔的花卉可以讓無人照管的公共空間煥發生機，並增強居民對社群的自豪感。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物；brighten up也指心情好轉。

senses.en: The sport of competing to move faster than others.
Designed or used for races.

examples.en: My cousin enjoys watching bicycle racing on weekend afternoons.
examples.zh: 我表親喜歡在週末下午看腳踏車比賽。

examples.en: Professional motor racing encourages technological innovation, but its environmental impact remains a subject of debate.
examples.zh: 職業賽車運動推動技術創新，但其環境影響仍存在爭議。

words.tip: 作運動名稱通常不可數；一場比賽用a race。

senses.en: To burn suddenly brighter or become suddenly stronger.
A sudden bright light or a device producing a warning light.
To become wider towards one end.

examples.en: The flames flared as he added another dry branch.
examples.zh: 他又添了一根幹樹枝，火焰頓時旺了起來。

examples.en: Tensions can flare when urban development projects fail to address the concerns of local residents.
examples.zh: 城市開發專案若未能回應當地居民的關切，緊張局勢就可能驟然加劇。

words.tip: flare up可指火勢突然變旺，也指矛盾或病症發作。

senses.en: To search for or handle something with awkward hand movements.
To fail to hold something or deal with something smoothly.

examples.en: I fumbled for my keys in the dark hallway.
examples.zh: 我在漆黑的走廊裡摸索著找鑰匙。

examples.en: Users often fumble with unfamiliar controls, highlighting the importance of intuitive design in public transport systems.
examples.zh: 使用者操作不熟悉的控制裝置時常常手忙腳亂，這凸顯了公共交通系統中直觀設計的重要性。

words.tip: fumble for表示摸索尋找；with表示笨拙擺弄。

senses.en: Thick, stiff paper used for boxes and packaging

examples.en: We cut the cardboard into shapes for a model house.
examples.zh: 我們把硬紙板剪成各種形狀，用來製作房屋模型。

examples.en: Replacing plastic packaging with recycled cardboard can reduce waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.
examples.zh: 用再生硬紙板替代塑膠包裝可以減少廢棄物，並促進更可持續的消費。

words.tip: 通常不可數；一張硬紙板說a sheet of cardboard。

senses.en: happening or existing at exactly the same time

examples.en: Simultaneous cheers erupted from both sides of the street.
examples.zh: 街道兩邊同時爆發出歡呼聲。

examples.en: Simultaneous investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure can reduce congestion more effectively than isolated measures.
examples.zh: 同時投資公共交通和腳踏車基礎設施，比採取單一措施更能有效緩解交通擁堵。

words.tip: 強調時間重合；副詞simultaneously表示同時地。

senses.en: shining with many small flashes of light
containing bubbles of gas

senses.zh: 生動有趣的；才華橫溢的
senses.en: lively, clever, and entertaining

examples.en: She held the sparkling bracelet up to the sunlight.
examples.zh: 她把閃閃發亮的手鍊舉到陽光下。

examples.en: Restaurants can reduce packaging waste by serving locally filtered sparkling water rather than imported bottled alternatives.
examples.zh: 餐廳可以供應本地過濾的氣泡水，代替進口瓶裝水，從而減少包裝廢棄物。

words.tip: 飲用水中sparkling指含氣泡，still指無氣泡。

senses.en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.

examples.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
examples.zh: 我們在沙灘上打排球，一直打到日落。

examples.en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
examples.zh: 排球等團隊運動既能幫助學生培養溝通能力，也能鼓勵他們定期鍛鍊。

words.tip: 指運動時不可數，play volleyball中不加冠詞。

senses.en: to close and open one eye quickly as a signal
a quick closing and opening of one eye as a signal

examples.en: My sister winked at me across the dinner table.
examples.zh: 姐姐隔著餐桌朝我眨了一隻眼。

examples.en: A friendly wink may communicate shared understanding, although its meaning can vary considerably across different cultures.
examples.zh: 友善的眨眼可能傳達彼此的默契，但其含義在不同文化間可能有很大差異。

words.tip: wink常指單眼示意；blink指自然眨眼。

senses.en: A person who competes in boxing.

examples.en: The boxer pulled on her gloves before training.
examples.zh: 這位拳擊運動員在訓練前戴上了手套。

examples.en: A professional boxer needs disciplined training and adequate recovery time to maintain both performance and long-term health.
examples.zh: 職業拳擊運動員需要有規律的訓練和充分的恢復時間，以保持競技狀態和長期健康。

words.tip: box作動詞可表示打拳；boxer是拳擊運動員。

senses.en: thick oily material used for lubrication or produced during cooking
to spread oil or fat over a surface

examples.en: There was grease on my hands after fixing the bicycle.
examples.zh: 修完腳踏車後，我的手上沾滿了油汙。

examples.en: Restaurants should prevent cooking grease from entering drains because it can block pipes and increase maintenance costs.
examples.zh: 餐館應防止烹飪油脂流入下水道，因為這會堵塞管道並增加維護費用。

words.tip: 名詞讀/ɡriːs/；動詞也常讀/ɡriːz/。

senses.en: A holiday taken by a couple just after their wedding.
An early period when a relationship or situation goes well.
To take a holiday together just after getting married.

examples.en: They spent their honeymoon in a quiet seaside village.
examples.zh: 他們在一個安靜的海邊村莊度過了蜜月。

examples.en: Popular honeymoon destinations can support local economies, but excessive tourism may damage fragile coastal environments.
examples.zh: 熱門蜜月目的地能促進當地經濟，但過度旅遊可能破壞脆弱的沿海環境。

words.tip: 英式常說on honeymoon，美式常說on a honeymoon。

senses.en: moving or directed towards the inside or centre
felt privately in the mind rather than shown openly
towards the inside or centre of something

examples.en: An inward push was enough to open the gate.
examples.zh: 只需向內一推，就能開啟大門。

examples.en: An inward flow of investment can help developing economies improve infrastructure and create employment opportunities.
examples.zh: 投資流入能夠幫助發展中經濟體改善基礎設施並創造就業機會。

words.tip: 形容詞用inward；副詞英式英語也常用inwards。

senses.en: Able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out.
Likely to continue or remain effective for a long time.

examples.en: These durable boots have survived years of muddy walks.
examples.zh: 這雙耐用的靴子陪我在泥路上走了多年，至今還沒壞。

examples.en: Choosing durable products rather than disposable alternatives can reduce household waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
examples.zh: 選擇耐用品而非一次性替代品，可以減少家庭垃圾並節約寶貴的自然資源。

words.tip: 耐用品通常用複數名詞durables或durable goods。

senses.en: To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts.
To examine material carefully to find what is useful.

examples.en: Sift the flour before adding it to the bowl.
examples.zh: 把麵粉篩過後再加入碗中。

examples.en: Researchers must sift through large amounts of evidence before drawing reliable conclusions about the causes of unemployment.
examples.zh: 研究人員必須仔細篩查大量證據，才能對失業原因得出可靠的結論。

words.tip: sift through表示仔細檢視，尋找有用資訊。

senses.en: decorative paper used to cover interior walls
an image displayed behind icons on a screen
to cover walls with decorative paper

examples.en: We chose pale green wallpaper for our small bedroom.
examples.zh: 我們為小臥室選了淺綠色牆紙。

examples.en: Choosing durable wallpaper can reduce the frequency of interior renovations and limit household material waste.
examples.zh: 選擇耐用的牆紙可以減少室內翻新的頻率，降低家庭材料浪費。

words.tip: wallpaper通常不可數；一卷用a roll of wallpaper。

senses.en: The amount of light something gives off or reflects.
The quality of having strong, vivid colours.
The ability to understand and learn things quickly.

examples.en: I lowered the screen's brightness before watching a film.
examples.zh: 看電影前，我調低了螢幕亮度。

examples.en: Reducing the brightness of outdoor lighting at night can save energy and limit disruption to wildlife.
examples.zh: 夜間降低戶外照明亮度可以節約能源，並減少對野生動物的干擾。

words.tip: 不可數；螢幕的“亮度”用brightness，不用lightness。

senses.en: A soft material full of holes that absorbs liquid.
A simple aquatic animal with many pores in its body.
To clean or wipe something using a damp sponge.

examples.en: Use a damp sponge to wipe the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 用溼海綿擦一下廚房的桌子。

examples.en: Urban wetlands act like a sponge, absorbing excess rainwater and reducing the risk of flooding.
examples.zh: 城市溼地就像海綿，能吸收多餘的雨水，降低洪澇風險。

words.tip: 比喻吸收能力強時，常用like a sponge。

senses.en: to wind into a series of circles or rings
a series of connected loops in wire, rope, or tubing

examples.en: Please coil the rope before putting it away.
examples.zh: 請先把繩子盤好再收起來。

examples.en: Engineers coil long pipes beneath buildings so that heat can be transferred efficiently from the ground.
examples.zh: 工程師在建築物下方盤繞長管道，以便高效地傳遞地下熱量。

words.tip: 作動詞可及物或不及物，強調繞成圈或螺旋。

senses.en: torn and worn, or wearing clothes in this condition
having an uneven edge, outline, or pattern

examples.en: He patched the ragged sleeves of his old coat.
examples.zh: 他補好了舊外套上破破爛爛的袖子。

examples.en: Discarded clothing, including ragged garments, can be recycled into insulation rather than sent to landfill.
examples.zh: 廢棄衣物，包括破舊衣服，可以回收製成隔熱材料，而非送往垃圾填埋場。

words.tip: 形容詞ragged讀兩個音節，結尾為/ɪd/。

senses.en: To spin or move around very quickly.
A spinning movement or a confusing rush of activity.

examples.en: Dry leaves whirled around us in the wind.
examples.zh: 乾枯的樹葉在風中繞著我們打轉。

examples.en: As urban life accelerates, many workers become caught in a whirl of meetings and deadlines.
examples.zh: 隨著城市生活節奏加快，許多上班族陷入接連不斷的會議和截止期限之中。

words.tip: give it a whirl是口語，意為“試一試”。

senses.en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

examples.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
examples.zh: 我們買了一隻小木船作為紀念品。

examples.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
examples.zh: 購買當地製作的紀念品可以支援傳統工藝，併為依靠旅遊業的社群帶來收入。

words.tip: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活動的紀念品。

senses.en: A small, rounded or cylindrical piece of compressed material.

examples.en: Each rabbit received a few food pellets with fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 每隻兔子都分到了一些顆粒飼料和新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: Heating systems that burn wood pellets can reduce reliance on fossil fuels when the wood is sustainably sourced.
examples.zh: 如果木材來源可持續，燃燒木顆粒的供暖系統可以減少對化石燃料的依賴。

words.tip: 指成形的小顆粒，常見於飼料、燃料等。

senses.en: Having a pattern of long, narrow bands.

examples.en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件條紋襯衫和深藍色牛仔褲。

examples.en: The striped coats of certain animals may help them avoid detection in their natural habitats.
examples.zh: 某些動物帶條紋的皮毛可能有助於它們在自然棲息地中避免被發現。

words.tip: striped意為有條紋的；strip的過去式是stripped。

senses.en: A card game involving bets on the strength of players' hands.
A metal rod used to move fuel in a fire.

examples.en: We played poker with plastic counters after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚飯後，我們用塑膠籌碼玩撲克。

examples.en: Researchers study poker to understand how people make decisions when information is incomplete and outcomes are uncertain.
examples.zh: 研究人員透過研究撲克，瞭解人們在資訊不完整、結果不確定時如何作出決策。

words.tip: poker是特定撲克遊戲，不泛指所有紙牌。

senses.en: A light shoe with straps that leaves much of the foot uncovered.

examples.en: A small stone got stuck inside my sandal.
examples.zh: 一顆小石子卡進了我的涼鞋裡。

examples.en: In warm climates, sandals are popular because their open design allows air to circulate around the feet.
examples.zh: 在氣候溫暖的地區，涼鞋很受歡迎，因為其開放式設計能讓腳部通風。

words.tip: 單隻用sandal，一雙用a pair of sandals。

senses.en: A vegetable with long, crisp stalks, eaten raw or cooked.

examples.en: I chopped some celery and added it to the soup.
examples.zh: 我切了些芹菜，放進湯裡。

examples.en: Growing vegetables such as celery locally can reduce transport costs and provide communities with fresh produce.
examples.zh: 在本地種植芹菜等蔬菜可以降低運輸成本，併為社群提供新鮮農產品。

words.tip: 通常不可數；一根芹菜莖用a stalk of celery。

senses.en: A pleasant smell, especially from flowers or perfume.
A liquid or substance used to give a pleasant smell.

examples.en: The fragrance of fresh roses filled the small kitchen.
examples.zh: 鮮玫瑰的香氣瀰漫在小廚房裡。

examples.en: Some consumers prefer products without added fragrance because scented ingredients can irritate sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 一些消費者偏愛不新增香料的產品，因為芳香成分可能刺激敏感肌膚。

words.tip: fragrance通常指好聞的氣味；smell則可褒可貶。

senses.en: a light material from tree bark, used for sealing bottles
a piece of cork used to close a bottle
to close a bottle with a cork

examples.en: The cork popped out and rolled under the table.
examples.zh: 軟木塞砰地彈出，滾到了桌子底下。

examples.en: Cork is a renewable material that can be harvested without cutting down the entire tree.
examples.zh: 軟木是一種可再生材料，採收時無需砍倒整棵樹。

words.tip: 表示軟木材料時不可數；表示軟木塞時可數。

senses.en: The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.

examples.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個星期天早上都沿河騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
examples.zh: 投資建設安全的腳踏車道可以鼓勵通勤者選擇更健康、汙染更少的交通方式。

words.tip: 表示這項活動時通常不可數；常說go cycling。

senses.en: A small device that produces a flame to light things.

examples.en: Dad used a long lighter to light the candle.
examples.zh: 爸爸用長柄點火器點燃了蠟燭。

examples.en: A refillable lighter may produce less plastic waste than disposable alternatives when used over a long period.
examples.zh: 長期使用時，可補充燃料的打火機可能比一次性產品產生更少的塑膠垃圾。

collocations.zh: 可充氣或加油的打火機

words.tip: 作名詞指打火機；也可為light的比較級，意為更輕的。

senses.en: An unpleasant layer of waste or bubbles on a liquid.
An insulting word for people considered extremely unpleasant or immoral.

examples.en: He skimmed the scum off the simmering soup.
examples.zh: 他撇去了燉煮中的湯表面的浮沫。

examples.en: A thick layer of scum on a pond may indicate excessive nutrient levels caused by agricultural runoff.
examples.zh: 池塘表面厚厚的浮垢可能表明農業徑流導致了水體營養物質過量。

words.tip: 通常不可數；用來指人時侮辱性很強，應避免。

senses.en: The part of a cooker or heater that produces heat

examples.en: She turned off the burner after the soup boiled.
examples.zh: 湯煮開後，她關掉了爐頭。

examples.en: Replacing inefficient gas burners with cleaner cooking technology can reduce indoor air pollution and improve health.
examples.zh: 用更清潔的烹飪技術替代低效燃氣爐頭，可以減少室內空氣汙染並改善健康。

collocations.en: put something on the back burner

words.tip: on the back burner比喻暫緩處理、擱置。

senses.en: A journey to a place important to someone's religion.
A visit to a place with special personal significance.

examples.en: My grandparents made a pilgrimage to the mountain temple.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母前往山中的寺廟朝聖。

examples.en: Religious pilgrimage can support local economies, but large visitor numbers may place pressure on fragile historic sites.
examples.zh: 宗教朝聖可以帶動當地經濟，但大量遊客可能給脆弱的歷史遺址帶來壓力。

words.tip: 常用make a pilgrimage to表示前往某地朝聖。

senses.en: A small amount of air, smoke, or steam released suddenly.
To breathe quickly and noisily after physical effort.
To release air or smoke, or swell with air.

examples.en: A puff of steam escaped from the kettle.
examples.zh: 一小團蒸汽從水壺裡冒了出來。

examples.en: Older buses release puffs of dark smoke, highlighting the need for cleaner public transport in cities.
examples.zh: 老舊公交車排出一團團黑煙，凸顯了城市發展更清潔公共交通的必要性。

words.tip: 一團煙用a puff of smoke；puff也可表示喘粗氣。

senses.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

examples.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
examples.zh: 她把一根黃瓜切成片，加入沙拉。

examples.en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
examples.zh: 在溫室中種植黃瓜可以提供穩定的食物供應，但為這些設施供暖需要消耗能源。

words.tip: 通常可數：a cucumber；表示食材時也可不可數。

senses.en: A title used before a man's surname or full name

examples.en: The children greeted their new neighbour as Mister Green.
examples.zh: 孩子們稱呼新鄰居為格林先生，並向他問好。

examples.en: In formal interviews, candidates may address a male interviewer as Mister followed by his surname.
examples.zh: 在正式面試中，應聘者可以用Mister加姓氏來稱呼男性面試官。

words.tip: 通常寫作Mr（美式Mr.），讀Mister，後接姓氏。

senses.en: any day from Monday to Friday

examples.en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比較安靜。

examples.en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
examples.zh: 延長圖書館工作日的開放時間，將有利於白天工作的學生。

words.tip: 指週一至週五，不保證當天實際上需要上班。

senses.en: a noticeable pleasant smell, especially from food or drink

examples.en: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香氣瀰漫了整個廚房。

examples.en: The aroma of freshly prepared food can enhance customers' dining experiences and influence their perception of quality.
examples.zh: 現做食物的香氣能夠提升顧客的用餐體驗，並影響他們對品質的判斷。

words.tip: 通常指令人愉悅的氣味，尤用於食物和飲品。

senses.en: a race in which teammates take turns completing sections
to pass information or broadcast signals to another person or place
an electrical switch controlled by another electrical circuit

examples.en: Our team dropped the baton during the school relay.
examples.zh: 我們隊在學校接力賽中掉了接力棒。

examples.en: Emergency services relay weather warnings to remote communities through local radio stations and mobile networks.
examples.zh: 應急部門透過地方廣播電臺和行動網路向偏遠社群傳達天氣警報。

words.tip: 動詞也讀/rɪˈleɪ/；relay a message指轉達訊息。

senses.en: To run slowly and steadily, usually for exercise.
A period of slow, steady running.
To knock or push something slightly, often accidentally.

examples.en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 我們每天早飯前都繞著公園慢跑。

examples.en: People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.
examples.zh: 經常慢跑的人無需昂貴的器材或健身房會員資格，也能改善心血管健康。

words.tip: jog someone's memory意為“喚起某人的記憶”。

senses.en: a light inside a protective container, often with a handle

examples.en: He carried a lantern along the dark garden path.
examples.zh: 他提著一盞燈，沿著漆黑的花園小徑走去。

examples.en: Solar lanterns provide affordable lighting in remote communities where reliable access to electricity remains limited.
examples.zh: 在仍難以穩定用電的偏遠社群，太陽能燈提供了價格實惠的照明。

words.tip: 指有外罩的燈，常可提攜；不等同於手電筒。

senses.en: a building where club members meet and use shared facilities

examples.en: We left our tennis bags outside the clubhouse.
examples.zh: 我們把網球包放在了俱樂部會所外面。

examples.en: A shared clubhouse can strengthen community ties by giving local sports teams a place to meet regularly.
examples.zh: 共用會所為當地運動隊提供定期聚會的場所，有助於加強社群聯絡。

words.tip: 指俱樂部使用的建築，不指俱樂部這個組織。

senses.en: Unpleasantly cold, though usually not extremely cold.
Showing little warmth or friendliness towards someone.

examples.en: It felt chilly outside, so I grabbed my jacket.
examples.zh: 外面有些冷，所以我拿上了夾克。

examples.en: Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.
examples.zh: 在寒冷天氣提供溫暖的公共場所，有助於保護老年居民免受寒冷引發的疾病侵害。

words.tip: chilly比freezing程度輕，也可形容態度冷淡。

senses.en: relating to Thailand, its people, or its language
the main language spoken in Thailand
a person from Thailand

examples.en: We shared a delicious Thai curry for dinner.
examples.zh: 晚飯我們一起吃了一道美味的泰式咖哩。

examples.en: Thai cuisine attracts international visitors and provides valuable opportunities for local restaurants and cooking schools.
examples.zh: 泰國菜吸引著國際遊客，也為當地餐館和烹飪學校提供了寶貴的機會。

words.tip: Thai首字母始終大寫；泰國是Thailand。

senses.en: having a pleasant flavour

examples.en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
examples.zh: 這道美味的湯很適合寒冷的夜晚。

examples.en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
examples.zh: 學校食堂可以提供用新鮮蔬菜和全穀物製作的美味餐食，鼓勵更健康的飲食。

words.tip: tasty指食物美味；tasteful指有品位。

senses.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

examples.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
examples.zh: 表親的婚禮之前，我需要理個髮。

examples.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
examples.zh: 在社群中心提供價格實惠的理髮服務，能讓實習理髮師在服務當地居民的同時積累實踐經驗。

words.tip: 說get或have a haircut，不說cut a haircut。

senses.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly.
To read something with great enthusiasm.
To consume or destroy large amounts of something.

examples.en: After swimming, we devoured the warm bread within minutes.
examples.zh: 游泳後，我們幾分鐘就狼吞虎嚥地吃光了熱麵包。

examples.en: Large infrastructure projects can devour public funds unless spending is carefully monitored throughout construction.
examples.zh: 大型基礎設施專案可能耗費鉅額公共資金，除非在整個施工過程中嚴格監督支出。

words.tip: 比eat語氣強；也可比喻大量閱讀或吞噬資源。

senses.en: bad luck or an unlucky event that causes difficulty

examples.en: We had the misfortune to miss the last train.
examples.zh: 我們很不巧，錯過了末班火車。

examples.en: Strong community networks can help families recover from financial misfortune without becoming isolated from society.
examples.zh: 緊密的社群互助網路能幫助家庭擺脫經濟困境，同時避免與社會隔絕。

words.tip: 表示厄運時不可數；表示具體不幸事件時可數。

senses.en: To become thicker, or make a liquid thicker.
To become or make something thicker or denser.

examples.en: Add a little flour to thicken the mushroom sauce.
examples.zh: 加一點麵粉，讓蘑菇醬變稠。

examples.en: As coastal fog thickens, transport operators may need to reduce services to maintain passenger safety.
examples.zh: 隨著沿海霧氣變濃，運輸運營商可能需要減少班次，以保障乘客安全。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物：thicken soup；soup thickens。

senses.en: A piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes.
A kitchen cupboard with shelves above for displaying dishes.
A person who dresses in a particular way.

examples.en: I put my clean socks in the bedroom dresser.
examples.zh: 我把乾淨襪子放進臥室的抽屜櫃裡。

examples.en: Restoring an old dresser rather than buying new furniture can reduce waste and conserve natural resources.
examples.zh: 修復舊抽屜櫃而非購買新傢俱，可以減少浪費並節約自然資源。

words.tip: 美式常指衣物抽屜櫃，英式常指餐具櫃。

senses.en: exchange a voucher or points for goods, services, or money
make up for a failure or restore a good reputation
recover something by paying the money owed on it

examples.en: You can redeem this voucher for a free lunch.
examples.zh: 你可以用這張代金券兌換一份免費午餐。

examples.en: Retailers increasingly allow customers to redeem loyalty points for products made from recycled materials.
examples.zh: 越來越多的零售商允許顧客用會員積分兌換再生材料製成的產品。

words.tip: redeem A for B 表示用券或積分A兌換B。

senses.en: To make something happen sooner or develop more quickly.
To move or act quickly, often because something is urgent.

examples.en: The warm sunshine hastened the melting of the snow.
examples.zh: 溫暖的陽光加快了積雪融化。

examples.en: Investment in renewable energy could hasten the transition towards a more sustainable and resilient economy.
examples.zh: 對可再生能源的投資可以加快向更可持續、更具韌性的經濟轉型。

words.tip: t不發音；hasten to do表示趕緊做某事。

senses.en: Experiencing bad things because of chance
Believed to bring bad luck

examples.en: We were unlucky to miss the bus by seconds.
examples.zh: 我們真倒黴，只差幾秒就錯過了公交車。

examples.en: Students who are unlucky enough to fall ill during examinations should be offered alternative assessment arrangements.
examples.zh: 不幸在考試期間生病的學生應獲得其他考核安排。

words.tip: unlucky強調運氣差，不等於unhappy（不開心）。

senses.en: So important or useful that it cannot be done without

examples.en: My bicycle is indispensable for getting to work.
examples.zh: 我的腳踏車是我上班不可缺少的交通工具。

examples.en: Reliable internet access has become indispensable for students who depend on digital platforms to complete their coursework.
examples.zh: 對於依靠數字平臺完成課程作業的學生來說，可靠的網路連線已變得不可或缺。

words.tip: 常接to或for；語氣比useful強，表示少不了。

senses.en: led or supported by someone with knowledge or experience

examples.en: We joined a guided walk through the forest yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我們參加了一次有嚮導帶領的森林徒步。

examples.en: Guided learning can help students build confidence before they begin working independently on complex tasks.
examples.zh: 有指導的學習可以幫助學生建立信心，為獨立完成複雜任務做好準備。

words.tip: guided tour指有導遊的遊覽；guided也是guide的過去分詞。

senses.en: Towards the outside or away from the centre

examples.en: The windows open outwards, so keep the balcony clear.
examples.zh: 窗戶向外開，所以請保持陽臺通暢。

examples.en: As cities expand outwards, surrounding farmland often disappears, creating concerns about food security and habitat loss.
examples.zh: 隨著城市向外擴張，周邊農田往往逐漸消失，引發人們對糧食安全和棲息地流失的擔憂。

words.tip: outwards 是副詞；作定語需用 outward。

senses.en: Happening suddenly, often without warning.
Speaking or behaving briefly in a way that seems rude.

examples.en: The bus came to an abrupt stop outside our house.
examples.zh: 公交車在我們家門外突然停了下來。

examples.en: Abrupt changes in government policy can create uncertainty for businesses and discourage long-term investment.
examples.zh: 政府政策的突然變化可能給企業帶來不確定性，並抑制長期投資。

words.tip: 形容變化指“突然的”；形容語氣或態度指“生硬的”。

senses.en: Very comfortable and expensive, often with beautiful surroundings or materials.

examples.en: Our hotel room had a luxurious bath overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 我們的酒店客房裡有一個可欣賞海景的豪華浴缸。

examples.en: Although luxurious resorts attract wealthy visitors, their high water consumption can place pressure on local resources.
examples.zh: 儘管豪華度假村能吸引富裕遊客，但其高耗水量會給當地資源帶來壓力。

words.tip: luxurious指豪華舒適；luxuriant多指植物繁茂。

senses.en: so bright that it is difficult to see
extremely impressive because of beauty, skill, or quality

examples.en: We shielded our eyes from the dazzling afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 我們遮住眼睛，躲避午後刺眼的陽光。

examples.en: Although dazzling performances attract visitors, sustained investment in local arts education is equally important.
examples.zh: 儘管精彩的演出能吸引遊客，持續投資本地藝術教育也同樣重要。

words.tip: 既可形容光線刺眼，也可形容表現精彩。

senses.en: to make something less heavy or less demanding
to become or make something brighter or paler
to make a mood or atmosphere more cheerful

examples.en: I removed two books to lighten my backpack.
examples.zh: 我拿出了兩本書，讓揹包輕一些。

examples.en: Employers can lighten staff workloads by simplifying administrative procedures and providing better tools for routine tasks.
examples.zh: 僱主可以透過簡化行政流程、為日常任務提供更好的工具來減輕員工的工作負擔。

words.tip: lighten可指減負或變亮；lighten up常指放輕鬆。

senses.en: visible on the outside rather than reflecting inner feelings
moving or directed away from the centre or starting point
towards the outside or away from the centre

examples.en: Despite her outward confidence, Leila felt nervous inside.
examples.zh: 儘管外表自信，萊拉內心卻很緊張。

examples.en: A city's outward appearance may improve through redevelopment, while underlying social inequalities remain largely unchanged.
examples.zh: 城市的外觀可能因改造而改善，但深層的社會不平等卻基本沒有改變。

words.tip: 作副詞時英式英語更常用outwards。

senses.en: not wanted or received with pleasure

examples.en: The loud music was an unwelcome interruption during dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐時響起的吵鬧音樂令人掃興。

examples.en: For many residents, rising rents are an unwelcome consequence of rapid development in urban areas.
examples.zh: 對許多居民而言，租金上漲是城市快速發展帶來的不受歡迎的後果。

words.tip: 可形容人、訊息或變化；feel unwelcome指感到不受歡迎。

senses.en: A small bed for a baby that can rock.
The place where something important first developed.
Hold someone or something gently and protectively.

examples.en: The baby slept peacefully in a wooden cradle.
examples.zh: 寶寶在木搖籃裡安靜地睡著。

examples.en: The region is often described as a cradle of agriculture because of its early farming settlements.
examples.zh: 由於擁有早期的農耕聚落，這一地區常被稱為農業的發源地。

words.tip: the cradle of 可比喻某種文明或活動的發源地。

senses.en: The soft, fleshy part inside a fruit.
A wet mixture of fibres used to make paper.
To crush something into a soft, wet mass.

examples.en: I prefer orange juice with plenty of pulp.
examples.zh: 我更喜歡含有豐富果肉的橙汁。

examples.en: Recycling facilities turn used paper into pulp, reducing the demand for fresh wood fibres.
examples.zh: 回收設施將廢紙製成紙漿，從而減少對新木纖維的需求。

words.tip: 表示果肉或紙漿時，pulp通常不可數。

senses.en: moving awkwardly and often dropping or breaking things
done without skill, care, or sensitivity

examples.en: My clumsy puppy knocked a flowerpot off the shelf.
examples.zh: 我那隻笨手笨腳的小狗把架子上的一個花盆撞了下來。

examples.en: A clumsy attempt to explain new regulations can reduce public confidence in local government.
examples.zh: 對新規定的解釋若處理不當，可能會削弱公眾對地方政府的信任。

words.tip: 主要指動作或處理方式笨拙，不等於智力低下。

senses.en: Made from wool.

examples.en: I pulled on thick woollen socks before going outside.
examples.zh: 出門前，我穿上了厚厚的羊毛襪。

examples.en: Although woollen clothing provides excellent insulation, its environmental impact depends partly on farming practices and manufacturing methods.
examples.zh: 雖然羊毛衣物保暖效能優良，但其環境影響部分取決於養殖方式和製造方法。

words.tip: 英式拼寫woollen；美式通常寫woolen。

senses.en: A dish of vegetables or meat cooked with spices.
To cook food with curry spices.

examples.en: This vegetable curry tastes wonderful with rice and warm bread.
examples.zh: 這道蔬菜咖哩配米飯和熱麵包非常好吃。

examples.en: School cafeterias can offer vegetable curry as an affordable alternative to meals containing meat.
examples.zh: 學校食堂可以提供蔬菜咖哩，作為價格實惠的非肉類餐食選擇。

words.tip: curry常指菜餚；咖哩粉用curry powder。

senses.en: A unit of weight equal to approximately 28.35 grams.
A very small amount of something.

examples.en: I added an ounce of butter to the pan.
examples.zh: 我往鍋里加了一盎司黃油。

examples.en: Athletes often need every ounce of determination to maintain demanding training schedules alongside their studies.
examples.zh: 運動員往往需要傾盡意志力，才能在兼顧學業的同時堅持高強度訓練。

words.tip: 重量盎司約28.35克；fluid ounce是容量單位。

senses.en: Surrounded by something, or during a particular situation

examples.en: We found a quiet bench amidst the flowering trees.
examples.zh: 我們在開花的樹叢中找到了一張安靜的長椅。

examples.en: Amidst growing concerns about air quality, several cities have expanded their networks of protected cycle lanes.
examples.zh: 隨著人們日益擔憂空氣質量，一些城市擴大了設有隔離設施的腳踏車道網路。

words.tip: 與amid同義，語氣較正式；後接名詞或名詞短語。

senses.en: an aromatic herb, or a sweet flavored with it
a place where coins are officially made
to make coins from metal

examples.en: I added fresh mint to the lemon water.
examples.zh: 我往檸檬水裡加了新鮮薄荷。

examples.en: Growing herbs such as mint in urban gardens can provide fresh ingredients and encourage interest in food production.
examples.zh: 在城市花園中種植薄荷等香草，可以提供新鮮食材，並激發人們對食物生產的興趣。

words.tip: 植物義通常不可數；a mint可指一顆薄荷糖。

senses.en: To clean and brush an animal or make yourself neat.
A man who is getting married or has just married.
To prepare someone for a particular role or responsibility.

examples.en: We groom our pony every morning before riding.
examples.zh: 我們每天早上騎馬前都會給小馬梳毛。

examples.en: Some organisations groom promising employees for leadership roles through structured training and regular mentoring.
examples.zh: 一些機構透過系統培訓和定期指導，培養有潛力的員工擔任領導職務。

words.tip: 培養某人任職用groom someone for a role。

senses.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

examples.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
examples.zh: 請用這把剪刀裁剪包裝紙。

examples.en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
examples.zh: 幼兒在課堂手工活動中使用剪刀時，教師應在旁監督。

words.tip: 通常用複數；一把剪刀說a pair of scissors。

senses.en: making you feel cooler, less tired, or more energetic
pleasantly different from what you usually experience

examples.en: A refreshing breeze blew through the open kitchen window.
examples.zh: 一陣清爽的微風從敞開的廚房窗戶吹進來。

examples.en: The documentary offers a refreshing perspective on how older people contribute to their local communities.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片以令人耳目一新的視角展現老年人如何為當地社群作出貢獻。

words.tip: refreshing形容事物；refreshed形容人感到精神恢復。

senses.en: To make someone smile or laugh.
To keep someone pleasantly occupied.

examples.en: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他滑稽的舞蹈逗樂了在廚房等候的每個人。

examples.en: Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
examples.zh: 博物館的互動展品既能讓小遊客玩得開心，也能幫助他們理解複雜的科學概念。

words.tip: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。

senses.en: A product that makes hair softer and easier to manage.
A liquid added during washing to make fabrics softer.

examples.en: I use conditioner to keep my curly hair soft.
examples.zh: 我用護髮素讓捲髮保持柔軟。

examples.en: Consumers can reduce plastic waste by choosing refillable containers for shampoo and conditioner products.
examples.zh: 消費者可以選擇可補充裝的洗髮水和護髮素容器，以減少塑膠垃圾。

words.tip: 單獨用常指護髮素；空調要說air conditioner。

senses.en: A soft, comfortable shoe worn inside the home.

examples.en: I found my missing slipper underneath the sofa.
examples.zh: 我在沙發下面找到了丟失的那隻拖鞋。

examples.en: Providing slippers in shared accommodation can improve comfort, although regular cleaning remains essential for good hygiene.
examples.zh: 在合住場所提供拖鞋能提升舒適度，但保持良好衛生仍離不開定期清潔。

words.tip: 通常用複數slippers；人字拖常叫flip-flops。

senses.en: a joint that allows a door or lid to swing
to depend entirely on something, used with on or upon

examples.en: The rusty hinge squeaks whenever I open the cupboard.
examples.zh: 每次我開啟櫥櫃，生鏽的合頁都會吱吱作響。

examples.en: The success of public transport reforms may hinge on reliable funding and sustained support from local residents.
examples.zh: 公共交通改革的成功可能取決於可靠的資金來源和當地居民的持續支援。

words.tip: hinge on 後接名詞或從句，表示“取決於”。

senses.en: A movable panel that covers and protects a window
A camera mechanism controlling how long light enters
To close a building or business, temporarily or permanently

examples.en: I closed the wooden shutters before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，我關上了木製窗板。

examples.en: Photographers use a fast shutter speed to capture moving wildlife clearly without disturbing its natural behaviour.
examples.zh: 攝影師使用較快的快門速度，在不干擾野生動物自然行為的情況下清晰捕捉其動態。

words.tip: 窗板常用複數shutters；快門速度用shutter speed。

senses.en: corn kernels heated until they burst into light, fluffy pieces

examples.en: We shared a bowl of popcorn during the film.
examples.zh: 看電影時，我們一起吃了一碗爆米花。

examples.en: Cinemas often earn additional revenue by selling snacks such as popcorn alongside tickets for film screenings.
examples.zh: 電影院除了出售電影票，往往還透過銷售爆米花等零食獲得額外收入。

words.tip: 通常是不可數名詞；一顆可說a piece of popcorn。

senses.en: having no value or practical use

examples.en: Without its missing parts, this old machine is worthless.
examples.zh: 缺了那些零件，這臺舊機器就毫無用處。

examples.en: Digital skills can quickly become worthless if training focuses only on tools that are soon outdated.
examples.zh: 如果培訓只關注很快就會過時的工具，數字技能可能迅速失去價值。

words.tip: worthless指無價值；priceless反而指極珍貴。

senses.en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors

examples.en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
examples.zh: 一枚煙花在湖面上空綻放，灑下金色火花。

examples.en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
examples.zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引遊客，但其噪聲可能打擾當地居民和野生動物。

words.tip: 單枚煙花可數；泛指煙花或焰火表演常用fireworks。

senses.en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports.
A loud, unpleasant noise.

examples.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
examples.zh: 我把網球拍落在球場邊了。

examples.en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
examples.zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以讓更多孩子參與學校體育活動。

words.tip: 球拍也可拼作racquet；喧鬧聲只用racket。

senses.en: a long-handled tool with teeth for gathering leaves or smoothing soil
to gather or level something using a rake

examples.en: I used a rake to gather the fallen leaves.
examples.zh: 我用耙子把落葉攏在一起。

examples.en: Volunteers rake leaves in public gardens to keep paths accessible and maintain attractive communal spaces.
examples.zh: 志願者在公共花園裡耙落葉，以保持道路暢通並維護公共空間的美觀。

words.tip: rake up可指耙攏，也可指翻出不愉快的舊事。

senses.en: a darker skin colour caused by exposure to the sun
to become or make skin darker through exposure to sunlight
having a light brown colour

examples.en: His summer tan had faded by the middle of winter.
examples.zh: 到了隆冬，他夏天曬出的棕褐膚色已經褪去。

examples.en: Although a tan is sometimes considered attractive, prolonged exposure to sunlight increases the risk of skin damage.
examples.zh: 雖然曬成棕褐色有時被認為很有吸引力，但長時間日曬會增加皮膚受損的風險。

words.tip: tan不只指曬黑；作形容詞也可描述鞋包的淺褐色。

senses.en: A narrow bed, often arranged above or below another.

examples.en: I climbed into the top bunk and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 我爬上上鋪，睡著了。

examples.en: Providing each passenger with a comfortable bunk could make overnight trains more attractive than short flights.
examples.zh: 為每位乘客提供舒適的鋪位，能讓夜間列車比短途航班更有吸引力。

words.tip: top bunk是上鋪；bunk bed指雙層床。

senses.en: Very unusual and unexpected
Someone extremely interested in a particular activity or subject
To become very frightened or upset, or make someone so

examples.en: A freak hailstorm covered our garden in white ice.
examples.zh: 一場罕見的冰雹把我們的花園蓋上了一層白冰。

examples.en: A freak weather event can expose weaknesses in urban infrastructure and disrupt essential public services.
examples.zh: 異常天氣事件可能暴露城市基礎設施的薄弱環節，並擾亂基本公共服務。

words.tip: 形容詞通常置於名詞前；動詞常用freak out。

senses.en: to bend your upper body forward and downward
to do something dishonest or morally wrong
a posture with the shoulders and upper back bent forward

examples.en: She stooped to pick up the fallen orange.
examples.zh: 她彎腰撿起掉落的橙子。

examples.en: Companies should not stoop to misleading advertising merely to increase sales in an increasingly competitive market.
examples.zh: 企業不應僅為在競爭日益激烈的市場中提高銷量，就不擇手段地釋出誤導性廣告。

words.tip: stoop to doing表示不惜做卑劣之事，to為介詞。

senses.en: A box where letters are delivered or collected.
An electronic space where email messages are received and stored.

examples.en: A postcard from my cousin arrived in our mailbox.
examples.zh: 表親寄來的一張明信片到了我們家的信箱裡。

examples.en: Residents in remote areas may travel considerable distances to reach the nearest public mailbox.
examples.zh: 偏遠地區的居民可能需要走很遠才能到達最近的公共郵筒。

words.tip: 美式常用詞；英式常用letterbox或postbox。

senses.en: very small pieces of stone or sand
determination to keep trying despite difficulties
to spread grit on roads to make them less slippery

examples.en: I shook the grit out of my walking boots.
examples.zh: 我把徒步靴裡的砂礫抖了出來。

examples.en: Although talent matters, students often need grit and consistent support to overcome persistent learning difficulties.
examples.zh: 雖然天賦很重要，但學生往往需要毅力和持續支援才能克服長期的學習困難。

words.tip: 砂礫和毅力義均不可數；grit不是通常意義的“研磨”。

senses.en: Very generous, elaborate, or expensive
To give something generously or in large quantities

examples.en: They prepared a lavish feast for the whole family.
examples.zh: 他們為全家準備了一頓豐盛的大餐。

examples.en: Critics argue that lavish spending on official ceremonies diverts public funds from essential services such as healthcare.
examples.zh: 批評者認為，在官方儀式上大肆花費會擠佔醫療等基本服務的公共資金。

words.tip: 動詞常用lavish sth on sb，表示大量給予。

senses.en: An important event or stage in development.
A roadside stone showing the distance to a place.

examples.en: Getting her first job was a milestone for Sara.
examples.zh: 找到第一份工作是薩拉人生中的一個里程碑。

examples.en: The opening of the railway marked a significant milestone in the region's economic development.
examples.zh: 這條鐵路的開通標誌著該地區經濟發展的一個重要里程碑。

words.tip: 常指發展中的重要節點，常搭配in。

senses.zh: 男運動員；男性運動愛好者
senses.en: a man who plays sports, especially with skill

examples.en: My uncle was a keen sportsman in his youth.
examples.zh: 我叔叔年輕時非常熱愛運動。

examples.en: A successful sportsman can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop confidence through physical activity.
examples.zh: 成功的男運動員可以鼓勵年輕人經常鍛鍊，並透過體育活動培養自信。

words.tip: 特指男性；不強調性別時可用athlete。

senses.en: a tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

examples.en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
examples.zh: 她為我們的野餐切了一個新鮮菠蘿。

examples.en: Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.
examples.zh: 種植菠蘿用於出口可以增加農村收入，但集約化種植可能損害當地土壤。

words.tip: 整個菠蘿可數，作為食物的菠蘿果肉常不可數。

senses.en: A group of flowers arranged together, usually as a gift.
The characteristic pleasant smell of a wine.

examples.en: She brought a bright bouquet to her grandmother's birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 她帶著一束鮮豔的花來參加祖母的生日晚餐。

examples.en: Choosing a bouquet of locally grown flowers can reduce the environmental impact associated with long-distance transport.
examples.zh: 選擇一束本地種植的鮮花，可以減少長途運輸帶來的環境影響。

words.tip: 末尾t不發音；一束花用a bouquet of flowers。

senses.en: Despite what has happened or been said.
Used to return to a topic or introduce another point.
Without care or any particular order.

examples.en: It was raining, but we went swimming anyhow.
examples.zh: 雖然下著雨，我們還是去游泳了。

examples.en: Although public transport improvements require substantial funding, cities should invest in them anyhow to reduce congestion.
examples.zh: 雖然改善公共交通需要大量資金，城市仍應投入，以緩解擁堵。

words.tip: 表示“反正”較口語化；勿與somehow混淆。

senses.en: A unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

examples.en: Add one gram of salt and stir the soup.
examples.zh: 加入一克鹽，然後攪拌湯。

examples.en: Comparing the nutrients provided per gram can help consumers make more informed choices about packaged foods.
examples.zh: 比較每克食物所含的營養成分，有助於消費者更明智地選擇包裝食品。

words.tip: 符號為g；複數為grams；一千克等於一千克中的一千克？

senses.en: a long, difficult journey on foot
to walk a long distance, often across difficult terrain

examples.en: Our trek through the forest ended beside a waterfall.
examples.zh: 我們穿越森林的徒步旅程在一處瀑布旁結束。

examples.en: Visitors who trek through remote mountain regions can support local economies by hiring guides and purchasing local supplies.
examples.zh: 在偏遠山區徒步的遊客可以透過僱用嚮導和購買當地物資來支援當地經濟。

words.tip: 現代常指艱苦徒步；trekked、trekking要雙寫k。

senses.en: a small shallow dish placed underneath a cup

examples.en: She placed a biscuit on the saucer beside her cup.
examples.zh: 她把一塊餅乾放在茶托上，緊挨著杯子。

examples.en: Traditional tea sets, including matching cups and saucers, can reflect local craftsmanship and cultural preferences.
examples.zh: 傳統茶具，包括配套的茶杯和茶碟，可以體現當地的手工藝和文化偏好。

words.tip: saucer是杯子下的小碟；flying saucer指飛碟。

senses.en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping

examples.en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
examples.zh: 我穿上睡衣褲，爬上了床。

examples.en: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
examples.zh: 選擇舒適的睡衣褲並保持固定的就寢時間，可能有助於兒童養成更健康的睡眠習慣。

words.tip: 用複數；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。

senses.en: barely enough, or less than is needed

examples.en: We had scant time to pack before the taxi arrived.
examples.zh: 計程車到達前，我們幾乎沒時間收拾行李。

examples.en: There is scant evidence that longer working hours consistently lead to higher productivity across different industries.
examples.zh: 幾乎沒有證據表明，延長工時能在不同行業中持續帶來更高的生產率。

words.tip: 強調少到不夠，多用於名詞前，如scant evidence。

senses.en: pleasantly round and full in shape
to make a cushion or pillow fuller by shaking it

examples.en: She picked a plump peach from the fruit bowl.
examples.zh: 她從果盤裡挑了一個飽滿的桃子。

examples.en: Consumers often prefer plump fruit, although appearance alone is not a reliable indicator of nutritional value.
examples.zh: 消費者往往偏愛飽滿的水果，但單憑外觀並不能可靠地判斷營養價值。

words.tip: 比fat語氣溫和，但描述他人體型仍需謹慎。

senses.en: Secretive and clever, often to gain an unfair advantage.
Showing secret amusement or knowledge.

examples.en: The sly cat stole a biscuit while I turned away.
examples.zh: 我一轉身，那隻狡猾的貓就偷走了一塊餅乾。

examples.en: Sly attempts to hide additional charges can damage consumer trust and harm a company's reputation.
examples.zh: 偷偷隱瞞額外費用的做法會損害消費者的信任，並傷及公司的聲譽。

words.tip: on the sly是固定短語，意為偷偷地。

senses.en: Pasta shaped into long, thin strands.

examples.en: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork before taking a bite.
examples.zh: 她先用叉子捲起義大利細面，再吃了一口。

examples.en: Simple meals such as spaghetti with vegetables can help students eat affordably while maintaining a balanced diet.
examples.zh: 蔬菜義大利麵等簡單餐食，可以幫助學生在節省開支的同時保持均衡飲食。

words.tip: 不可數名詞；一盤用a plate of spaghetti。

senses.en: forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair

examples.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
examples.zh: 她跑上樓時，一頭捲髮隨著步伐上下彈動。

examples.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
examples.zh: 廣告應展現外貌各異的人，包括捲髮者和不同膚色的人。

words.tip: curly捲曲程度明顯；wavy通常指輕柔的波浪狀。

senses.en: To flow over the edge because a container is too full.
To contain more people or things than can comfortably fit.
Liquid or other contents that exceed the available space.

examples.en: The bath overflowed while I was answering the door.
examples.zh: 我去應門時，浴缸裡的水溢了出來。

examples.en: During heavy rainfall, urban drains may overflow and carry polluted water into nearby rivers.
examples.zh: 暴雨期間，城市排水管道可能滿溢，將汙水帶入附近河流。

words.tip: 動詞重音在末音節，名詞重音在首音節。

senses.en: A container made of cardboard, often used for food or drinks.

examples.en: Please put the milk carton back in the fridge.
examples.zh: 請把牛奶盒放回冰箱。

examples.en: Local recycling schemes should explain how residents can dispose of each type of food carton correctly.
examples.zh: 當地回收專案應說明居民如何正確處理各種食品紙盒。

words.tip: a carton of milk是一盒奶；勿與cartoon混淆。

senses.en: Tasting of salt or containing a lot of salt.

examples.en: The soup was too salty, so I added water.
examples.zh: 湯太鹹了，所以我加了些水。

examples.en: Eating salty snacks frequently can contribute to high blood pressure, increasing the risk of cardiovascular disease.
examples.zh: 經常吃鹹味零食可能導致高血壓，增加患心血管疾病的風險。

words.tip: salty強調鹹味；salted強調加過鹽。

senses.en: Usually, or when conditions are normal.

examples.en: We ordinarily eat outside, but today it is raining.
examples.zh: 我們通常在戶外吃飯，但今天下雨了。

examples.en: Public libraries ordinarily provide free internet access, helping residents who cannot afford a connection at home.
examples.zh: 公共圖書館通常提供免費網路，幫助那些無力負擔家庭網路費用的居民。

words.tip: 表示“通常”，不表示推測性的“大概”。

senses.en: To move quickly or make someone move quickly, sometimes roughly.
Busy, energetic activity involving many people.
To sell aggressively or obtain something through dishonest persuasion.

examples.en: We hustled through the station to catch the last train.
examples.zh: 我們匆忙穿過車站，趕上末班火車。

examples.en: Some residents leave major cities because the daily hustle makes it difficult to maintain a balanced lifestyle.
examples.zh: 一些居民離開大城市，是因為日常的忙碌喧鬧讓他們難以保持平衡的生活方式。

words.tip: hustle and bustle是固定搭配，指忙碌喧鬧。

senses.en: A secure position for your feet on a surface.
The basis or status on which something operates.

examples.en: I lost my footing on the wet steps.
examples.zh: 我在溼滑的臺階上沒站穩。

examples.en: Public funding can help place rural schools on an equal footing with their urban counterparts.
examples.zh: 公共資金能幫助農村學校獲得與城市學校平等的地位。

words.tip: on an equal footing表示地位平等。

senses.en: A twisted mass of threads, hair, or similar things
Become twisted together, or make things twist together
A confused situation that is difficult to resolve

examples.en: My headphones were buried in a tangle of cables.
examples.zh: 我的耳機埋在一團纏結的線纜裡。

examples.en: Small businesses often face a tangle of regulations that makes expansion costly and time-consuming.
examples.zh: 小企業常面臨錯綜複雜的法規，使業務擴張既費錢又費時。

words.tip: a tangle of既可指實物纏結，也可指複雜困局。

senses.en: extremely busy and full of activity, often causing stress

examples.en: After a hectic morning, I finally sat down for lunch.
examples.zh: 忙亂了一上午後，我終於坐下來吃午飯。

examples.en: A hectic urban lifestyle can leave residents with little time for exercise, relaxation, or meaningful social interaction.
examples.zh: 忙碌緊張的城市生活可能讓居民無暇鍛鍊、放鬆或進行有意義的社交。

words.tip: 現代常用義是忙亂的，不是興奮的或發熱的。

senses.en: A small, round, dark blue fruit.

examples.en: A ripe blueberry rolled off my spoon onto the table.
examples.zh: 一顆熟藍莓從我的勺子上滾到了桌上。

examples.en: Growing blueberries locally can diversify farm income, but suitable soil conditions are essential for successful cultivation.
examples.zh: 在當地種植藍莓可以使農場收入多樣化，但適宜的土壤條件是成功栽培的關鍵。

words.tip: 可數名詞，複數把y變為ies：blueberries。

senses.en: Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.

examples.en: In my haste, I left my keys on the table.
examples.zh: 我匆忙之中把鑰匙落在了桌上。

examples.en: Policies developed in haste may overlook the needs of vulnerable groups and create additional social problems.
examples.zh: 倉促制定的政策可能忽視弱勢群體的需求，並引發更多社會問題。

words.tip: 通常為不可數名詞；in haste意為匆忙地。

senses.en: A tropical fruit with sweet orange flesh and a large stone

examples.en: This mango is sweet enough to eat without sugar.
examples.zh: 這個芒果已經很甜了，不用加糖就能吃。

examples.en: Improved storage facilities can help mango farmers reduce food waste and earn more reliable incomes.
examples.zh: 改善儲存設施可以幫助芒果種植戶減少食物浪費，獲得更穩定的收入。

words.tip: 複數mangoes和mangos均正確。

senses.en: Large and awkward to carry, move, or store.

examples.en: This bulky suitcase barely fits inside the small cupboard.
examples.zh: 這個大行李箱勉強能塞進那隻小櫃子。

examples.en: Compact furniture is increasingly popular because bulky items can make small urban apartments feel overcrowded.
examples.zh: 緊湊型傢俱越來越受歡迎，因為體積龐大的傢俱會讓城市小公寓顯得擁擠。

words.tip: bulky強調體積大、佔空間，不一定很重。

senses.en: touch someone lightly, causing laughter or an itchy feeling
amuse someone or pleasantly interest them
a slight itchy feeling in part of the body

examples.en: The kitten's whiskers tickled my wrist as it sniffed.
examples.zh: 小貓湊過來聞時，鬍鬚弄得我的手腕癢癢的。

examples.en: Humorous advertisements often tickle viewers while making ordinary household products seem more appealing to potential buyers.
examples.zh: 幽默廣告常常逗樂觀眾，同時讓普通家居用品對潛在買家更有吸引力。

words.tip: tickle指撓癢；scratch多指用指甲抓撓。

senses.en: to move upwards or rise to a higher position
to go up something such as stairs or a mountain

examples.en: We watched the balloon ascend slowly into the clear sky.
examples.zh: 我們看著氣球緩緩升上晴朗的天空。

examples.en: As hikers ascend the mountain, they encounter distinct vegetation zones shaped by changing temperatures and moisture levels.
examples.zh: 徒步者登山時，會遇到由溫度和溼度變化形成的不同植被帶。

words.tip: 較正式；ascend the stairs中不加up。

senses.en: To a very great degree.

examples.en: The little bakery was exceedingly busy on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 週六早上，那家小麵包店忙得不可開交。

examples.en: Providing reliable public transport in sparsely populated areas can be exceedingly expensive for local authorities.
examples.zh: 對於地方政府而言，在人口稀少的地區提供可靠的公共交通可能極其昂貴。

words.tip: 比 very 更正式，常修飾形容詞或副詞。

senses.en: Serious and firm in demanding acceptable behaviour.
The back part of a boat or ship.

examples.en: Dad gave us a stern look across the table.
examples.zh: 爸爸隔著桌子嚴厲地看了我們一眼。

examples.en: Schools should combine stern warnings about bullying with practical support for students who experience it.
examples.zh: 學校既應嚴正警告欺凌行為，也應為遭受欺凌的學生提供實際支援。

words.tip: 形容詞指態度嚴厲；作名詞指船尾，與bow相對。

senses.en: A large container for rubbish, usually kept outside.

examples.en: Please put that rubbish in the dustbin outside.
examples.zh: 請把那些垃圾放進外面的垃圾桶。

examples.en: Providing a separate dustbin for food waste can help households reduce the amount of rubbish sent to landfill.
examples.zh: 為廚餘垃圾提供單獨的垃圾桶，可以幫助家庭減少送往填埋場的垃圾量。

words.tip: 英式用詞；美式常用garbage can或trash can。

senses.en: causing problems, difficulty, or annoyance

examples.en: This troublesome lock jams whenever the weather turns cold.
examples.zh: 每當天氣變冷，這把煩人的鎖就會卡住。

examples.en: Unreliable public transport is particularly troublesome for workers who depend on buses to reach jobs outside city centres.
examples.zh: 對於依賴公交車前往市中心以外地區上班的人來說，公共交通不可靠尤其令人困擾。

words.tip: troublesome指造成麻煩；troubled指自身遇到困擾。

senses.en: A machine or device that removes moisture from things.

examples.en: The towels are still warm from the dryer.
examples.zh: 毛巾剛從烘乾機裡拿出來，還是熱的。

examples.en: Using a clothesline instead of an electric dryer can lower household energy consumption and reduce monthly bills.
examples.zh: 用晾衣繩代替電烘乾機，可以降低家庭能耗並減少每月賬單支出。

words.tip: dryer通常是乾燥裝置；dry的比較級通常寫drier。

senses.en: A hollow in a surface caused by pressure or impact
To make or develop a hollow in a surface
To reduce someone's confidence or damage something's strength or reputation

examples.en: My bike has a dent in its metal basket.
examples.zh: 我的腳踏車金屬車籃上有一處凹痕。

examples.en: Repeated delays in public transport can dent passengers' confidence and encourage greater reliance on private cars.
examples.zh: 公共交通反覆延誤會削弱乘客的信心，使人們更加依賴私家車。

words.tip: dent不是“牙齒”；make a dent in可指削減或取得進展。

senses.en: for a period of time to pass

examples.en: Several minutes elapsed before the bus finally arrived.
examples.zh: 過了幾分鐘，公交車終於來了。

examples.en: Several years may elapse before environmental policies produce measurable improvements in urban air quality.
examples.zh: 環境政策可能要經過數年才能使城市空氣質量出現可衡量的改善。

words.tip: 不及物動詞，以時間作主語，不能直接接賓語。

senses.en: For each person or thing separately.

examples.en: We bought fresh peaches for fifty cents apiece.
examples.zh: 我們買了新鮮桃子，每個五十分。

examples.en: Reusable containers may cost more apiece initially, but they can reduce packaging expenses over the long term.
examples.zh: 可重複使用的容器起初單價可能較高，但長期而言能夠降低包裝費用。

words.tip: 常放在價格或數量之後，不用於名詞前作限定詞。

senses.en: To travel across or through an area.

examples.en: We traversed the snowy valley before reaching the mountain hut.
examples.zh: 我們穿過積雪覆蓋的山谷，才到達山間小屋。

examples.en: New railway routes traverse remote regions, connecting isolated communities with essential services and larger markets.
examples.zh: 新鐵路線路穿越偏遠地區，讓孤立的社群能夠獲得基本服務並進入更大的市場。

words.tip: 正式用詞，直接接地點賓語：traverse the desert。

senses.en: Not moving or changing position.

examples.en: Our bus remained stationary while passengers climbed aboard.
examples.zh: 乘客上車時，我們的公交車一直停著沒動。

examples.en: Stationary vehicles with running engines contribute to urban air pollution without providing any transport benefit.
examples.zh: 停著卻未熄火的車輛加劇了城市空氣汙染，卻沒有發揮任何運輸作用。

words.tip: stationary指靜止的；stationery指文具，讀音相同。

senses.en: An unexpected difficulty that delays or prevents progress.
To catch or tear something on a sharp or rough object.

examples.en: My sweater snagged on a nail by the door.
examples.zh: 我的毛衣被門邊的一顆釘子鉤住了。

examples.en: The housing project hit a snag when engineers discovered unstable ground beneath the proposed site.
examples.zh: 工程師發現擬建地塊下方的地基不穩，住房專案因此遇到了障礙。

words.tip: hit a snag指遇到障礙；動詞常接on表示被鉤住。

senses.en: not neat or well arranged
not keeping your belongings or surroundings neat

examples.en: Her untidy desk was covered with cups and notebooks.
examples.zh: 她凌亂的書桌上堆滿了杯子和筆記本。

examples.en: Shared workspaces can quickly become untidy unless employees take responsibility for keeping communal areas clean and organised.
examples.zh: 如果員工不主動保持公共區域乾淨有序，共享辦公空間很快就會變得凌亂。

words.tip: untidy強調不整齊，不一定像dirty那樣有汙垢。

senses.en: A short nail with a broad, flat head.
To fasten something using small nails.
A particular approach to dealing with a situation.

examples.en: I used a tack to secure the loose fabric.
examples.zh: 我用一枚大頭短釘固定住鬆開的布料。

examples.en: When public campaigns fail to change behaviour, policymakers may need to take a different tack.
examples.zh: 當公共宣傳活動無法改變行為時，政策制定者可能需要換一種方法。

words.tip: 方法用tack；步入正軌用on track，勿混。

senses.en: A large container that you sit in to wash your body.

examples.en: The kitten watched water dripping into the empty bathtub.
examples.zh: 小貓看著水滴進空浴缸。

examples.en: Replacing a bathtub with a shower can save space in small urban apartments.
examples.zh: 在小型城市公寓中，用淋浴設施替換浴缸可以節省空間。

words.tip: bathtub尤常用於美式英語；英式常說bath。

senses.en: extremely ugly or unpleasant
extremely shocking or terrible

examples.en: That hideous carpet clashes with everything in the room.
examples.zh: 那塊難看的地毯與房間裡的一切都不搭。

examples.en: Poorly planned developments can create hideous buildings that damage the visual character of historic neighbourhoods.
examples.zh: 規劃不當的開發專案可能造出極其難看的建築，破壞歷史街區的視覺風貌。

words.tip: 語氣很強，常形容極醜的外觀或可怕的事。

senses.en: To dress someone or provide them with clothes

examples.en: The charity helps feed and clothe families during winter.
examples.zh: 這家慈善機構在冬季幫助家庭解決吃穿問題。

examples.en: Low wages can make it difficult for parents to feed and clothe their children adequately.
examples.zh: 低工資可能使父母難以讓孩子吃飽穿暖。

words.tip: 較正式；過去式和過去分詞通常為clothed。

senses.en: A large round fruit with thick skin and sweet, juicy flesh.

examples.en: She sliced a ripe melon for our picnic.
examples.zh: 她切了一個熟甜瓜，供我們野餐時吃。

examples.en: Farmers growing melons in dry regions often use efficient irrigation systems to reduce water consumption.
examples.zh: 乾旱地區種植甜瓜的農民常使用高效灌溉系統來減少用水量。

words.tip: melon泛指甜瓜類；watermelon專指西瓜。

senses.en: The quality of happening at consistent intervals or following a pattern.

examples.en: The regularity of her morning walks helps her sleep better.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨規律散步，這幫助她睡得更好。

examples.en: The regularity of public transport services strongly influences whether commuters choose buses over private cars.
examples.zh: 公交服務的規律性會顯著影響通勤者是否選擇公交車而非私家車。

words.tip: with regularity表示有規律地，也可指經常發生。

senses.en: No longer fresh, especially when describing bread or air.
No longer interesting or original because of repeated use.

examples.en: This bread is stale, so I'll use it for breadcrumbs.
examples.zh: 這麵包不新鮮了，我就拿它做麵包屑吧。

examples.en: Teaching methods can become stale when educators lack opportunities to exchange ideas and develop new skills.
examples.zh: 如果教育工作者缺乏交流想法和培養新技能的機會，教學方法就可能變得陳舊乏味。

words.tip: stale指失去新鮮感；rotten指已腐爛。

senses.en: A short trip to buy, collect, or deliver something

examples.en: I ran an errand before meeting you for lunch.
examples.zh: 和你見面吃午飯前，我出去辦了點事。

examples.en: Reliable neighbourhood transport helps older residents run errands independently and maintain regular contact with their communities.
examples.zh: 可靠的社群交通能幫助老年居民獨立外出辦事，並與社群保持日常聯絡。

words.tip: 通常指外出辦小事；常搭配run errands。

senses.en: not allowing water to pass through
to treat something so water cannot pass through it

examples.en: My waterproof jacket kept me dry during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨中，我的防水夾克讓我沒有淋溼。

examples.en: Outdoor workers need waterproof clothing to remain comfortable and protected when carrying out tasks in wet weather.
examples.zh: 戶外工作者需要防水衣物，以便在潮溼天氣作業時保持舒適並得到保護。

words.tip: water-resistant僅指有一定抗水能力，防水程度較弱。

senses.en: A woman who welcomes and entertains guests.
A woman who welcomes customers and takes them to restaurant tables.

examples.en: Our hostess brought out fresh fruit after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後，女主人端來了新鮮水果。

examples.en: A welcoming hostess can help international visitors feel comfortable and encourage meaningful conversations across cultures.
examples.zh: 熱情的女主人能讓國際訪客感到自在，並促進有意義的跨文化交流。

words.tip: hostess特指女性；host如今也可用於任何性別。

senses.en: able to stretch and return to its original shape
stretchy material used to hold clothing or objects in place
able to change or adapt easily

examples.en: These elastic sleeves stretch easily over my thick gloves.
examples.zh: 這些有彈性的袖口很容易拉伸，套住我的厚手套。

examples.en: Manufacturers use elastic materials in sports clothing to improve comfort and allow greater freedom of movement.
examples.zh: 製造商在運動服中使用彈性材料，以提高舒適度，讓活動更加自如。

words.tip: 作材料名詞通常不可數；elastic band指橡皮筋。

senses.en: To scatter things loosely across a surface or area

examples.en: The children strew flower petals along the garden path.
examples.zh: 孩子們沿著花園小徑撒花瓣。

examples.en: Visitors who strew litter across beaches threaten marine wildlife and increase the cost of coastal maintenance.
examples.zh: 在海灘上亂扔垃圾的遊客會威脅海洋野生動物，並增加海岸維護成本。

words.tip: 過去式strewed，分詞常用strewn；常見被動結構。

senses.en: Products applied to the face or body to improve appearance.

examples.en: She keeps her cosmetics in a small bathroom drawer.
examples.zh: 她把化妝品放在浴室的一個小抽屜裡。

examples.en: Consumers increasingly expect cosmetics manufacturers to disclose ingredients clearly and reduce unnecessary packaging to limit environmental damage.
examples.zh: 消費者越來越希望化妝品製造商明確公開成分，並減少不必要的包裝以降低環境危害。

words.tip: 通常用複數；cosmetic作形容詞也指表面的。

senses.en: A vegetable preserved in vinegar or salty water.
To preserve food in vinegar or salty water.

examples.en: She added a crunchy pickle to her sandwich.
examples.zh: 她在三明治里加了一根脆醃黃瓜。

examples.en: Many communities pickle seasonal vegetables to extend their shelf life and reduce household food waste.
examples.zh: 許多社群的居民會醃製時令蔬菜，以延長儲存期並減少家庭食物浪費。

words.tip: 美式英語中a pickle常指一根醃黃瓜。

senses.en: At or to a greater distance.
Located at a greater distance.

examples.en: We walked farther along the beach before stopping for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們沿海灘又走了一段路才停下來吃午飯。

examples.en: As housing costs rise, many workers move farther from city centres and face longer daily commutes.
examples.zh: 隨著住房成本上漲，許多上班族搬到離市中心更遠的地方，每天通勤時間也隨之增加。

words.tip: farther多指實際距離；進一步討論用further。

senses.en: Having faults or lacking something needed to be complete.

examples.en: This handmade bowl is imperfect, but I love its shape.
examples.zh: 這個手工碗雖不完美，但我很喜歡它的形狀。

examples.en: Although the current recycling system is imperfect, it still reduces the amount of waste sent to landfill.
examples.zh: 儘管現有的回收體系並不完善，它仍然減少了送往填埋場的垃圾量。

words.tip: 表示有缺陷，不等於完全無用或失敗。

senses.en: a liquid product used to wash hair
to wash hair using shampoo

examples.en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
examples.zh: 我為這次旅行裝了一小瓶洗髮水。

examples.en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
examples.zh: 使用可補充裝的洗髮水容器可以減少家庭和旅遊業產生的塑膠垃圾。

words.tip: 泛指洗髮水通常不可數；一瓶用a bottle of shampoo。

senses.en: pink or reddish, especially in a healthy-looking way
giving hope of success or happiness, sometimes unrealistically

examples.en: Her cheeks were rosy after walking in the cold.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的天氣裡走了一陣後，她的臉頰紅撲撲的。

examples.en: Although official forecasts paint a rosy picture, rising energy costs could slow the country's economic recovery.
examples.zh: 儘管官方預測描繪了樂觀的前景，能源成本上漲仍可能拖慢該國的經濟復甦。

words.tip: paint a rosy picture 指描繪樂觀景象，有時暗含過度美化。

senses.zh: 行動遲緩的；無精打采的
senses.en: moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy
growing or operating more slowly than expected

examples.en: I felt sluggish after eating such a large lunch.
examples.zh: 午飯吃得太多，我感覺懶洋洋的。

examples.en: Sluggish economic growth can discourage investment and limit employment opportunities for recent university graduates.
examples.zh: 經濟增長乏力會抑制投資，並限制大學應屆畢業生的就業機會。

words.tip: 既形容人沒精神，也形容經濟或系統運轉慢。

senses.en: covered with soft hair or having a soft, airy texture
light and soft because of air inside

examples.en: Our kitten curled up on a fluffy white blanket.
examples.zh: 我們的小貓蜷縮在一條毛茸茸的白色毯子上。

examples.en: Hotels often provide fluffy towels and comfortable bedding to improve guest satisfaction and encourage repeat visits.
examples.zh: 酒店通常提供柔軟蓬鬆的毛巾和舒適的床上用品，以提高客人滿意度並吸引回頭客。

words.tip: 形容毛髮時指毛茸茸；形容食物時指鬆軟。

senses.en: The activity or sport of moving a boat with oars.

examples.en: My sister goes rowing on the lake every Saturday.
examples.zh: 我姐姐每週六都去湖上划船。

examples.en: Schools that offer rowing can help students develop physical fitness, coordination, and a strong sense of teamwork.
examples.zh: 開設賽艇課程的學校可以幫助學生增強體能、協調能力和團隊意識。

words.tip: 划船的row讀/rəʊ/；爭吵的row讀/raʊ/。

senses.en: a woman who rents property or rooms to other people
a woman who owns or manages a pub

examples.en: Our landlady came round to fix the kitchen tap.
examples.zh: 我們的女房東過來修廚房水龍頭。

examples.en: A responsible landlady should maintain safe housing conditions and respond promptly when tenants report serious problems.
examples.zh: 負責任的女房東應確保住房條件安全，並在租客報告嚴重問題時及時回應。

words.tip: landlady指女性；landlord可泛指房東。

senses.en: To speak angrily to someone because they did something wrong.

examples.en: Dad scolded me for leaving the freezer door open.
examples.zh: 爸爸因為我沒關冰櫃門而訓了我。

examples.en: Teachers who frequently scold pupils may discourage them from asking questions and participating in classroom discussions.
examples.zh: 經常訓斥學生的教師可能會使學生不願提問或參與課堂討論。

collocations.zh: 因某人做某事而訓斥他

words.tip: 用 scold someone for doing，表示因某行為責罵某人。

senses.zh: 放肆卻討喜的；厚臉皮的
senses.en: Slightly rude or disrespectful, often in an amusing way

examples.en: The child gave a cheeky grin and took another biscuit.
examples.zh: 那孩子調皮地咧嘴一笑，又拿了一塊餅乾。

examples.en: Advertisements sometimes use cheeky humour to attract attention, although audiences may differ in what they find acceptable.
examples.zh: 廣告有時使用略帶冒犯的幽默吸引注意，不過不同受眾的接受尺度可能不同。

words.tip: 指調皮放肆，不是胖乎乎；胖乎乎用chubby。

senses.en: a small room or cupboard for storing food

examples.en: There is another bag of rice in the pantry.
examples.zh: 食品儲藏室裡還有一袋米。

examples.en: Keeping a well-organised pantry can help households reduce food waste and manage their grocery budgets.
examples.zh: 保持食品儲藏室整齊有序可以幫助家庭減少食物浪費並控制食品開支。

collocations.zh: 儲備充足的食品儲藏室

words.tip: 主要儲存食品；不等於做飯的kitchen。

senses.en: A fruit with creamy green flesh and a large central stone.

examples.en: She spread ripe avocado on her warm toast.
examples.zh: 她把熟透的牛油果抹在熱吐司上。

examples.en: Growing demand for avocados can place pressure on water supplies in regions with limited rainfall.
examples.zh: 在降雨有限的地區，牛油果需求增長可能給供水帶來壓力。

words.tip: 複數為avocados，不加-es。

senses.en: A tool used to grip and turn nuts or bolts
Pull or twist forcefully, sometimes causing injury
Sadness at leaving someone or something; a sudden forceful twist

examples.en: She tightened the loose bolt with a wrench.
examples.zh: 她用扳手擰緊了鬆動的螺栓。

examples.en: Leaving a close community can be a real wrench for students who move abroad for university.
examples.zh: 對赴海外上大學的學生來說，離開關係緊密的社群可能十分難捨。

words.tip: 扳手在英式英語中常叫spanner；wrench也可作動詞。

senses.en: a long, narrow cut or opening
to make a long, narrow cut in something

examples.en: Sunlight came through a narrow slit in the curtains.
examples.zh: 陽光透過窗簾間的一條狹縫照了進來。

examples.en: A narrow slit in the laboratory screen allows researchers to observe how light behaves when passing through small openings.
examples.zh: 實驗室屏障上的一道狹縫讓研究人員能夠觀察光穿過小開口時的表現。

words.tip: 動詞過去式、過去分詞均為slit；現在分詞為slitting。

senses.en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.

examples.en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
examples.zh: 我姐姐在當地體育中心練體操。

examples.en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
examples.zh: 將體操納入學校課程有助於兒童提高協調性、增強身體自信，並培養運動興趣。

words.tip: 雖以-s結尾，表示運動時作單數：gymnastics is。

senses.en: a fastener with two rows of teeth joined by sliding

examples.en: My jacket zipper got stuck halfway up this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，我夾克的拉鍊拉到一半卡住了。

examples.en: Designing clothing with replaceable buttons and zippers could extend its lifespan and reduce household textile waste.
examples.zh: 採用可更換紐扣和拉鍊的服裝設計，可以延長衣物壽命並減少家庭紡織品廢棄物。

words.tip: zipper主要用於美式英語，英式英語通常用zip。

senses.en: a substance used with water to clean clothes or surfaces

examples.en: I added detergent before starting the washing machine.
examples.zh: 我在啟動洗衣機之前加入了洗滌劑。

examples.en: Using excessive detergent wastes money and may increase the amount of chemicals entering local waterways.
examples.zh: 使用過量洗滌劑既浪費錢，也可能增加進入當地水道的化學物質。

words.tip: 泛指洗滌劑時通常不可數；指種類時可數。

senses.en: To twist and squeeze something, especially to remove liquid.

examples.en: Wring out the wet towel before hanging it up.
examples.zh: 把溼毛巾擰乾後再掛起來。

examples.en: Where washing machines are unavailable, residents must wring out heavy clothes by hand after washing.
examples.zh: 在沒有洗衣機的地方，居民洗完厚重衣物後必須用手擰乾。

words.tip: 過去式和過去分詞均為wrung；擰乾常用wring out。

senses.en: a long warm coat worn over other clothes

examples.en: He pulled on his overcoat before stepping into the snow.
examples.zh: 他穿上大衣，然後走進雪地。

examples.en: Donating an unused overcoat to a local charity can help someone stay warm during winter.
examples.zh: 將閒置的大衣捐給當地慈善機構，可以幫助有需要的人溫暖過冬。

words.tip: overcoat通常指套在其他衣服外的禦寒長大衣。

senses.en: A narrow boat moved with a paddle having two blades.
To travel across water in a kayak.

examples.en: She paddled her kayak gently across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 她輕輕划著皮艇穿過平靜的湖面。

examples.en: Exploring coastal areas by kayak allows tourists to enjoy natural scenery without producing engine noise.
examples.zh: 乘皮艇探索沿海地區，讓遊客能在不產生發動機噪聲的情況下欣賞自然風光。

words.tip: kayak通常用雙葉槳；canoe通常用單葉槳。

senses.en: having plenty of fresh air and open space
light and delicate in appearance or texture
casual in a way that suggests little concern

examples.en: The bedroom feels airy with both windows wide open.
examples.zh: 兩扇窗都大開著，臥室顯得通風又舒適。

examples.en: Bright, airy classrooms can create a more comfortable learning environment, especially in schools located in warm climates.
examples.zh: 明亮通風的教室能營造更舒適的學習環境，在氣候溫暖地區的學校尤其如此。

words.tip: 形容房間時指通風寬敞，不是“空氣製成的”。

senses.en: To shine with many small flashes of reflected light.
Tiny shiny pieces used to decorate things.
Bright sparkling light, or an appearance of glamour and excitement.

examples.en: Tiny drops of water glitter on the leaves outside.
examples.zh: 外面樹葉上的小水珠閃閃發亮。

examples.en: Although city skylines glitter at night, excessive artificial lighting can disrupt wildlife and waste energy.
examples.zh: 雖然城市的天際線在夜晚燈光璀璨，但過量的人工照明會干擾野生動物並浪費能源。

words.tip: 作動詞表示閃耀；作閃光裝飾粉講時通常不可數。

senses.en: To swallow food or drink quickly in large amounts.
To swallow because you are nervous or frightened.
An amount swallowed in one quick movement.

examples.en: After cycling home, I gulped down a glass of water.
examples.zh: 騎車回家後，我大口喝下了一杯水。

examples.en: Workers who gulp down meals during short breaks may find it harder to maintain healthy eating habits.
examples.zh: 在短暫休息時狼吞虎嚥的員工，可能更難保持健康的飲食習慣。

words.tip: gulp down強調快速吞下；sip指小口抿飲。

senses.en: To catch again or regain control of something
To experience or produce a past feeling or quality again
The act of catching something or taking control again

examples.en: The farmer recaptured the goat beside our garden gate.
examples.zh: 農夫在我們花園門旁重新抓住了那隻山羊。

examples.en: Restoring historic buildings can help cities recapture their distinctive character while creating new opportunities for tourism.
examples.zh: 修復歷史建築有助於城市重現獨特風貌，同時創造新的旅遊發展機會。

words.tip: 既可指重新抓住，也可指重溫昔日感受或再現特色。

senses.en: A wide topped tool with a narrow tube for pouring
To direct something through a narrow space or particular route
A large pipe carrying smoke away from a ship's engine

examples.en: Use a funnel to pour oil into the bottle.
examples.zh: 用漏斗把油倒進瓶子裡。

examples.en: Well-designed drainage systems funnel rainwater into storage tanks, reducing the risk of urban flooding.
examples.zh: 設計合理的排水系統將雨水引入儲水罐，降低城市內澇風險。

words.tip: 作動詞常用funnel A into B，表示將A引入B。

senses.en: Loose and hanging away from the body.

examples.en: These baggy trousers feel comfortable on long train journeys.
examples.zh: 長途坐火車時，穿這條寬鬆的褲子很舒服。

examples.en: Some young people choose baggy clothing to express their identity rather than follow traditional expectations.
examples.zh: 一些年輕人選擇寬鬆的衣服來表達自我，而非遵循傳統期待。

words.tip: baggy形容衣服寬大鬆垮，不是泛指袋子的形狀。

senses.en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment.
To return money paid for something.

examples.en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
examples.zh: 商店把壞水壺的貨款退給了我。

examples.en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
examples.zh: 航班取消且沒有合理的替代方案時，航空公司應向乘客提供全額退款。

words.tip: 名詞重音在前；動詞讀/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在後。

senses.en: a large green-skinned fruit with juicy, usually red flesh

examples.en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
examples.zh: 在外面玩耍後，我們一起吃了一個冰涼的西瓜。

examples.en: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
examples.zh: 在乾旱地區種植西瓜需要謹慎管理灌溉，以保護當地有限的水資源。

words.tip: 整個西瓜可數；指切開的瓜肉時常不可數。

senses.en: Not paid, returned, or completed by the expected time.
Needed or deserved much earlier than now.

examples.en: I found an overdue library book under my bed.
examples.zh: 我在床底下發現了一本逾期未還的圖書館藏書。

examples.en: Investment in rural public transport is long overdue, as many residents still lack reliable services.
examples.zh: 農村公共交通早就該得到投資，因為許多居民至今仍缺乏可靠的交通服務。

collocations.zh: 逾期未還的圖書館書籍

words.tip: long overdue強調“早就該有或該做”，不只是遲到。

senses.en: Carrying or holding a large amount of something.
Full of a particular feeling, especially an unpleasant one.

examples.en: She arrived at the picnic laden with bags of food.
examples.zh: 她帶著大包小包的食物來到野餐地點。

examples.en: Trucks laden with construction materials contribute to congestion and increase road maintenance costs in rapidly expanding cities.
examples.zh: 在迅速擴張的城市中，滿載建築材料的卡車加劇了擁堵，並增加了道路維護成本。

words.tip: 常用laden with；也可構成sugar-laden等複合形容詞。

senses.en: Covering part of the same area or period.
Sharing some features, interests, or responsibilities.

examples.en: The roof was covered with rows of overlapping tiles.
examples.zh: 屋頂鋪著一排排相互搭疊的瓦片。

examples.en: Overlapping responsibilities between government departments can create confusion and delay the implementation of essential public services.
examples.zh: 政府部門之間職責交叉可能造成混亂，並延誤重要公共服務的落實。

words.tip: 強調部分重合，不一定完全相同；也可指時間重疊。

senses.en: A shaped frame used to hang clothes.

examples.en: She put her jacket on a wooden hanger.
examples.zh: 她把夾克掛在一個木衣架上。

examples.en: Retailers can reduce plastic waste by collecting used hangers and replacing damaged ones with recyclable alternatives.
examples.zh: 零售商可以回收舊衣架，並用可回收的替代品更換損壞的衣架，從而減少塑膠垃圾。

words.tip: hanger是衣架；hangar是飛機庫，注意拼寫。

senses.zh: 難以到達的；無法進入的
senses.en: difficult or impossible to reach or enter
difficult or impossible to obtain, use, or understand

examples.en: Heavy snow made the mountain cabin inaccessible all weekend.
examples.zh: 大雪使那間山中小屋整個週末都無法到達。

examples.en: Public services remain inaccessible to many rural residents because reliable transport and internet connections are lacking.
examples.zh: 由於缺乏可靠的交通和網路連線，許多農村居民仍無法享用公共服務。

words.tip: 常用 inaccessible to sb，表示某人無法接近或使用。

senses.en: to stop a fire or flame from burning
to bring a feeling, hope, or idea to an end

examples.en: We extinguished the campfire before getting into our tents.
examples.zh: 我們在進入帳篷前撲滅了篝火。

examples.en: Prolonged unemployment can extinguish young people's hopes of achieving financial independence and securing stable housing.
examples.zh: 長期失業可能使年輕人實現經濟獨立和獲得穩定住房的希望破滅。

words.tip: 及物動詞；日常說撲滅也可用put out。

senses.en: An activity you enjoy doing in your free time.

examples.en: Gardening became her favourite pastime after she retired.
examples.zh: 退休後，園藝成了她最喜歡的消遣。

examples.en: Outdoor pastimes can improve mental health while encouraging people to spend less time using electronic devices.
examples.zh: 戶外休閒活動可以改善心理健康，同時鼓勵人們減少使用電子裝置的時間。

words.tip: 指閒暇活動；注意拼寫只有一個s。

senses.en: a shelf used for storing books

examples.en: She placed her favourite novel on the wooden bookshelf.
examples.zh: 她把最喜歡的小說放到了木書架上。

examples.en: A well-stocked bookshelf in every classroom can encourage children to explore subjects beyond the school curriculum.
examples.zh: 每間教室都配備藏書豐富的書架，可以鼓勵孩子探索學校課程以外的主題。

words.tip: 複數為bookshelves，注意把f變為ves。

senses.en: Relating to Arabia, especially its geography, culture, or wildlife.
A horse of a breed originally developed in Arabia.

examples.en: We admired the Arabian horses trotting across the sandy field.
examples.zh: 我們欣賞著在沙地上小跑的阿拉伯馬。

examples.en: The Arabian Peninsula faces significant water shortages, encouraging investment in desalination technology and more efficient irrigation.
examples.zh: 阿拉伯半島面臨嚴重缺水，這推動了對海水淡化技術和高效灌溉的投資。

words.tip: Arabian多指半島或馬種；語言用Arabic，人常用Arab。

senses.en: A long-handled tool for washing floors
To clean a surface or remove liquid with absorbent material

examples.en: I used a mop to clean the muddy kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 我用拖把擦洗了沾滿泥的廚房地板。

examples.en: Staff should mop shared floors regularly to maintain hygiene in schools and other public buildings.
examples.zh: 工作人員應定期拖洗公共區域的地面，以保持學校及其他公共建築的衛生。

words.tip: 動詞過去式mopped，進行式mopping，均雙寫p。

senses.en: To flow out suddenly in large amounts.
To express enthusiasm or praise in an excessive way.
A sudden, strong flow of liquid.

examples.en: Water gushed from the broken pipe beneath the sink.
examples.zh: 水從水槽下方破裂的管道里噴湧而出。

examples.en: When ageing pipes burst, clean water can gush into streets, wasting resources and disrupting local transport.
examples.zh: 老化的管道爆裂時，清水會湧上街道，浪費資源並擾亂當地交通。

words.tip: 談論人時，gush about常暗示讚美過於熱情。

senses.en: done regularly or repeatedly as a habit

examples.en: His habitual lateness meant we often missed the bus.
examples.zh: 他習慣性遲到，害得我們常常錯過公交車。

examples.en: Habitual use of private cars can increase urban congestion and discourage investment in public transport.
examples.zh: 習慣性使用私家車可能加劇城市擁堵，並削弱投資公共交通的動力。

words.tip: 形容反覆發生的行為，也可修飾經常做某事的人。

senses.en: Stopping and starting repeatedly rather than continuing without a break.

examples.en: Intermittent rain kept us running indoors throughout the afternoon.
examples.zh: 整個下午，斷斷續續的雨讓我們不時跑回屋裡。

examples.en: Intermittent internet access can prevent rural students from participating fully in online learning programmes.
examples.zh: 網路連線時斷時續，會妨礙農村學生充分參與線上學習課程。

words.tip: 強調時停時續，不一定按固定週期發生。

senses.en: making someone feel that they need rest

examples.en: Carrying these heavy bags upstairs is tiring work.
examples.zh: 把這些沉重的袋子搬上樓是件累人的活。

examples.en: Long and tiring commutes can reduce workers' productivity and leave them with less time for family activities.
examples.zh: 漫長而累人的通勤會降低員工的工作效率，也會減少他們參與家庭活動的時間。

words.tip: tiring形容事物令人累；tired形容人感到累。

senses.en: To make someone feel less tired or more comfortable.
To load the latest version of displayed information.
To help someone remember something learned or experienced before.

examples.en: A cool shower refreshed me after the long walk.
examples.zh: 走了很遠的路後，衝個涼讓我恢復了精神。

examples.en: Regular breaks can refresh employees and help them maintain concentration during tasks that require sustained mental effort.
examples.zh: 定時休息能讓員工恢復精神，幫助他們在需要持續腦力投入的任務中保持專注。

words.tip: 人感覺精神恢復用refreshed；令人清爽用refreshing。

senses.en: A place where people can stay in tents.

examples.en: We found a quiet campsite beside the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊找到了一處安靜的露營地。

examples.en: Well-managed campsites allow visitors to enjoy natural landscapes while limiting damage to local ecosystems.
examples.zh: 管理良好的露營地讓遊客欣賞自然風光，同時減少對當地生態系統的破壞。

words.tip: 英式常用campsite，美式也常用campground。

senses.en: Become faster, or make something happen faster.

examples.en: I quickened my pace when the rain started.
examples.zh: 開始下雨時，我加快了腳步。

examples.en: Improved transport links can quicken the pace of economic development by connecting rural producers with urban markets.
examples.zh: 改善交通聯絡可以將農村生產者與城市市場連線起來，從而加快經濟發展的步伐。

words.tip: 可及物或不及物，常搭配pace、pulse。

senses.en: A unit of volume equal to one thousand milliliters.

examples.en: This bottle holds exactly one liter of fresh milk.
examples.zh: 這個瓶子正好能裝一升鮮奶。

examples.en: Measuring household water consumption by the liter can help residents understand how much they use each day.
examples.zh: 以升為單位測量家庭用水量，可以幫助居民瞭解自己每天用了多少水。

words.tip: liter是美式拼寫，英式為litre；一升等於一千毫升。

senses.en: Having won a competition, battle, or struggle.

examples.en: The victorious team lifted the trophy above their heads.
examples.zh: 獲勝的隊伍將獎盃高舉過頭頂。

examples.en: Athletes who emerge victorious in international competitions often inspire younger generations to participate in sport.
examples.zh: 在國際賽事中獲勝的運動員往往會激勵年輕一代參與體育運動。

words.tip: victorious是形容詞；victory是表示勝利的名詞。

senses.en: to spread throughout a place or affect every part

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread pervaded the kitchen.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫了整個廚房。

examples.en: Digital technology now pervades everyday life, changing how people communicate, study, and access public services.
examples.zh: 數字技術如今滲透日常生活，改變著人們交流、學習和獲取公共服務的方式。

words.tip: 及物動詞，直接接場所或領域，不加介詞。

senses.en: Find your position or become familiar with your surroundings.
Position something towards a direction or focus it on something.

examples.en: I used the river to orientate myself in town.
examples.zh: 我藉助河流來確定自己在城裡的方位。

examples.en: Universities should orientate their support services towards the needs of students adjusting to life away from home.
examples.zh: 大學應以適應離家生活的學生的需求為導向，提供支援服務。

words.tip: 多用於英式英語；常用orientate oneself，不專指向東。

senses.en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container
examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts

examples.en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
examples.zh: 我把衣物從行李箱裡拿出來，掛好了襯衫。

examples.en: Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.
examples.zh: 教師可以透過審視每個論點背後的證據和假設，幫助學生剖析複雜的論證。

words.tip: 既可指取出行李，也可比喻拆解複雜觀點。

senses.en: Burning or shining brightly.
To get off a vehicle or land on a surface.

examples.en: The candles were still alight when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我們到達時，蠟燭還燃著。

examples.en: Passengers should wait until the bus has stopped completely before they alight from the vehicle.
examples.zh: 乘客應等公交車完全停穩後再下車。

words.tip: 形容詞通常作表語；下車用alight from。

senses.en: in the same direction as the hands of a clock
moving in the same direction as clock hands

examples.en: Turn the lid clockwise until the jar is sealed.
examples.zh: 順時針擰蓋子，直到罐子密封。

examples.en: Visitors move clockwise around the exhibition hall, allowing the museum to manage crowds and prevent congestion.
examples.zh: 參觀者沿順時針方向繞展廳行進，便於博物館管理人流並防止擁堵。

words.tip: 反義詞英式常用anticlockwise，美式常用counterclockwise。

senses.en: being the first of its kind for someone or something
a young unmarried woman, especially in old stories

examples.en: The new ferry completed its maiden voyage this morning.
